## How to generate AI designs in 30 seconds

With Sivi's [**Design AI**](./design-ai), just pick a size, add your prompt, and generate the designs.

No more blank canvas and drag-and-drop manual labor. Let Sivi’s generative engine handle the composition.

#### 1

### Choose any size

Pick one from a bunch of pre-set sizes for web banners, ads, social posts, profile covers, emails, and more. You are not limited to presets. If your size isn’t listed, simply choose Custom Size and type in your own.

#### 2

### Add prompt

Type what you would like to promote in your preferred language. You can also add your product page URL for Sivi to extract product details, images, colors, and typography. Not sure what to type in? Get brand-specific campaign recommendations.

#### 3

### Generate editable designs

Choose how your designs are created. Use Auto Mode when you want things done fast. Sivi writes your text, picks images, sets the size and style, and instantly generates your designs. Go with Review Mode if you like having more control.

## Get answers to common questions about Sivi

## Get answers to common questions about Sivi

## Get answers to common questions about Sivi

### **What is Sivi?**

Sivi is an AI-powered design platform that uses its Large Design Model to generate layered, editable, free-form designs from text, the way LLMs generate text from prompts. Unlike image generators that paint flat pixels, Sivi's LDM composes elements: text, vectors, images, backgrounds, each on its own layer.

### **Is Sivi an image generator?**

No, Sivi is an AI design generator, not an AI image generator. With its Large Design Model (LDM), Sivi creates free-form, layered designs (e.g., You can't move the text in an image, but you can in a design).

### **What makes Sivi different from other AI design tools?**

According to The New York Times, Sivi is the only one of ~95,000 design-creation apps that produces editable layers. Unlike text-to-image models, Sivi's Large Design Model generates multi-layered, fully editable designs.

### **Do I need design skills to use Sivi?**

No. Sivi is built for non-designers. Describe what you need in plain text and Sivi generates editable, on-brand marketing designs in seconds. Marketers, founders, and ecommerce teams use Sivi daily without any design background.

### **What type of AI designs can I generate?**

With Sivi, you can generate a wide range of designs, including [display ads](./usecases/display-ads-generator), [social media posts](./usecases/ai-social-media-post-generator), [YouTube thumbnails](./usecases/youtube-thumbnail-generator), [Instagram ads](./usecases/instagram-ad-maker), [WhatsApp promotions](./usecases/whatsapp-promotion-generator), [Amazon A+ banners,](./usecases/amazon-a-plus-content-generator) and more.

### **Can I edit the text in the designs?**

Yes, all text, images, and elements in the AI generated designs are fully editable.

### **Can I use my own brand assets?**

Absolutely. Sivi is built to integrate your components and brand guidelines.

### **How does Sivi work?**

Sivi uses its Large Design Model trained to generate designs. The process begins by analyzing your content, followed by creating an initial composition. The LDM then fine-tunes the composition and applies appropriate colors. Once the designs are generated, they undergo a scoring process based on aesthetics. Only designs that meet quality standards are approved and displayed to you.

### **How do I generate designs with AI?**

You can either provide a prompt to the AI design generator for creative ideas, or if you have a clear vision, simply input your text, images, and brand details. Sivi will generate customized designs based on your inputs.

### **Is Sivi free to use?**

Yes, Sivi offers a free plan with up to 12 designs per month. [**Sivi’s paid plans**](./pricing) start at $16/month (billed yearly) or $20/month (billed monthly), with higher tiers for more credits, storage, and features.

### **Can I use Sivi AI designs for commercial purposes?**

Yes, AI designs generated with Sivi can be used for both personal and commercial projects. However, redistribution of the designs is only supported with certain subscription plans. Be sure to check your plan's details for specific redistribution rights.

### **Does Sivi support my language?**

Yes, Sivi generates AI designs in over 72 languages, including French, Spanish, Russian, German, Hindi, and Chinese. Occasionally, some designs may display symbols instead of proper text, but this can be easily fixed by selecting or uploading a font that supports the specific language.

### **Can I integrate Sivi in my platform?**

Yes, you can integrate Sivi for on-demand creatives into your marketing, ecommerce, email, ad platforms, and more using [**Sivi API**](./api) or [**UI SDK**](./sdk).

## The gap in generative AI

Text-to-image models like Midjourney, DALL-E, or Nanobanana Pro represent a breakthrough in digital art. They are incredible at generating a surreal concept art or a stock photo replacement.

  


However, for businesses, they fail at one critical task: Design.

### The problem?

Text-to-image models generate flat raster images. The text they generate is often hallucinated, buttons are just colored rectangles you can't click, and you cannot move a single element. If you need to change a headline, you have to regenerate the entire image and hope for the best.

### The Solution

The Large Design Model. By treating design as a system of components rather than a grid of pixels, an LDM bridges the gap between chaos and control.

[Try Large Design Model](https://instant.sivi.ai/#/generate-designs?source=sivi-ldm)

## What is a Large Design Model?

A Large Design Model is a generative AI system that outputs layered data like JSON instead of just pixel data.

  


As a true text-to-design generator, it understands that a card consists of an image, a headline, a subtext, and a CTA button. It knows that the CTA button needs to align with the text branding.

## Large Design Model Architecture

LDM employs custom diffusion models and multimodal architectures. LDM starts by understanding the content (text and assets) as well as the user-provided brand details, transforming them into a JSON representation.

  


The composer takes the representation JSON, adds styles and preferences, and produces a layered design as JSON.

  


The composition JSON is then passed onto the SVG Rendering Engine, where the color generator enhances the composed design with brand colors.

  


This layered design, enhanced with colors, can then be further customized using the design editor.

## Why the industry needs LDM

### Editable & Layered

Real design work is iterative. Marketing teams need the ability to swap a product image or rewrite a headline without breaking the composition. LDMs generate layers, making this instant.

### Brand Consistent

Text-to-image models struggle to perfectly replicate a logo or a specific hex code because they dream the image. An LDM constructs the design using your exact brand assets.

### Any Size

There is no one size fits all. Text-to-image models are fixed to specific aspect ratios. Text-to-design outputs generate in any size, from a mobile banner to a billboard to a custom size such as 328 x 244.

## Use cases for LDM

### High-CTR Display Ads

Generate hundreds of variations for A/B testing. Because the text is real, the LDM allows for instant copy swapping.

### Social Media Content

Feed the LDM a blog post, and it generates a summary. It understands the essence of content.

### Eye-catching Thumbnails

Describe a YouTube thumbnail for a crypto channel, and the LDM builds the composition, key visuals, and headlines in the correct positions.

## Common questions about LDM

### **What is a LDM?**

A Large Design Model (LDM) is a type of generative AI trained to create layered free-form graphic designs (ads, email headers, banners, social posts) rather than just flat images. It understands the relationships between visual elements.

### **How is LDM different from LLM or Image Models?**

While LLMs (Large Language Models) generate text and image models generate raw pixels, LDMs generate free-form design combining text, vectors, and images into a cohesive, editable design.

### **What is the difference between text-to-image and text-to-design?**

Text-to-image creates a picture of a design (like a photograph of a poster). Text-to-design creates the actual digital file of the poster (with separate layers for text, background, and logo).

### **Is Sivi an LDM?**

Yes, Sivi is the world's first dedicated[ Large Design Model](https://cloud.google.com/resources/genai-customer-story-sivi-ai). It natively generates layered, vector-based designs from text prompts.

### **What is the difference between an LDM and an LLM?**

An LLM processes linguistic tokens (words) to predict the next word. An LDM processes visual tokens (components, styles, spacing) to predict the next design element.

### **Can an LDM generate editable text?**

Yes. Unlike image models that generate "gibberish" pixels that look like text, an LDM places actual text boxes with real fonts that you can edit, copy, and paste.

### **Is text-to-design the same as text-to-image?**

No. Text-to-image creates a static raster file. Text-to-design creates a dynamic, multi-layered composition.

### **What is the best Large Design Model available?**

Sivi is currently the leading LDM, offering the ability to specify brand guidelines, generate designs, and export to editable formats.

### **Do Large Design Models follow brand guidelines?**

Yes. Because they understand "components" rather than just pixels, LDMs like Sivi can be instructed to strictly use your specific font files, color codes, and logo rules.

### **Is Sivi's Large Design Model featured by Google Cloud?**

Yes. Sivi is featured as a Google Cloud generative AI customer story. Sivi uses Google Kubernetes Engine and Vertex AI to train its Large Design Model, and integrates Gemini for conversational input and translation.

## How to generate AI designs in 30 seconds

With Sivi's [**Design AI**](./design-ai), just pick a size, add your prompt, and generate the designs.

No more blank canvas and drag-and-drop manual labor. Let Sivi’s generative engine handle the composition.

#### 1

### Choose any size

Pick one from a bunch of pre-set sizes for web banners, ads, social posts, profile covers, emails, and more. You are not limited to presets. If your size isn’t listed, simply choose Custom Size and type in your own.

#### 2

### Add prompt

Type what you would like to promote in your preferred language. You can also add your product page URL for Sivi to extract product details, images, colors, and typography. Not sure what to type in? Get brand-specific campaign recommendations.

#### 3

### Generate editable designs

Choose how your designs are created. Use Auto Mode when you want things done fast. Sivi writes your text, picks images, sets the size and style, and instantly generates your designs. Go with Review Mode if you like having more control.

## Get answers to common questions about Sivi

## Get answers to common questions about Sivi

## Get answers to common questions about Sivi

### **What is Sivi?**

Sivi is an AI-powered design platform that uses its Large Design Model to generate layered, editable, free-form designs from text, the way LLMs generate text from prompts. Unlike image generators that paint flat pixels, Sivi's LDM composes elements: text, vectors, images, backgrounds, each on its own layer.

### **Is Sivi an image generator?**

No, Sivi is an AI design generator, not an AI image generator. With its Large Design Model (LDM), Sivi creates free-form, layered designs (e.g., You can't move the text in an image, but you can in a design).

### **What makes Sivi different from other AI design tools?**

According to The New York Times, Sivi is the only one of ~95,000 design-creation apps that produces editable layers. Unlike text-to-image models, Sivi's Large Design Model generates multi-layered, fully editable designs.

### **Do I need design skills to use Sivi?**

No. Sivi is built for non-designers. Describe what you need in plain text and Sivi generates editable, on-brand marketing designs in seconds. Marketers, founders, and ecommerce teams use Sivi daily without any design background.

### **What type of AI designs can I generate?**

With Sivi, you can generate a wide range of designs, including [display ads](./usecases/display-ads-generator), [social media posts](./usecases/ai-social-media-post-generator), [YouTube thumbnails](./usecases/youtube-thumbnail-generator), [Instagram ads](./usecases/instagram-ad-maker), [WhatsApp promotions](./usecases/whatsapp-promotion-generator), [Amazon A+ banners,](./usecases/amazon-a-plus-content-generator) and more.

### **Can I edit the text in the designs?**

Yes, all text, images, and elements in the AI generated designs are fully editable.

### **Can I use my own brand assets?**

Absolutely. Sivi is built to integrate your components and brand guidelines.

### **How does Sivi work?**

Sivi uses its Large Design Model trained to generate designs. The process begins by analyzing your content, followed by creating an initial composition. The LDM then fine-tunes the composition and applies appropriate colors. Once the designs are generated, they undergo a scoring process based on aesthetics. Only designs that meet quality standards are approved and displayed to you.

### **How do I generate designs with AI?**

You can either provide a prompt to the AI design generator for creative ideas, or if you have a clear vision, simply input your text, images, and brand details. Sivi will generate customized designs based on your inputs.

### **Is Sivi free to use?**

Yes, Sivi offers a free plan with up to 12 designs per month. [**Sivi’s paid plans**](./pricing) start at $16/month (billed yearly) or $20/month (billed monthly), with higher tiers for more credits, storage, and features.

### **Can I use Sivi AI designs for commercial purposes?**

Yes, AI designs generated with Sivi can be used for both personal and commercial projects. However, redistribution of the designs is only supported with certain subscription plans. Be sure to check your plan's details for specific redistribution rights.

### **Does Sivi support my language?**

Yes, Sivi generates AI designs in over 72 languages, including French, Spanish, Russian, German, Hindi, and Chinese. Occasionally, some designs may display symbols instead of proper text, but this can be easily fixed by selecting or uploading a font that supports the specific language.

### **Can I integrate Sivi in my platform?**

Yes, you can integrate Sivi for on-demand creatives into your marketing, ecommerce, email, ad platforms, and more using [**Sivi API**](./api) or [**UI SDK**](./sdk).

## What is Sivi Gen-2?

Generative AI graphic design, not a template or an image!

  


Most AI design tools are just template shufflers. They take a pre-made template and blindly swap the text. Sivi Gen-2 is different. It is a foundational [Large Design Model](./large-design-model) (LDM) that builds every design pixel-perfectly from scratch based on your content.

  


Think of it as an AI Designer app that lives in your browser. You give it the brief, the assets, and the brand guidelines, and it generates unique ads and banners in seconds.

Generative AI graphic design, not a template or an image!

  


Most AI design tools are just template shufflers. They take a pre-made template and blindly swap the text. Sivi Gen-2 is different. It is a foundational [Large Design Model](./large-design-model) (LDM) that builds every design pixel-perfectly from scratch based on your content.

  


Think of it as an AI Designer app that lives in your browser. You give it the brief, the assets, and the brand guidelines, and it generates unique ads and banners in seconds.

With the new style cards, users get improved predictability and consistent brand identity with finer creative control over styles of design elements such as image container, backdrop, headline, etc.

## How to generate designs with Sivi Gen-2

Whether you're brainstorming or production-ready, Sivi Gen-2 adapts to your workflow with three flexible ways to bring your ideas to life:

Whether you're brainstorming or production-ready, Sivi Gen-2 adapts to your workflow with three flexible ways to bring your ideas to life:

#### Prompt with Sivi AI Designer

**Perfect for:** Ideation, quick ad copy, social media posts, marketing concepts.

**How it works:**

  1. Describe what you need in the prompt box along with your purpose and dimensions (e.g., "Facebook ad for my new yoga class").

  2. Sivi then crafts compelling copy and visuals tailored to your purpose.

  3. Simply review, select your favorites, and hit 'Generate'!




### [Explore Prompting Guide »](./prompt-engineering)

#### Design with your own content

**Perfect for:** Production Assets, Specific Campaigns. When you have specific text and images in mind.

**How it works:**

  1. Choose skip prompt on the homepage and go to content editor

  2. Type your copy and upload your assets (photos, logos, etc.). It's about content engineering.

  3. Customize with your brand colors and fonts under preferences.

  4. Sivi Gen-2 transforms your content into eye-catching designs.




### [Try Content Engineering »](./content-engineering)

#### The Sivi Chrome Extension

**Perfect for:** E-commerce stores and content creators to automatically extract content from your product pages, blog posts, or any other web pages.

**How it works:**

  1. Install the extension and open a product page or blog post.

  2. The extension auto-extracts text, images, brand elements, and more.

  3. Select the content you want and let Sivi work its magic!

## The Evolution of Sivi Gen-2

Sivi Gen-2 is continuously evolving. Your account gives you access to the latest model updates. Sivi Gen-3 is next.

### Sivi Gen-2

#### The Base LDM

The core Large Design Model that introduced style-based design generation with multiple variants and improved design composition. Released in early 2024.

### Sivi Gen-2E

#### Enhanced Model

Released in mid 2024. Features a rewritten color science engine for more vibrant outputs and improved typography logic for better readability.

### Sivi Gen-2.5

#### Faster Model

## Frequently Asked Questions

### **What is Sivi Gen-2?**

Sivi Gen-2 is a generative AI system for graphic design. Unlike tools that use templates, Sivi Gen-2 uses a Large Design Model to generate unique, editable designs layer-by-layer from your text and assets.

### **Is there a free AI Designer?**

Yes. Sivi offers a free tier that allows you to generate, customized, and download designs using the AI designer. You can [upgrade](./pricing) for more credits and advanced features.

### **How does Sivi Gen-2 differ from Gen-3?**

Sivi Gen-2 is a style-based model, excellent for following specific aesthetic guidelines. [Sivi Gen-3](./gen3) is a component-based model with agentic architecture for even more complex workflows.

### **Can I edit Gen-2 designs with my branding?**

Yes. Sivi generates standard vector layers. You can easily add your brand colors, fonts, and logos to ensure your designs reflect your unique brand identity.

### **What is Sivi Gen-2.5?**

Sivi Gen-2.5 is a significant update to the Gen-2 model for faster speed and better graphic layout understanding. It is available now within the Sivi suite.

### **Does Sivi use templates?**

Sivi is a text-to-design generator. It constructs designs from scratch based on the content and style you provide, ensuring your designs never look generic.

### **Do I need design experience to use Sivi Gen-2?**

Absolutely not! Sivi Gen-2 is designed for users of all skill levels. It empowers those who want to express themselves visually, even if they don't possess years of design training. It’s perfect to express your creativity, whether you're an entrepreneur, a small business owner, a passionate blogger, or simply someone who loves to create.

### **What types of designs can Sivi Gen-2 create?**

Sivi Gen-2 is incredibly versatile. It can generate display ads, WhatsApp promotions, social media posts, Instagram Ads, Amazon A+ content, product banners, website graphics, blog headers, marketing materials, and so much more!

### **How is Sivi Gen-2 different from image generators?**

Sivi is a design AI. It generates multi-layered designs with vectors, text, and images. You can customize each layer in the design editor just like you do in any other design tool. Unlike image generators, Sivi generates designs for a wide range of dimensions, even custom sizes!

### **What file formats does Sivi Gen-2 support?**

Sivi Gen-2 supports PNG and JPG formats, with more coming soon!

### **How do I generate designs in regional languages?**

Yes, Sivi automatically supports 72+ regional languages. Simply type your prompt or content in your preferred language. See the [full list here](https://support.sivi.ai/generate-your-first-design/languages). Need a language that's not listed? Choose a suitable font and design away!

### **Can I use Sivi Gen-2 outputs commercially?**

Yes, you can absolutely use Sivi Gen-2 designs for commercial purposes.

## Why Sivi Gen-3?

  * You shouldn't have to redo every AI design in Photoshop.

  * Your brand shouldn't look generic across every channel.

  * Your team shouldn't wait weeks for campaign creative.




  


Most AI tools today work on probability. You type a prompt, and they guess pixels. The result is a flat image that looks good in isolation but fails in production. Because it is off-brand, locked to a fixed aspect ratio, and impossible to edit the image without rebuilding it from scratch.

  


Sivi Gen-3 changes this by moving from probability to intent. It uses an agentic workflow to reason, critique, and refine input and designs just like a human designer would. It creates original, pixel-perfect designs for your brand, editable to the last layer. Not AI slop. Not flat images. You get production-ready creative your team can use the moment it's generated.

#### On-brand Designs

Stop fixing hallucinated text and melted buttons. Start directing an AI that understands design systems.

## What's new in Sivi Gen-3

#### Significantly improved design quality

A meaningful leap over Sivi Gen-2.8s in layout, typography, hierarchy, and visual polish. Trained on design principles, not just image aesthetics, so hierarchy, balance, and white space hold up at professional-grade composition.

#### Brand-component-based generation

Every design is composed from your brand's components, so consistency is built in. This ensures that a button looks like your button, not a generic AI approximation.

#### Agentic flow

An agent reads your brief, pulls your brand context, and reasons through the creative direction before design generation begins. You give it a goal, it forms the right input, so the design starts on-brand and on-intent.

#### Contextual Intelligence

Drop a link to your website, and Sivi understands your brand instantly. No need to manually upload hex codes or font files.

#### Every layer editable

Headlines, CTAs, products, backgrounds, each a native, editable layer you can change in seconds.

[Generate Designs With LDM](https://instant.sivi.ai/#/generate-designs?source=sivi-gen3)

True editability means you never have to open Photoshop to fix an AI mistake again.

## How it works: The Agentic Architecture

Sivi Gen-3 isn't just a bigger model; it's a different kind of brain. It uses a three-step cognitive loop to ensure quality.

#### Perception

##### Context Extraction

Before designing, the agentic workflow analyzes your input. Add a URL, and it extracts the visual schema such as text message, colors, typography, offer, automatically.

#### Reasoning

##### The Critique Loop

Unlike standard models that blindly output an image, Sivi critiques its own work. It might catch that a button's contrast is too low and fix it before you ever see the design.

#### Execution

##### Atomic Construction

Sivi builds designs using atoms - your specific buttons, input fields, and containers. This means the final output isn't a flat JPEG, but a fully free-form, editable design file.

[Generate Designs With LDM](https://instant.sivi.ai/#/generate-designs?source=sivi-gen3)

It’s like having a senior designer who double-checks their work before showing it to the creative director.

## Frequently Asked Questions

#### **What is Sivi Gen-3?**

Sivi Gen-3 is the brand component-based Large Design Model (LDM) with an agentic workflow. It generates fully editable, component-based designs rather than flat images.

#### **What is a Large Design Model (LDM)?**

An [LDM](./large-design-model) is an AI model specifically trained on graphic design principles: grouping, typography, and hierarchy, unlike standard Large Language Models (LLMs) or Image Diffusion Models.

#### **Is Sivi Gen-3 the latest design model?**

Yes, Gen-3 represents the next leap in AI design, following Sivi Gen-2.5. It introduces component-based design generation and agentic architecture.

#### **How does component-based design work?**

Instead of generating a single flat image, Sivi constructs the design from individual brand-specific elements (components) like buttons and text blocks. This makes every part of the design fully editable and consistent.

#### **What data or inputs does Sivi Gen-3 support?**

You can input text prompts, upload assets (logos, images), or valid URLs. Sivi can extract context and content from these inputs to generate relevant ads or banners.

#### **How can I access or start using Sivi Gen-3?**

Sivi Gen-3 is currently in development for Q2 2026. You can get early access to be among the first to experience agentic design.

#### **What is the pricing for Sivi Gen-3?**

Pricing is credit-based: 1.5 credits per design for sizes up to 1280px, and 2 credits per design for sizes larger than that.

#### **Can I use Sivi Gen-3 outputs commercially?**

Yes, similar to other LDM versions, you can use Sivi Gen-3 designs for commercial purposes. The AI-generated design is owned by the user, and the user can use it for any purpose.

## **Three products, one engine**

Sivi has been the Large Design Model category creator.

##### **Sivi API**

**For backend integration and automated pipelines.**

  


Send a JSON request with your text prompt, content, brand kit, and output size. Get back a multi-layered design with every element individually addressable. Export as JSON, HTML, JPG, PNG, or PDF.

  


**Best for** : bulk generation, automated workflows, scheduled campaigns, server-side processing.

[Learn more about the API](./api)

##### Sivi SDK

**For user-facing design experiences.**

  


Embed a complete design generator and editor inside your product. Your users type a prompt, get a design, edit any element, and export. White-label the entire experience with your brand colors, fonts, and logo.

  


**Best for** : client portals, SaaS embeds, seller dashboards, team design tools.

[Learn more about the SDK](./sdk)

##### Sivi MCP

**For AI agents and agentic workflows.**

  


Connect any AI agent to Sivi through the Model Context Protocol. Your agent calls Sivi as a tool, generates layered designs mid-conversation, and returns results to the user. No custom integration code. Works with Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor, Windsurf, and any MCP-compatible client.

  


**Best for** : AI assistants, agentic workflows, copilot features, chat-based design generation.

The API is headless. You control the UI. The SDK is a drop-in design studio. You control the branding. Use one or both depending on your product.

## **Built for your platform**

Sivi's design API automates design creation within platforms. Instead of relying on templates, Sivi uses its Large Design Model to produce fresh, professional layouts instantly. Each integration looks different. Here's what it looks like for yours.

#### **Ecommerce platforms**

Auto-generate product banners, category headers, and sale creatives for thousands of SKUs. One API call per product. Feed in your product data, get back layered banners.

#### **Agencies**

Build a white-label design studio for your clients. Each client gets their own portal with their brand kit. They self-serve on-brand designs within your guardrails.

#### **LLM and AI products**

Your AI agent writes the copy. Sivi composes the matching visual. Chain text generation and design generation in the same workflow. Use the MCP server so your agent calls Sivi directly as a tool, no glue code needed.

#### Ad platforms

Your users stay in-platform at the creative stage. They generate ad creatives instantly instead of dropping off to design somewhere else. All IAB sizes. A/B variations on demand.

#### **Social media platforms**

Users generate branded social posts, stories, and reels covers without switching to an external tool. Every post matches their brand kit.

#### **Enterprise**

Brand governance at scale. The API enforces your brand kit across thousands of creatives, 72 languages, any channel. The SDK gives regional teams self-serve access.

#### **Website builders**

Add a **Generate Banner** button to your page editor. Hero banners, hello bars, blog covers, on demand.

#### **Media and content companies**

Automate daily content production. Generate professional marketing designs in 72+ languages at publishing speed.

#### **Email marketing platforms**

Generate email headers and newsletter visuals that match the campaign content. Output exports as HTML.

## Get started in 5 minutes

  1. Sign up at [instant.sivi.ai](https://instant.sivi.ai/) and get your API key.  
  


  2. Make your first API call. Two input modes are available: [Designs from Prompt](https://developer.sivi.ai/docs/sivi-api/core-api/designs-from-prompt) or [Designs from Content](https://developer.sivi.ai/docs/sivi-api/core-api/designs-from-content).  
  


  3. Explore the output. The response includes an array of variant objects containing URLs and `link`s to an anonymous design studio where you can view, edit, and export the generated designs.  
  


  4. Decide your integration path. API only? SDK embed? MCP for your AI agent? Mix and match. Pick the plan that fits.



    
    
    import requests
    
    response = requests.post(
        "https://connect.sivi.ai/api/prod/v2/general/designs-from-prompt",
        headers={"sivi-api-key": "YOUR_API_KEY", "Content-Type": "application/json"},
        json={
            "type": "displayAds",
            "subtype": "displayAds-half-page-ad",
            "dimension": {"width": 300, "height": 600},
            "prompt": "generate a design for my t-shirt shop for summer campaign with 20% off",
            "assets": {
                "images": [],
                "logos": []
            },
            "language": "english",
            "numOfVariants": 4,
            "outputFormat": ["jpg", "png"],
            "settings": {
                "mode": "custom",
                "colors": ["#005C99", "#00BFA6", "#333333", "#F0F0F0"]
            }
        }
    )
    
    result = response.json()
    design_id = result["body"]["designId"]
    
    # Step 3: Retrieve the generated design variants
    variants_response = requests.post(
        "https://connect.sivi.ai/api/prod/v2/general/get-design-variants",
        headers={"sivi-api-key": "YOUR_API_KEY", "Content-Type": "application/json"},
        json={
            "designId": design_id,
            "type": "generated",
            "limit": 10
        }
    )
    
    variants = variants_response.json()
    for v in variants["body"]["variations"]:
        print(f"Variant: {v['variantId']}")
        print(f"Image: {v['variantImageUrl']}")
        print(f"Edit: {v['variantEditLink']}")

## Common questions about the design API, SDK, and MCP

#### **What is a design API?**

A design API takes text and brand assets as input and returns a free-form, multi-layered design as output. It is different from an image generation API (flat pixels) and a template API (filled layouts). [Read the full guide.](./what-is-design-api)

#### **Is this a template-based system?**

No. Every design is generated from scratch by Sivi's Large Design Model. No templates to build, manage, or maintain.

#### **How do I choose between API, SDK, and MCP?**

Use the **API** if you need backend automation: bulk generation, scheduled campaigns, server-side pipelines. Use the **SDK** if your users need to generate and edit designs inside your product. Use the **MCP server** if you are building an AI agent that should generate designs as a tool call. Many teams use more than one.

#### **Do I need the SDK, or is the API enough?**

The API includes an anonymous design studio link for every generated design. Your users can open it to edit and export. But they cannot control the prompt or manage the full workflow inside your product. If your users need to generate designs themselves within your product, you need the SDK.

#### **Can I use the API, SDK, and MCP together?**

Yes. Common pattern: API for high-volume batch generation, SDK for interactive user-facing design, MCP server for AI agent workflows. All three share the same API key and brand kit.

#### **Do I need the SDK, the MCP server, or is the API enough?**

The API includes an anonymous design studio link for every generated design, your users can open it and edit the output (move elements, change text, export). What they cannot do with the API alone is work with the prompt or update the input. If your users need to generate designs themselves, control prompts, and manage the full input-to-output flow inside your product, you need the SDK. If you're building an AI agent or copilot that should generate designs as a tool call, use the MCP server.

#### **What is the Sivi MCP server?**

An MCP server that lets AI agents call Sivi as a tool during conversations and agentic workflows. Compatible with Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor, Windsurf, and other MCP clients.

#### **What plan do I need for SDK access?**

The SDK is available on the Superpower plan and Enterprise plans. The API alone is available on the Power plan ($96/mo). The MCP server works on all plans. [View full pricing](./api-pricing)

#### **How fast can I integrate?**

Most teams go from first API call to working prototype in under 60 minutes with the SDK, or under a day with the API. Production deployment typically takes under a week. [Quickstart guide](https://developer.sivi.ai/docs/intro)

Sivi API supports 72+ languages, eliminating the need for tedious manual translation and design adaptation.

## **What makes Sivi design API different?**

### **Layered, editable output**

The API returns a free-form design file, not a raster image. Every element (text blocks, images, vectors, backgrounds) exists on its own layer with independent coordinates, styles, and properties. You can programmatically access, modify, or remove any element after generation.

### **Text rendering**

Text is placed as real, selectable, editable text on independent layers. Never rendered as pixels. Never hallucinated. The API guarantees that the text in the output matches the text in your input.

### **Layout composition engine**

The LDM does not stretch, crop, or scale. It re-composes the entire layout for each target dimension. A 728x90 leaderboard and a 1080x1080 social post get different visual hierarchies, not different zoom levels of the same layout.

### **Brand system**

Attach a brand kit to your API key: hex codes, font families, logo files, spacing rules. The model enforces these as hard constraints on every generation. No per-request configuration needed. No drift across thousands of outputs.

### Async generation

POST your request and get a **designId** back immediately. Poll for completion or register a webhook. The API handles queuing, processing, and delivery. Concurrent requests supported on all plans.

### **Export pipeline**

Each generated design can be exported as JPG, PNG, HTML, or PDF. The export endpoint accepts the designId and returns rendered output in your specified format.

The output is not a screenshot. It is a layered design file where every text block, image, and vector is a separate, editable component.

The output is not a screenshot. It is a layered design file where every text block, image, and vector is a separate, editable component.

## **Sivi API request lifecycle**

### **Phase 1: Request**

POST a JSON payload to [designs-from-prompt](https://developer.sivi.ai/docs/sivi-api/core-api/designs-from-prompt) with a natural language prompt, or to [designs-from-content](https://developer.sivi.ai/docs/sivi-api/core-api/designs-from-content) with structured data (headline, body, CTA, product URL). Include your brand kit ID, target dimension, language, and numOfVariants.

### **Phase 2: Generation**

The API queues your request and returns a `designId` immediately. The LDM resolves brand assets, selects layout patterns, and composes a multi-layered design. Typical generation time: under 60 seconds. Use polling or webhook callbacks to detect completion.

### **Phase 3: Retrieval**

Call `get-design-variants` with your `designId`. Each variant includes a `variantImageUrl` (rendered preview), a `variantEditLink` (anonymous design studio for editing), and layer metadata. Export endpoints return JPG, PNG, HTML, or PDF.

## **Code samples**

### **Generate a design (cURL)**
    
    
     curl -X POST "https://connect.sivi.ai/api/prod/v2/general/designs-from-prompt" \
      -H "sivi-api-key: YOUR_API_KEY" \
      -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
      -d '{
        "type": "displayAds",
        "subtype": "displayAds-square",
        "dimension": { "width": 1080, "height": 1080 },
        "prompt": "Summer sale banner for urban clothing brand",
        "language": "english",
        "numOfVariants": 2
      }'

### **Generate a design (Python)**
    
    
     import requests
    
    response = requests.post(
        "https://connect.sivi.ai/api/prod/v2/general/designs-from-prompt",
        headers={"sivi-api-key": "YOUR_API_KEY", "Content-Type": "application/json"},
        json={
            "type": "displayAds",
            "subtype": "displayAds-square",
            "dimension": {"width": 1080, "height": 1080},
            "prompt": "Summer sale banner for urban clothing brand",
            "language": "english",
            "numOfVariants": 2
        }
    )
    
    result = response.json()
    design_id = result["body"]["designId"]
    
    # Retrieve the generated variants
    variants_response = requests.post(
        "https://connect.sivi.ai/api/prod/v2/general/get-design-variants",
        headers={"sivi-api-key": "YOUR_API_KEY", "Content-Type": "application/json"},
        json={"designId": design_id, "type": "generated", "limit": 10}
    )
    
    variants = variants_response.json()
    for v in variants["body"]["variations"]:
        print(f"Image: {v['variantImageUrl']}")
        print(f"Edit: {v['variantEditLink']}")

### **Generate a design (Node.js)**
    
    
     const response = await fetch("https://connect.sivi.ai/api/prod/v2/general/designs-from-prompt", {
      method: "POST",
      headers: {
        "sivi-api-key": "YOUR_API_KEY",
        "Content-Type": "application/json"
      },
      body: JSON.stringify({
        type: "displayAds",
        subtype: "displayAds-square",
        dimension: { width: 1080, height: 1080 },
        prompt: "Summer sale banner for urban clothing brand",
        language: "english",
        numOfVariants: 2
      })
    });
    
    const result = await response.json();
    const designId = result.body.designId;
    
    // Retrieve the generated variants
    const variantsRes = await fetch("https://connect.sivi.ai/api/prod/v2/general/get-design-variants", {
      method: "POST",
      headers: {
        "sivi-api-key": "YOUR_API_KEY",
        "Content-Type": "application/json"
      },
      body: JSON.stringify({ designId, type: "generated", limit: 10 })
    });
    
    const variants = await variantsRes.json();
    variants.body.variations.forEach(v => {
      console.log(`Image: ${v.variantImageUrl}`);
      console.log(`Edit: ${v.variantEditLink}`);
    });

## **Integration options**

Platform teams integrate the Sivi API to give their users design superpowers without building design infrastructure from scratch. Here is how different product categories use it.

### **REST API (headless)**

Call designs-from-prompt or designs-from-content, poll get-design-variants for results, and serve the output however you want. No frontend dependency. Best for automated pipelines, batch generation, and server-side processing.

### **SDK (full design studio)**

Import the React component or embed via iframe. The SDK handles generation, editing, and export in your frontend. You control theming, permissions, and user routing.

### **MCP server (AI agents)**

Install the MCP server. Any MCP-compatible client such as Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor, Windsurf calls Sivi as a tool within conversations or automated workflows. No custom integration code.

### Hybrid

Use the API for automated, high-volume generation, the SDK for interactive user-facing design, and the MCP server for AI agent workflows. Many integrators use more than one.

## Common questions about the design API

### **How does authentication work?**

Every request requires a `**sivi-api-key**` header. Create your key at [instant.sivi.ai](https://instant.sivi.ai/) and make your first call. The [quickstart](https://developer.sivi.ai/docs/sivi-api/core-api/core-overview) guide walks you through generating your first design in under 5 minutes.

### **Is the Sivi API a template-based system?**

No. The API uses the [Large Design Model (LDM)](./large-design-model) and generates original layouts on every call. Send the same prompt twice and get two different, well-composed designs. No template library to build or maintain. Your content and brand kit are the only inputs the model needs.

### **How is this different from image generation APIs like Nano Banana or Midjourney?**

Image generation APIs produce flat raster images with no editable layers and often hallucinate text. The Sivi design API generates free-form, multi-layered designs where every text block is real editable text and every element is a separate layer. You get a graphic design API output you can work with, not a frozen image.

### **How do I handle async generation?**

POST your request and receive a `**designId**` immediately. Poll the `**get-design-variants**` endpoint or register a webhook to be notified on completion. Concurrent requests are supported on all plans.

### **What user management models does the API support?**

The API supports three user management models:

  * **User redirection:** End-users are redirected to create Sivi accounts directly.

  * **API-managed users:** Create and manage end-user accounts programmatically with your API key.

  * **Fully embedded:** Users access design generation without leaving your platform. No Sivi-branded touchpoints.




### **How is data secured during API interactions?**

API keys authenticate every request. All data is encrypted in transit and at rest. Brand assets and generated designs are isolated per account and not used for model training. Enterprise plans include custom data residency options.

### **How is Sivi API different from Canva API?**

Sivi API auto-generates designs from prompts, no templates involved. Canva API provides access to a template-based editor for manual, collaborative design. Sivi is generative infrastructure. Canva is a collaborative editing tool. [Full comparison](./compare/canva-api-vs-sivi-api)

### **What enterprise API integration features are available?**

Enterprise integration includes:

  * Custom themes and white-labeling options for SDK

  * Flexible deployment options and staging environments

  * Dedicated support and custom feature development

  * Influence on product roadmap




### **Is there a sandbox for testing?**

Yes. The sandbox costs $1 one-time and gives you 20 credits with 7-day validity. Test output quality, integration patterns, and response formats before committing to a paid plan.

### **Do I own the designs generated through the API?**

Yes. All designs generated with your API key are your intellectual property. Sivi does not claim any rights over your generated output or brand assets.

# Embed an AI design studio in your product

Give your users the ability to generate, edit, and export on-brand designs without leaving your platform. The Sivi SDK drops a full design studio into your frontend. Your branding, your permissions, your UX. Sivi's Large Design Model underneath.

4.8/5

176,000 Brands

72+ Languages

  *   *   *   *   *   *   *   *   *   *   *   *   * 


The SDK is not a widget or a button. It is a complete design generation and editing environment that lives inside your product. 

The SDK is not a widget or a button. It is a complete design generation and editing environment that lives inside your product. 

The SDK is not a widget or a button. It is a complete design generation and editing environment that lives inside your product. 

The SDK is not a widget or a button. It is a complete design generation and editing environment that lives inside your product. 

## **What the SDK includes?**

#### **Design generator**

Your users type a prompt or paste content. The SDK calls Sivi's LDM and renders the generated design right inside your interface. Multiple variations per request. Any size. 72+ languages.

#### **Design editor**

Every generated design is fully editable. Users click any element to move it, resize it, change the text, swap an image, or adjust colors. The editor works like a lightweight design tool, not a static preview.

#### **Brand kit manager**

Set up brand kits with fonts, color palettes, logos, and component libraries. Assign different brand kits to different users or clients. The SDK enforces the assigned brand kit on every generation.

#### **Export module**

Users export finished designs as JPG, PNG, PDF, or HTML directly from the embedded editor. No external tools needed. No copy-pasting into another app.

[Get SDK Access](https://instant.sivi.ai/#/generate-designs?source=sivi-sdk)

## **How integration works?**

#### **Option 1: React component**

Import the Sivi SDK React component, pass your API key and configuration, and render it anywhere in your app. Full control over theming, feature toggles, and user permissions through props.
    
    
    import { SiviDesignStudio } from '@sivi/sdk-react';
    
    function DesignPage({ user }) {
      return (
        <SiviDesignStudio
          apiKey={process.env.SIVI_API_KEY}
          brandKitId={user.brandKitId}
          theme={{
            primaryColor: '#229EF9',
            fontFamily: 'Inter',
            borderRadius: '8px'
          }}
          permissions={{
            canExport: true,
            canEditText: true,
            canSwapImages: true
          }}
          onDesignComplete={(design) => {
            saveToUserLibrary(design);
          }}
        />
      );
    }

#### **Option 2: iframe embed**

For non-React stacks, embed the SDK as an iframe. Communicate via postMessage events. Works with any frontend framework or vanilla HTML.
    
    
    <iframe
      src="https://sdk.sivi.ai/studio?api_key=YOUR_KEY&brand_kit=bk_abc123"
      width="100%"
      height="700"
      frameborder="0"
    ></iframe>
    
    <script>
      window.addEventListener('message', (event) => {
        if (event.data.type === 'sivi:design-complete') {
          console.log('Design layers:', event.data.design.layers);
        }
      });
    </script>

#### **Option 3: API + custom UI**

Use the REST API for generation and build your own frontend. Best for teams that want complete UI control and only need the generation engine.

## **White-labeling**

The SDK is designed to disappear into your product. 

Your users should never know Sivi exists unless you want them to.

#### **Your branding**

Set primary colors, fonts, border radius, spacing, and icon styles. The design studio matches your product's look and feel. No Sivi logo unless you keep it.

#### **Your permissions**

Control exactly what each user can do. Allow or restrict: text editing, image swapping, color changes, export formats, brand kit switching. Different permission sets for different user tiers.

#### **Your user management**

Connect the SDK to your existing user system. Each user gets their own design history, saved assets, and brand kit assignments. The User Management API handles creation, permissions, and storage.

#### Your domain

For Enterprise plans, the SDK runs on your custom domain. Your users interact with sdk.yourdomain.com, not a Sivi URL.

## **Who uses the SDK?**

#### **Agencies building client portals**

The most common SDK use case. Agencies embed the design studio behind their own brand. Each client gets a portal with their brand kit pre-loaded. Clients generate their own ads, social posts, and banners within the agency's guardrails. The agency keeps creative control and scales output without adding junior designers.

#### **SaaS platforms adding design features**

Social media management tools, email marketing platforms, and CRM products use the SDK to keep users in-platform. Instead of "download your copy and go design it in Canva," users generate the matching visual right where they wrote the copy.

#### **Ecommerce platforms empowering sellers**

Marketplace operators embed the SDK so sellers can generate product banners and promotional graphics directly in the seller dashboard. Brand kits ensure marketplace visual consistency.

## Common questions about the SDK

#### **Do I need to build a design editor?**

No. The SDK includes a complete editor. Users can click any element to move, resize, or edit it. Text is live text, not an image. You get a full design tool without building one.

#### **Can I hide the Sivi branding?**

Yes. On Superpower and Enterprise plans, the SDK is fully white-labeled. You control colors, fonts, and logos. Your users interact with your brand, not ours.

#### **Can different users have different brand kits?**

Yes. The User Management API lets you assign brand kits per user. Agencies typically set one brand kit per client. Marketplaces set one per seller. Each user only sees designs generated with their assigned brand.

#### **What happens when a user generates a design?**

The SDK calls the Sivi API, which uses the LDM to compose a new layered design. The result renders in the embedded editor. The user can then edit any layer and export in their preferred format. The whole flow happens inside your product.

#### **Is there a sandbox for testing?**

Yes. The API sandbox works with the SDK. $1 one-time gives you 20 credits with 7-day validity to test the full embed experience before going to production.

#### **How is the SDK priced?**

The SDK is available on the Superpower plan ($280/mo) which includes 2,500 credits and up to 100 end customers, with per-user storage. Enterprise plans offer custom pricing for higher volumes. See the full breakdown on the [API pricing page](./api-pricing).

# What is a design API?

A design API takes text, brand assets, and size specifications as input and returns a complete, multi-layered design as output. Every element (text, images, vectors, backgrounds) exists on its own layer and can be edited independently. The output is a design file, not a flat image. Design APIs are used by platforms, apps, and AI agents to automate the creation of marketing visuals: banners, social posts, ad creatives, email headers, and more. They replace the manual work of a designer for high-volume, on-brand creative production.

# What is a design API?

A design API takes text, brand assets, and size specifications as input and returns a complete, multi-layered design as output. Every element (text, images, vectors, backgrounds) exists on its own layer and can be edited independently. The output is a design file, not a flat image. Design APIs are used by platforms, apps, and AI agents to automate the creation of marketing visuals: banners, social posts, ad creatives, email headers, and more. They replace the manual work of a designer for high-volume, on-brand creative production.

## **How a design API works**

**Step 1**

#### **You send a request**

A JSON payload with a text prompt or structured content, a brand kit reference, an output size, and a language. No visual input needed.

**Step 2**

#### **The engine composes a design**

A Large Design Model (LDM) selects layout patterns, places text as real editable text, positions images and vectors, and enforces brand rules: colors, fonts, logos, spacing. Every element is composed individually, not rendered as a flat image.

**Step 3**

#### **You get back a layered design file**

The response contains a free-form design with every element on its own layer. Text is text. Vectors are vectors. You can move, edit, resize, or delete any element in the design studio. Export as JPG, PNG, HTML, or PDF.

The key difference: a design API returns free-form, layered output where every element is individually addressable. An image API returns a flat raster where nothing can be edited. 

The key difference: a design API returns free-form, layered output where every element is individually addressable. An image API returns a flat raster where nothing can be edited. 

The key difference: a design API returns free-form, layered output where every element is individually addressable. An image API returns a flat raster where nothing can be edited. 

The key difference: a design API returns free-form, layered output where every element is individually addressable. An image API returns a flat raster where nothing can be edited. 

## **Three types of design-related APIs**

Not all APIs that produce visuals are the same. There are three distinct categories, each with a different architecture, output format, and use case.

#### **Template APIs**

**How they work:** You build a template with fixed slots (headline here, image there, logo in the corner). The API fills those slots with your data.  
**Output:** A filled version of the template. Fixed layout.  
**Examples:** Bannerbear, Placid, Abyssale  
**Good for:** High-volume production of visuals that follow the exact same layout. Product cards, social media posts with identical framing, certificates.  
**Limitation:** Every new layout requires a new template. Scaling to hundreds of design variations means building and maintaining hundreds of templates. No creative variety without manual template work.

#### **Image generation APIs**

**How they work:** A diffusion model generates a flat raster image from a text prompt. The model predicts pixels, not design elements.  
**Output:** A flat JPG or PNG. No layers, no editable text, no structure.  
**Examples:** DALL-E, Midjourney, Adobe Firefly, Stability AI  
**Good for:** Generating artistic imagery, illustrations, concept art, background textures.  
**Limitation:** Text in the image is rendered as pixels and frequently hallucinated (misspelled, garbled, or misplaced). No brand enforcement. No editability. Cannot produce marketing-ready designs where text accuracy and brand compliance matter.

#### **Design APIs**

**How they work:** A Large Design Model composes a design element by element. Text is placed as real text. Images and vectors are placed on separate layers. Brand rules (colors, fonts, logos) are enforced automatically.  
**Output:** A multi-layered design file. Every element is individually addressable, editable, and exportable.  
**Examples:** Sivi  
**Good for:** Automated production of marketing designs — banners, social posts, ad creatives, email headers, product visuals — where text accuracy, brand compliance, and editability are required.  
**Advantage:** No templates to maintain. Original layouts generated from scratch. Any size, any language (72+), full brand kit enforcement.

## **When to use a design API**

A design API is the right choice when your use case requires any combination of the following:

**Text accuracy**

The design contains headlines, CTAs, product names, or prices that must be letter-perfect. No hallucinated text.

**Brand compliance**

Every output must use the correct hex codes, fonts, logo placement, and spacing. Enforced automatically, not manually.

**Editability**

The output needs to be editable after generation. Users or systems need to change text, swap images, or adjust layout.

**Volume**

You're generating hundreds or thousands of designs per day. Templates can't scale without proportional maintenance effort.

**Multilingual**

The same design needs to work in 10, 30, or 72 languages. The layout must re-compose per language, not just swap text strings.

**Programmatic control**

You need to generate designs from code, in a pipeline, or through an AI agent without any human in the loop.

## **How Sivi's design API works**

Sivi is the first design API built on a Large Design Model. Here's what that means for developers:

#### **Input options**

  * **Designs from Prompt:** Send a natural language prompt ("Summer sale banner for urban clothing brand") and Sivi composes the design.



  * **Designs from Content:** Send structured content (headline, body text, CTA, product image URL) and Sivi arranges it into a design.




#### **Any size, any language**

Specify any custom dimension. The model doesn't stretch or crop, it composes the entire layout for the target size. Same for languages: switch from English to Arabic, and the layout flips to RTL with correct typography.

#### **Brand kit enforcement**

Attach a brand kit to your API key. Every design generated through that key automatically uses the correct colors, fonts, logos, and spacing. No manual checking.

## **When a design API is NOT the right choice**

#### **You need artistic imagery.**

For photo-realistic scenes, illustrations, concept art, use an image generation API like DALL-E or Midjourney.

#### **You need photo editing.**

For cropping, retouching, filters, background removal, use an image editing API, not a design API.

#### **You need a fixed, pixel-perfect layout every time.**

If the design must look identical across every output with zero variation, a template API gives you that control.

## Design APIs: What everyone wants to know

#### **Is a design API the same as an image generation API?**

No. An image generation API (DALL-E, Midjourney, Firefly) produces a flat raster image where text is pixels and nothing is editable. A design API produces a free-form, multi-layered design where text is real text, every element is on its own layer, and the entire output is editable. Different architecture, different output, different use case.

#### **Can a design API replace a graphic designer?**

For high-volume, templated work - yes. For bulk product banners, social post variations, ad creatives in multiple sizes and languages, a design API handles this faster and cheaper than manual design. For strategic brand work, campaign concepts, and custom creative direction, you still need a designer.

#### **Do I need templates to use a design API?**

No. A generative design API like Sivi creates original layouts from scratch. You send a prompt or structured content, and the model composes a new layout every time. No templates to build or maintain.

#### **How does a design API handle brand consistency?**

Through a brand kit. You upload your brand's colors, fonts, logos, and style rules once. The API enforces them on every design generated under that brand kit. No manual review needed.

#### **Can a design API generate designs in multiple languages?**

Sivi supports 72+ languages including RTL scripts (Arabic, Hebrew, etc.). It composes the entire layout so typography, reading direction, and spacing work correctly in the target language.

#### **How do AI agents use a design API?**

Through the Model Context Protocol (MCP). The AI agent treats the design API as a callable tool. It sends a design brief, receives a layered design back, and presents it to the user. This means any MCP-compatible assistant (Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor, Windsurf) can generate marketing designs as part of a conversation without switching apps.

#### **What's the cost of using a design API?**

Sivi's design API starts with a $1 sandbox (20 credits, 7-day validity). Plans start at $96/month for 800 designs when paid yearly. At scale, that's roughly $0.11 per design, compared to $15+ per banner with manual design at $60/hour. [View full pricing](./api-pricing)

# Sivi - Design Agent Skills

Skills for AI agents to generate production-ready design assets such as ads, social posts, banners, thumbnails, and more using [Sivi](https://sivi.ai)'s Large Design Model (LDM).

### generate-design

Generate design assets from a text prompt. Supports 60+ formats across Instagram, Facebook, Twitter, LinkedIn, Pinterest, YouTube, Display Ads, Amazon, Email, and custom dimensions. Returns multiple variants with preview images and edit links.
    
    
    /generate-design A bold Instagram post announcing 30% off summer collection
    

## Installation
    
    
    npx skills add sivi/skills
    

Works with Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, Windsurf, Cline, and [17+ other AI agents](https://skills.sh/).

## Setup

  1. Get your API key from [sivi.ai](https://sivi.ai)
  2. Add it to `.claude/skills/generate-design/.env`:


    
    
    export SIVI_API_KEY="your-api-key-here"

## Usage

Ask your AI agent:

  * "Create four different Facebook ads. Headline: Refined Sanctuary, Description: Transform your home with KraftHaus Living., Button: Explore Now. Use Logo from <https://media.hellosivi.com/logos/s6FVztpTVjO.svg>. Brand Colors: #CAAB75, #F8F8F8, #000000"
  * "Make a YouTube thumbnail for a cooking tutorial. Use colors red and yellow."
  * "Create a 1200x600 website hero banner for my SaaS landing page. Logo: <https://i.postimg.cc/HLsyY1yQ/334741881-132153419591441-4888262822416491172-n-jpg-stp-dst-jpg-s150x150-tt6-efg-ey-J2ZW5jb2Rl-X3Rh.jpg>"
  * "Design 3 Instagram story ads for a fitness app launch. Headline: Your Journey Starts Here. Colors: #FF6B35, #1A1A2E, #FFFFFF"
  * "Generate a Pinterest pin for a vegan recipe blog. Use a dark theme with colors #2D5016, #F5E6CC, and #FFFFFF"
  * "Create a LinkedIn banner for a tech startup. Headline: Building the Future of AI. Logo: <https://i.postimg.cc/HLsyY1yQ/334741881-132153419591441-4888262822416491172-n-jpg-stp-dst-jpg-s150x150-tt6-efg-ey-J2ZW5jb2Rl-X3Rh.jpg>. Colors: #0A66C2, #FFFFFF, #000000"
  * "Make 2 Amazon product ad variants in square. Title: Premium Wireless Earbuds."
  * "Design an email header image, 600 x 250. Headline: Exclusive Summer Sale. Theme: colorful. Colors: #E91E63, #FFC107, #4CAF50"



### Supported Platforms

Platform | Formats  
---|---  
Instagram | Post, Ad, Story  
Facebook | Post, Ad, Cover  
Twitter / X | Post, Ad, Cover  
LinkedIn | Post, Ad, Cover, Banner  
Pinterest | Pin (small), Standard Pin  
WhatsApp | Post, Wide Post, Status, Business Cover  
YouTube | Thumbnail  
Display Ads | Half-page, Rectangle, Square, Skyscraper, Leaderboard, Banner  
Amazon | Ad, Fullscreen, Square, Rectangle, Standard  
Website | Rectangle, Square, Fullscreen HD, Half-page, Hello Bar  
Email | Square, Tall, Rectangle, Wide, Small  
Custom | Any width × height  
  
### Options

  * **Variants** \- Generate 1–4 design variants per request
  * **Brand colors** \- Pass hex codes for on-brand output
  * **Theme** \- Light, dark, or colorful
  * **Assets** \- Include your own logos and images (public URLs)
  * **Language** \- Generate text in any supported language
  * **Output format** \- JPG or PNG

## Prerequisites

  * Python 3 (pre-installed on macOS and most Linux)
  * curl (pre-installed on macOS, Linux, Git Bash)
  * [Sivi API key](https://sivi.ai)

## About

Skills to generate design assets such as ads, banner, social posts, thumbnails, and more from a natural language prompt, then fetches and displays the generated variants with preview images and edit links. Accepts a prompt/brief, optional dimensions, and optional brand or style info.

# Sivi Claude skill - Generate branded designs inside Claude, Cursor, and more

Use Sivi Claude skill to turn your AI coding assistant into a design agent. Type a prompt, get back layered, editable, on-brand designs. No browser, no design tool, no context switching. This is an open-source agent skill that wraps the Sivi design API. One install. Works across Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, Windsurf, Cline, and 17+ AI agents. You bring your API key. The Claude skill handles the rest: parsing your brief, calling the API, polling for results, and displaying the output inline.

## **How the design agent works**

**Step 1**

#### **Describe your design**

Type a natural language prompt in your AI coding assistant. A simple prompt such as "Instagram post for a summer sale on outdoor furniture" or a detailed one like this: "Create four different Facebook ads. Headline: Refined Sanctuary, Description: Transform your home with KraftHaus Living., Button: Explore Now. Brand Colors: #CAAB75, #F8F8F8, #000000". Use logo from <https://media.hellosivi.com/logos/s6FVztpTVjO.svg>.

**Step 2**

#### **The design agent calls the Sivi API**

The agent skill parses your prompt, selects the right design type and size, and sends the request to the Sivi design API with your API key. You can also specify text message, colors, themes, logos, images, language, and dimensions. The Sivi API uses the Large Design Model and composes the design.

**Step 3**

#### **Get designs inline**

The design agent polls for results and displays the generated design variants directly in your IDE. Each variant includes a preview image and an edit link to the Sivi design studio where you can fine-tune and export. Note that Claude code does not display the image inline.

The designs are also downloaded to your local folder.

One prompt. Multiple design variants. Layered, editable output. A design agent that works where you code. 

One prompt. Multiple design variants. Layered, editable output. A design agent that works where you code.

## **How to install the design agent skill**

#### **One command via skills.sh**

Install the `sivi/skills` design agent with a single command. Works with Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, Windsurf, Cline, and 17+ AI agents.


That's it. Your AI coding assistant is now a design agent.

#### **Clone from GitHub**

Alternatively, clone the repo and set up manually.
    
    
    git clone https://github.com/sivi/skills.git
    
    # Add your Sivi API key
    echo "SIVI_API_KEY=your_api_key_here"
    
    

That's it. Your AI coding assistant is now a design agent.

#### **MCP (Model Context Protocol)**

The skill can be packaged as an MCP server for use with any MCP-compatible client - Claude Desktop, Cursor, Windsurf, and others. See the GitHub repo for MCP setup instructions.

#### **Get your API key**

You need a Sivi API key to use this skill. Sign up at the Sivi web app and get sandbox access.

[Get API Key](https://instant.sivi.ai/#/generate-designs?source=sivi-design-agent-skill)

## **Why a design agent inside your IDE**

Developers, marketers, and founders who work in the terminal or IDE shouldn't have to open a browser, log into a design tool, and context-switch to create a quick banner or social post.

  


This agent skill puts a design agent where you already work. It's the same Sivi API that powers production design pipelines for ecommerce platforms and agencies - just accessed through a conversational interface instead of code.

## Design agent skill FAQ

#### **Is this free?**

The skill itself is open-source and free. You need a Sivi API key to use it. The API sandbox gives you 20 credits for $1 to test with. Production use requires a paid plan. [View API pricing](./api-pricing)

#### **Do I need to know how to code?**

No. The agent skill runs inside your AI coding assistant. You type a natural language prompt. The design agent handles the API call.

#### **Can I use my brand's colors, fonts, and logos?**

Yes. Pass colors as hex codes and logos as URLs directly in your prompt. For full brand kit management (fonts, brand components, style rules), set up a brand kit in the Sivi dashboard and use it via the API.

#### **What AI assistants does this work with?**

Works with Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, Windsurf, Cline, and 17+ AI agents that support skills.sh or MCP.

#### **How is this different from using the API directly?**

It's the same API. The design agent skill is a convenience layer that handles prompt parsing, payload construction, polling, and result display. If you're building an integration, use the API directly. If you want a design agent inside your IDE, use the skill.

#### **Can I modify the skill?**

Yes. It's open-source. Fork it, adapt it to your workflow, add custom defaults, or extend it with new features.

Install the `sivi/skills` design agent and get your API key. First design in under 2 minutes.

`npx skills add sivi/skills`

# What is an AI design generator?

An AI design generator is a tool that creates graphic designs from text input. You describe what you need, such as a social post, a banner, an ad, or a thumbnail, and the tool produces a visual design. The term gets used loosely. Canva calls itself an AI design tool. Midjourney users call it a design generator. Sivi calls itself an AI design generator. But these three produce fundamentally different outputs, and understanding that difference is the single most important thing to know before choosing a tool.

# What is an AI design generator?

An AI design generator is a tool that creates graphic designs from text input. You describe what you need, such as a social post, a banner, an ad, or a thumbnail, and the tool produces a visual design. The term gets used loosely. Canva calls itself an AI design tool. Midjourney users call it a design generator. Sivi calls itself an AI design generator. But these three produce fundamentally different outputs, and understanding that difference is the single most important thing to know before choosing a tool.

## The three categories of AI design tools

#### **Category 1**

### **Template tools with AI features**

These tools have existed for a decade. Their foundation is a library of pre-made templates. Recently, they've added AI features such as auto-suggest layouts, smart resize, AI copywriting, and background removal. But the core mechanic hasn't changed: you start with a template, and you fill it in.

  


**The AI part:** Helps you choose or customize a template faster.  
**The output:** A version of an existing template with your content.  
**Why it works:** Predictable, fast, and familiar.  
**Why it doesn't scale:** Every new layout requires a new template. Creative variety means maintaining a massive template library. Your output inevitably looks like everyone else who uses the same templates.  
**Tools:** Canva, Adobe Express, Visme, Creatopy, Fotor

#### **Category 2**

### **Image generators**

There are over 95,000 image generators available today. They all use diffusion models to generate images from text prompts. Some people use them to create "designs" by prompting for a "social media post about summer sale" or a "banner for tech startup."

  


**The AI part:** Generates entirely new images from text.  
**The output:** A flat raster image in JPG or PNG format. No layers, no editable text, no structure.  
**Why it works:** Visually impressive. Can produce stunning imagery that no template could match.  
**Why it fails at design:** Text is rendered as pixels and is frequently misspelled, garbled, or misplaced. You can't click on a headline and fix it. There's no brand control. If anything is wrong, you regenerate and hope. The output is a picture of a design, not an actual design file.  
**Tools:** 95,000+ options including Nano Banana, Midjourney, Flux, Ideogram, and thousands more.

#### **Category 3**

### **Large Design Models**

This is the newest category. A Large Design Model doesn't fill templates and doesn't generate pixel grids. It composes free-form design layouts. It understands that a design consists of elements such as headlines, body text, CTAs, images, vectors, and backgrounds. It places each one on its own layer with proper hierarchy, spacing, and brand rules.

  


**The AI part:** Composes original, free-form designs from text.  
**The output:** A multi-layered design file. Text is real text. Images and vectors are separate layers. Everything is editable.  
**Why it works:** Combines the creative originality of generative AI with the usability of a design file. You get something new every time, unlike templates, and something editable every time, unlike image generators.  
**Why it matters:** For the first time, AI produces output that works in a professional design workflow without manual reconstruction.  
**Tools:** Sivi

Only the third category actually generates designs. Template tools fill existing layouts. Image generators produce flat pictures. Neither creates a design file. The term "AI design generator" applies accurately only to Large Design Models.

Three categories of AI design tools: template tools add AI to existing templates, image generators create flat pixel images, and Large Design Models compose layered, editable design files. Only LDMs actually generate designs. The others fill templates or produce flat images. 

Three categories of AI design tools: template tools add AI to existing templates, image generators create flat pixel images, and Large Design Models compose layered, editable design files. Only LDMs actually generate designs. The others fill templates or produce flat images.

## The evolution: Templates → Images → Designs

Understanding where these categories came from helps clarify where the industry is heading.

#### **Era 1**

### **Manual design, before the 2010s**

Every design was hand-crafted in Photoshop, Illustrator, or InDesign. High quality, but slow and expensive. Required trained designers.

#### **Era 2**

### **Template tools, 2012 to present**

Canva democratized design by giving non-designers access to pre-made templates. Massive improvement in accessibility. But the trade-off was creative uniformity. Everyone's output started looking the same.

#### **Era 3**

### **Image generators, 2022 to present**

Diffusion models made it possible to generate entirely new visuals from text. The category exploded to over 95,000 tools, with leaders like Nano Banana, Midjourney, Flux, and Ideogram. Breakthrough for art and illustration. But every single one of them produces a flat image, unusable for professional design work where text accuracy, brand compliance, and editability are required.

#### **Era 4**

### **Large Design Models, 2023 to present**

LDMs combine the originality of generative AI with the free-form quality of a design tool. The output isn't a picture of a design. It's an actual design file with layers, real text, and brand enforcement. Sivi pioneered this category with the first LDM in 2023.

  


The pattern is clear: each era solves the previous era's biggest limitation. Templates solved accessibility. Image generators solved creative variety. LDMs solved usability and editability.

Design tools have evolved through four eras: manual design, templates, image generators, and Large Design Models. Each era solved the previous one's biggest limitation. LDMs solve the editability and brand compliance gaps that image generators left open.

Design tools have evolved through four eras: manual design, templates, image generators, and Large Design Models. Each era solved the previous one's biggest limitation. LDMs solve the editability and brand compliance gaps that image generators left open.

## Why the distinction matters for professionals?

If you're a hobbyist making a one-off social post, any of these tools might work. But for professional use by marketing teams, agencies, and businesses producing designs at volume, the category you choose has real consequences.

### **Text accuracy**

Marketing designs live and die by their text. A headline that says "Sumemr Sale" or a CTA that reads "Shpo Now" is worse than no design at all. Image generators render text as pixels, and pixel text is notoriously unreliable. Template tools and LDMs place real text, but LDMs don't require you to build a template first.

### **Brand governance**

When you're producing hundreds of designs for a brand, manual brand checking doesn't scale. Template tools require brand setup per template. Image generators have zero brand awareness. LDMs can enforce a brand kit as a hard constraint on every design generated.

### **Editability**

The first draft is rarely the final one. Can you change the headline? Move the CTA? Swap a product image? Template tools let you edit within constraints. Image generators don't let you edit at all. LDMs give you full element-level control.

### **Production speed at scale**

A marketing team generating 50 ad variations, 10 social posts, and 20 email banners per week needs a tool that scales without proportional manual effort. Templates scale linearly with maintenance effort. LDMs scale without it.

For professional design work, the tool category determines text accuracy, brand governance, editability, and production speed at scale. LDMs are the only category that delivers all four without proportional manual effort.

For professional design work, the tool category determines text accuracy, brand governance, editability, and production speed at scale. LDMs are the only category that delivers all four without proportional manual effort.
