## Frequently Asked Questions

### **What is an AI design generator?**

An AI design generator creates graphic designs from text input. The term covers three distinct technologies: template tools with AI features, image generators, and Large Design Models. Each produces a different type of output with different levels of editability and brand control.

### **Is Canva an AI design generator?**

No. Canva is a template tool with AI features. It uses AI to suggest templates, auto-resize designs, generate copy, and remove backgrounds. But the core workflow is still template based. You choose a pre-made layout and fill it in. The output is a version of an existing template.

### **Is Midjourney an AI design generator?**

No. Midjourney is an image generator. It produces flat raster images from text prompts. People sometimes use it to generate "designs," but the output has no layers, no editable text, and no brand control. It creates a picture of a design, not an actual design file.

### **What is a Large Design Model?**

A [Large Design Model](./large-design-model), or LDM, is a generative AI system that outputs layered, free-form design files rather than flat images. It composes designs element by element, placing text, images, vectors, and backgrounds on separate layers with proper visual hierarchy and brand enforcement. Sivi operates the first dedicated LDM.

### **Can AI replace graphic designers?**

For high-volume production tasks such as bulk social posts, ad variations, banner sets, and email headers, AI design generators, particularly LDMs, can replace manual design work. For strategic creative direction, brand identity development, and custom conceptual work, human designers add irreplaceable value.

### **What is the best AI design generator?**

It depends on your workflow. For predictable, template-based output with manual editing: Canva. For artistic imagery: Nano Banana, Midjourney, Flux, Ideogram, or any of the 95,000+ image generators. For editable, branded design files at scale: Sivi.

### **What's the difference between AI image generators and AI design generators?**

Image generators produce flat raster images with no layers and no editable text. There are over 95,000 of them, from Nano Banana and Midjourney to Flux and Ideogram, and this limitation is true of every single one. AI design generators based on LDMs like Sivi produce free-form, multi-layered design files where every element is individually editable. The first gives you a picture; the second gives you a file you can work with.

# What is an AI ad generator?

# What is an AI ad generator?

# What is an AI ad generator?

# What is an AI ad generator?

An AI ad generator is a tool that designs ad creatives from text input. This could be a product description, a campaign brief, or a simple prompt. Looking for the tool? [Try Sivi's AI ad generator](./generate-ads). You describe what you want to advertise, and the tool produces visual ad creatives. It covers three very different technologies with very different outputs. Understanding the difference is the key to choosing the right tool.

[Try Sivi's AI ad generator](./generate-ads). You describe what you want to advertise, and the tool produces visual ad creatives. It covers three very different technologies with very different outputs. Understanding the difference is the key to choosing the right tool.

[Try Sivi's AI ad generator](./generate-ads). You describe what you want to advertise, and the tool produces visual ad creatives. It covers three very different technologies with very different outputs. Understanding the difference is the key to choosing the right tool.

Updated: 07 May, 2026

An AI ad generator turns text input into ad creatives. There are three types - template-based, image-based, and design-based (LDM). Design-based generators produce editable, on-brand ads at scale.

An AI ad generator turns text input into ad creatives. There are three types - template-based, image-based, and design-based (LDM). Design-based generators produce editable, on-brand ads at scale.

An AI ad generator turns text input into ad creatives. There are three types - template-based, image-based, and design-based (LDM). Design-based generators produce editable, on-brand ads at scale.

## Three types of AI ad generators

## Three types of AI ad generators

  1. ### Template-based ad generators




A template-based ad generator chooses a template, swaps the copy and product images.

  


These tools have been around the longest and produce predictable, clean results. AI features like auto-suggest and smart resize speed things up, but you are always working within the boundaries of a premade layout.

  


**Works well for:** Standardized campaigns with a fixed ad format. If you run the same 300×250 layout every week with new copy, a template is efficient.

  
**Breaks down when:** You need to scale across formats. A Facebook feed ad, a Google display banner, and an Instagram story ad each need their own template. Running a multi-platform campaign means building and maintaining a separate template for every size and every variation.

  
**Examples:** Canva, Creatopy, Visme, Adobe Express

  2. ### **Image-based ad generators**




An image-based AI ad generator uses diffusion models to generate a flat image that looks like an ad. You type a prompt describing your product and offer, and the model predicts what pixels should appear.

  


**Works well for:** Concept exploration and mood boards. When you need visual direction for a campaign, image generators are fast and creative.

  
**Breaks down when:** You move to production. The ad copy is fused into pixels and frequently misspelled. You cannot change a price from "$29" to "$39" without regenerating the entire image. There is no brand enforcement. Every generation is a roll of the dice on whether the text is accurate.

  
**Examples:** Nano Banana, Midjourney with ad-style prompts

  3. ### Design-based ad generators (LDM)




A design-based AI ad generator (Large Design Model) composes each ad as a layered design file where every element, headline, price, CTA, product, background is editable.

  


**Works well for:** Production advertising. When you need dozens of ad variations across multiple sizes with accurate copy and consistent branding, this is the only approach that scales without proportional manual effort.

  
**Falls short for:** Artistic or photographic imagery. For visual concepts that require painterly or photorealistic style, image generators remain the better tool.

  
**Examples:** [**Sivi's AI ad generator**](./generate-ads)

Template ad generators work well for fixed formats but break down across campaigns. Image generators produce striking visuals but unusable ad copy. Design-based generators produce editable, branded ad creatives that scale across formats and campaigns. 

Template ad generators work well for fixed formats but break down across campaigns. Image generators produce striking visuals but unusable ad copy. Design-based generators produce editable, branded ad creatives that scale across formats and campaigns. 

Template ad generators work well for fixed formats but break down across campaigns. Image generators produce striking visuals but unusable ad copy. Design-based generators produce editable, branded ad creatives that scale across formats and campaigns. 

## How AI ad generators actually work?

The mechanics differ by type, but here's the general flow:

  


**Input:** You provide a text prompt like "Summer sale banner for running shoes", structured content such as headline, CTA, and product URL, or a combination. Some tools also accept brand assets like logos, colors, and fonts.

  


**Processing:**

  * Template generators match your content to a pre-made layout and slot it in.

  * Image generators run your prompt through a diffusion model that predicts pixel arrangements.

  * Design generators (LDMs) analyze your content, compose an appropriate layout, place each element on its own layer, and apply brand rules.




  


**Output:** The tool returns a visual. What matters is what kind of visual:

  * A template fill with limited editing and a fixed layout?

  * A flat image with no editing and no text accuracy guarantee?

  * A layered design with full editing, accurate text, and brand enforcement?




AI ad generators process your text input through templates, diffusion models, or design composition. The output type, whether a filled template, a flat image, or a layered design file, determines whether you can edit, resize, and control branding in the result. 

AI ad generators process your text input through templates, diffusion models, or design composition. The output type, whether a filled template, a flat image, or a layered design file, determines whether you can edit, resize, and control branding in the result. 

AI ad generators process your text input through templates, diffusion models, or design composition. The output type, whether a filled template, a flat image, or a layered design file, determines whether you can edit, resize, and control branding in the result. 

## What makes a good AI ad generator?

Not all AI ad generators are equal. Here is what to evaluate for production advertising.

### **Ad copy precision**

Every word in an ad affects performance. A misspelled headline kills credibility. A wrong price creates liability. The tool must produce accurate text that you can verify and correct after generation, not text baked into pixels that you cannot touch.

### **Campaign iteration speed**

Offers change. A/B tests reveal winners. A new product drops in the middle of a campaign. The tool should let you update any element without starting over. Change the CTA, swap the product shot, adjust the price, and export a new version in seconds.

### **Variation generation for testing**

Effective ad campaigns test multiple creatives simultaneously. The tool should produce distinct layout variations from the same brief so you can identify which performs best, without manually designing each version.

### **Consistent branding**

When a campaign spans dozens of ad units across platforms, every creative must use the same brand assets. Manual checking does not scale at campaign velocity. Automatic brand enforcement does.

### **Multi-format generation**

A single campaign might target Google Display, Facebook feed, Instagram stories, and LinkedIn. Each platform has different size requirements and content expectations. The tool should produce appropriate ad layouts for each platform from one brief, not force a separate workflow for each format.

A good AI ad generator delivers accurate ad copy, fast campaign iteration, multi-format generation from one brief, variation testing, and consistent branding across all creatives automatically.

## When to use which type of AI ad generator?

**Use a template-based tool when:**

  * You need a specific, pixel-perfect layout every single time

  * You have a small number of ad formats and don't need variety

  * Your team has time to build and maintain templates




**Use an image-based tool when:**

  * You need artistic or photographic imagery for inspiration

  * Text accuracy does not matter, or you will add text manually later

  * You're exploring concepts, not producing final ads




**Use a design-based tool when:**

  * You need production-ready ads with accurate, editable text

  * Your brand guidelines must be enforced automatically

  * You need ads in multiple sizes without starting over

  * You're producing at volume and can't maintain templates for every variation

## Which AI ad generator should you use?

A quick decision path for production advertising.

### **Do you need editable, accurate ad copy in your output?**

If yes, skip image generators. Their text is baked into pixels and often wrong.

### **Do you run ads across multiple platforms and sizes?**

If yes, skip single-template tools. Maintaining a separate template per size does not scale.

### **Do you need brand consistency without manual checking on every ad?**

If yes, you need a tool with automatic brand kit enforcement, not a tool that requires you to apply brand assets manually.

### **Is your team small, or is your ad volume high?**

If yes, you need speed at scale. Template tools and manual design do not fit.

If you answered yes to all four, you need a design-based AI ad generator. [**Try Sivi's free AI ad generator**](./generate-ads).

Choose a design-based AI ad generator if you need accurate editable text, multi-format output, automatic brand enforcement, and production speed. Template tools suit fixed layouts. Image generators suit concept exploration.

## The shift from "generating images" to "generating ad designs"

The first wave of AI ad tools focused on generating _images_ of ads. This was a breakthrough. For the first time, anyone could create ad visuals from a text prompt.

  


But marketing teams quickly discovered the limitations. The headline is misspelled. The price can't be changed. The brand colors are wrong. The output looks like an ad but doesn't function like one.

  


The second wave focuses on generating _designs_ , meaning free-form, layered files where text is text, images are images, and everything is editable. This is what Large Design Models do. They don't predict pixels; they compose free-form design layouts. See how [Sivi's design-based AI ad generator](./generate-ads) does it.

  


For businesses that need to ship real ads, not just pictures of ads, this distinction is everything.

The industry is shifting from generating images of ads to generating actual ad designs. Large Design Models produce free-form, layered files with editable text and brand enforcement, not flat pictures that look like ads but cannot function as them. 

The industry is shifting from generating images of ads to generating actual ad designs. Large Design Models produce free-form, layered files with editable text and brand enforcement, not flat pictures that look like ads but cannot function as them. 

The industry is shifting from generating images of ads to generating actual ad designs. Large Design Models produce free-form, layered files with editable text and brand enforcement, not flat pictures that look like ads but cannot function as them. 

## How to use an AI ad generator for each platform?

Different ad platforms have different format requirements. A good AI ad generator handles these with correct dimensions, visual hierarchy, and platform-appropriate layouts.

### **Facebook and Instagram ads**

Specify feed dimensions such as 1080×1080 and story dimensions at 1080×1920. Provide your product, offer, and CTA. A design-based generator places your copy with proper hierarchy and applies your brand kit automatically. Generate feed, story, and carousel formats from one brief.

### **Google Display ads**

All standard IAB sizes apply here, including 300×250, 728×90, 160×600, and 300×600. Design-based generators re-compose the layout for each dimension rather than scaling one image. This means your 728×90 leaderboard and your 300×600 half-page both look deliberate, not stretched.

### **LinkedIn ads**

Single image ads use 1200×627. Professional tone, clear value proposition, and minimal visual clutter work best. Sivi generates LinkedIn-appropriate layouts with editable headline, description, and CTA.

### **Google Shopping and retargeting**

Product-focused ads need clean product shots, price, and an offer. Design-based generators compose these with the product image prominent and price as editable text you can update mid-campaign.

### **X/Twitter ads**

Standard image ad uses 1200×628 or square 1080×1080. Short copy, high-contrast visuals, and clear CTAs perform best.

AI ad generators produce platform-specific ads when you supply the correct dimensions and content. Design-based tools re-compose layouts for each size and keep text editable across every format. 

AI ad generators produce platform-specific ads when you supply the correct dimensions and content. Design-based tools re-compose layouts for each size and keep text editable across every format. 

AI ad generators produce platform-specific ads when you supply the correct dimensions and content. Design-based tools re-compose layouts for each size and keep text editable across every format. 

## Frequently Asked Questions

### **Can AI generate ad creatives?**

Yes. AI can generate ad creatives across all three approaches: template-based, image-based, and design-based. The quality and usability of the output depends on which approach you use. Design-based generators produce the most usable output for production marketing.

### **What is the best AI ad generator?**

It depends on your needs. For fixed-layout production, Canva or Creatopy work well as template-based tools. . For artistic exploration, Nano Banana is an effective image-based tool. For editable, branded ad designs at scale, Sivi is a design-based Large Design Model.

  * Template tools are cost-effective, but, lack uniqueness.

  * Image generators produces stunning image ads, but, cannot edit artifacts. 

  * Design models are perfect for instant static ads, but unsuitable for videos.




### **Are ads from an AI ad generator effective?**

AI-generated ads perform comparably to manually designed ads when the output quality matches. This means accurate text, proper brand application, and appropriate visual hierarchy. The advantage of AI is speed and volume: generate dozens of variations for A/B testing in the time it takes to manually produce one.

### **Is there a free AI ad generator?**

Most tools offer free tiers. Canva has a generous free plan and is template-based. Sivi offers free plan - see [Sivi's AI ad generator](./generate-ads). Free image-based generators exist but typically have quality or resolution limits.

### **How much does an AI ad generator cost?**

Free plans exist across all three types. Paid plans typically run from $10 to $500 per month depending on volume and features.

### **Can AI ad generators replace designers?**

No. They replace the repetitive composition work, such as resizing, applying brand colors, and assembling layouts. Strategy, creative concept, and high-touch brand work still need human judgment. Most teams use AI ad generators to scale the output of their designers, not to remove them.

### **Are AI-generated ads copyright-free for commercial use?**

It depends on the tool. Most design-based and template-based generators, including Sivi, allow commercial use of the generated ads. Always check the specific tool's terms. Note that stock assets used inside the ad may have their own license terms.

### **What's the difference between an AI ad generator and an AI image generator?**

An AI image generator outputs a flat picture. An AI ad generator outputs a free-form ad with editable text, defined layouts, and brand compliance. Image generators suit artistic work. Ad generators suit production advertising.

### **Can AI make Google Display ads?**

Yes. Design-based generators can produce all standard IAB display sizes like 300×250, 728×90, 160×600, and 300×600 with layout re-composition for each dimension. This is significantly faster than creating separate templates for each size.

# What is an AI banner generator?

An AI banner generator creates banner designs from text input. You describe what the banner should communicate. A product launch, a sale, an event, a brand message. The tool produces a visual banner ready for use on websites, social media, email, or advertising platforms. Banners are everywhere: website hero sections, email headers, display ad placements, social media covers, ecommerce category pages, event promotions. They're also the most repetitive design task in marketing. Same brand, same general layout, different content every week. That repetition is exactly where AI banner generation becomes valuable.

## How AI banner generators work?

The core flow across all types:

#### **Step 1**

### **You provide input.**

A text prompt like "Back to school sale, 30% off all supplies", structured content such as a headline, CTA, and product images, or a URL to extract content from.

#### **Step 2**

### **The tool generates a banner.**

The AI selects a layout, arranges visual elements, applies text, and produces output. How it does this, and what it produces, varies dramatically by the type of the tool you use.

#### **Step 3**

### **You use or edit the output.**

Depending on the tool, you either export a finished file, edit within template constraints, or have full element level control.

You provide text describing your banner content. The AI generates a design. Depending on the tool type, the output is a filled template, a flat image, or a layered design file with full element level editing.

## Three types of AI banner generators

### **Template-based**

You pick a banner template from a library. A website hero template, an email header template, a social media cover template. You swap in your text and images, choose your colors, and export. Some tools use AI to suggest templates or auto-fill fields, but the final output is always a variation of the original template.

  


The practical issue: every banner placement needs its own template. A 1920×600 hero, a 600×200 email header, and a 300×250 display ad are three separate templates to build and maintain. Multiply that by campaigns, and the template library grows faster than your team can manage.

  


**Examples:** Canva, Creatopy, Visme, Fotor

  


### **Image-based**

You type a prompt like "promotional banner for summer clearance sale" and a diffusion model generates a flat image. The result might look like a banner, but the text is baked into the pixels. If the headline reads "Summre Clearrance," you regenerate and hope the next attempt is better.

  


The practical issue: you cannot fix a single word without regenerating the entire image. You cannot resize it for a different placement without getting a completely different result. And the tool has no concept of your brand colors, fonts, or logo.

  


**Examples:** DALL-E, Midjourney, Adobe Firefly

  


### **Design-based LDM**

A Large Design Model reads your content and composes the banner from individual elements. The headline is placed as real text. The product image sits on its own layer. The CTA is a separate, clickable element. Your brand kit constrains the colors, fonts, and logo placement from the start.

  


The practical advantage: one content brief produces banners for every placement. The model recomposes the layout for each size. And because every element is independent, you can update the headline without touching anything else.

  


**Examples:** Sivi

Template tools require a separate template for every banner placement. Image generators produce flat pictures you cannot edit or resize. Design-based generators, or LDMs, compose layered banner designs from a brief for every placement and size.

Template tools require a separate template for every banner placement. Image generators produce flat pictures you cannot edit or resize. Design-based generators, or LDMs, compose layered banner designs from a brief for every placement and size.

## Banner types you can generate with AI

### **Website banners**

Hero images, promotional banners, announcement bars, blog covers. [Website banners](./usecases/website-content-generator) need to work across screen sizes and load fast. Design-based generators can produce these in exact pixel dimensions with proper content hierarchy.

### **Email banners**

[Email headers](./usecases/email-hero-images-generator), newsletter graphics, promotional [email banners](./usecases/email-banner-maker), email signatures. Email rendering is notoriously finicky. HTML export from a design generator ensures the banner displays correctly across email clients.

### **Display ad banners**

Google Display Network, programmatic ad placements, retargeting campaigns. Standard IAB sizes like 300×250, 728×90, 160×600, 300×600, and 320×50 with layout recomposed for each dimension.

### **Social media banners**

Facebook cover photos, [LinkedIn banners](./usecases/linkedin-profile-banner-generator), Twitter/X headers, YouTube channel art. Each platform has different dimensions and content guidelines. [AI banner generators](./generate-banner) can produce platform specific versions from a single content brief.

### **Ecommerce banners**

Product promotion banners, [category headers](./usecases/category-banner-generator), sale announcements, [Amazon A+ content](./usecases/amazon-a-plus-content-generator). High volume banner production for catalogs with hundreds or thousands of products.

### **Event banners**

[Conference banners](./generate/conference-banner), webinar promotions, trade show displays, workshop announcements. Time sensitive content that needs fast turnaround.

AI banner generators produce website heroes, email headers, social media covers, display ads in IAB sizes, ecommerce banners, and event graphics. Design-based generators create all formats from a single content brief.

## When to use an AI banner generator?

An AI banner generator makes sense when:

  * **Volume is high.** You're producing banners weekly or daily for websites, email campaigns, social media, or ad placements.



  * **Brand consistency matters.** Every banner needs to use the correct colors, fonts, and logo placement without manual checking.

  * **You need multiple sizes.** The same banner content needs to exist as a 1920×600 hero image, a 600×200 email header, and a 300×250 display ad.

  * **Content changes frequently.** New promotions, seasonal campaigns, product launches. The visual layout stays consistent but the content keeps changing.

  * **Your team isn't designers.** Marketers, business owners, and content creators need to produce professional banners without learning design software.




Use an AI banner generator when banner volume is high, brand consistency matters, you need multiple sizes from one brief, content changes frequently, or your team lacks dedicated designers.

Use an AI banner generator when banner volume is high, brand consistency matters, you need multiple sizes from one brief, content changes frequently, or your team lacks dedicated designers.

Use an AI banner generator when banner volume is high, brand consistency matters, you need multiple sizes from one brief, content changes frequently, or your team lacks dedicated designers.

## What makes a good AI banner generator?

### **Cross-platform consistency**

A single campaign might need a website hero, an email header, a LinkedIn cover, and a set of display ads. A good banner generator maintains visual consistency across all these formats. Same message, same brand feel, different layout composed for each placement.

### **Content refresh speed**

Banners change often. A new promotion, a seasonal update, a product launch. The tool should let you update content without rebuilding the entire banner. Change the offer from "20% off" to "30% off" and export, rather than starting from scratch each time.

### **Text accuracy at every size**

Banner text must be legible at 728×90 and prominent at 1920×600. The tool needs to handle text scaling intelligently, not just shrink everything proportionally. Headlines that work at large sizes often need different placement or sizing at small dimensions.

### **Brand enforcement across volume**

When your team produces dozens of banners per week, manual brand checking falls apart. The right tool applies your exact hex codes, fonts, and logo placement automatically, across every banner, every time.

A good AI banner generator maintains visual consistency across platforms, lets you update content without rebuilding, scales text intelligently across sizes, and enforces brand rules automatically at production volume. 

A good AI banner generator maintains visual consistency across platforms, lets you update content without rebuilding, scales text intelligently across sizes, and enforces brand rules automatically at production volume. 

A good AI banner generator maintains visual consistency across platforms, lets you update content without rebuilding, scales text intelligently across sizes, and enforces brand rules automatically at production volume. 

## Frequently Asked Questions About AI Banner Generators

### **What is an AI banner generator?**

An AI banner generator is a tool that creates banner designs from text input. Depending on the tool type, the output ranges from a filled template to a flat image to a fully editable, layered design file.

### **How to create banners with AI?**

Describe your banner content, including what you are promoting, the headline, and the CTA. Choose your dimensions. An AI banner generator like Sivi composes the banner with appropriate layout, text placement, and brand assets. Edit any element, then export.

### **Can AI generate banners in different sizes?**

Template tools require a separate template per size. Image generators produce fixed ratio images. Design-based generators, or LDMs, recompose the layout for each dimension. This means generating a 728×90 leaderboard and a 300×600 half page ad from the same content.

### **Is there a free AI banner generator?**

Most tools offer free tiers. Canva's free plan includes template-based banner creation. Sivi offers free banner generation with its design-based approach. Layered, editable output.

### **What is the best AI banner generator for marketing?**

For production marketing where text accuracy, brand compliance, and editability matter, design-based generators like Sivi produce the most usable output. For quick one off banners with predictable layouts, template tools work well.

### **Can I make banners in multiple languages with AI?**

Template tools require manual text replacement per language. Image generators are mostly English centric. Sivi supports 72+ languages and recomposes the banner layout for each language, including RTL scripts.

### **How is an AI banner generator different from an AI image generator?**

An image generator produces a flat picture of a banner. No layers, no editable text, no brand control. A design-based AI banner generator produces a layered design file where every element is editable and brand rules are enforced.

# AI design: generate editable designs, not flat images

Every AI design tool in this space either fills a template or generates a flat image. Sivi does neither. The Large Design Model composes designs element by element, including text, vectors, images, and backgrounds, each on its own layer. The output is a design file you can edit, not a picture you can only stare at.

## Where AI designs are used?

With the rise of artificial intelligence (AI), most of the design template tools use them to generate text and images and replace them with content on pre-made generic design templates.

  


AI design is template-free visual content such as display ads, social media posts, and product banners, generated for user text, brand assets, and guidelines. Not the other way around, generating content to fit the existing design template.

  


The AI designs by Sivi are unique, differentiating from design template replacement tools including Canva, Adobe Express, and Microsoft Designer in multiple ways.

The distinction matters. If you need to change a headline after generation, template tools let you, but only within that template’s slots. Image generators don't let you at all. Sivi gives you full control over every element because every element is an independent layer. For a detailed breakdown of all three categories, see [**what an AI design generator is**](./what-is-ai-design-generator).

#### Custom dimensions

#### Multiple variations

Generate diverse design variations within minutes to find your perfect match. Still not sure, A/B test them to find the match made in heaven.

#### Multi-language support

Go global with visuals that directly speak to your audience in their language.

#### Brand consistency

#### Content generator

#### Design editor

#### Enhance

#### Content snippets

## How to generate designs with AI?

Here’s how you can use generative AI for graphic design.

  1. Get started with Sivi by clicking on ‘Generate designs now’ and signing up.

  2. Provide your purpose and dimensions of the design.

  3. Generate content with a prompt. Or add your content directly to the content editor.

  4. Add assets including the images, logo, brand colors, etc.

  5. Hit Generate and watch your ideas turn into designs, generated just for you.

  6. Tap on a design to edit it. Make changes, generate variations, and download them in just a few clicks.

## Most asked questions about AI design

#### **Can AI generate design?**

Yes, specialized AI design models can generate graphic designs. Sivi's Large Design Model generates multi-layered editable designs for user-provided content, brand assets, and preferences.

#### **Is Sivi free?**

Yes. You can get started with Sivi for free. You get real layered design files, not watermarked images or limited-feature templates. See the pricing page for details on paid plans.

#### **How is Sivi different from other AI design tools?**

With layered design generation and free-form design datasets, Sivi follows atomic design principles to compose editable designs from scratch, fundamentally [**different from other generative AI design tools**](https://sivi.ai/blog/generative-ai-for-graphic-design-sivi-cole-deepfloyd-sdxl-dall-e3).

#### **Will AI design replace human designs?**

While AI designs enhance human productivity, it cannot entirely replace human creativity, judgment, and the ability to understand nuance.

#### **Is AI design right for me?**

AI design is valuable for businesses of all sizes, from startups to SMBs to large enterprises. Sivi’s [**AI design generator**](./tour/ai-design-generator) can streamline your design workflow, boost creativity, and scale your visuals.

#### **Can I use AI to generate designs for social media?**

Yes. Sivi generates designs for Instagram, Facebook, LinkedIn, Twitter/X, Pinterest, and more, in platform-specific dimensions with appropriate visual hierarchy for each platform.

#### **How does Sivi compare to Canva?**

Canva is a template-based tool. You pick a pre-made layout and fill in your content. Sivi generates original layouts from scratch. Every design is unique. The output is a layered file where everything is editable, not constrained to template slots. For teams that need variety at scale without maintaining hundreds of templates, Sivi is a fundamentally different approach.

## Real layered ad creatives, not flat images

Ad creatives have one job - drive clicks and conversions. A flat image with garbled text or an uneditable price does not do that job. When the CTA says "Shp Now" or the discount reads "30$ off" instead of "$30 off," the ad fails before it runs.

  
Sivi's [Large Design Model (LDM)](./large-design-model) composes each ad as a layered design file. Every element exists on its own layer, from the headline and price to the CTA, product image, and background. You can verify, edit, and iterate without regenerating.

  


  * **Accurate ad copy.** Every headline, price point, and CTA is placed as real, editable text. No pixel guessing.

  * **Mid-campaign edits.** The offer changed from 20% to 30%? Update the text and re-export. The layout stays intact.

  * **Multi-format from one brief.** Generate a 300×250 display ad, a 1080×1080 Instagram square, and a 1080×1920 story from the same content.

  * **Brand kit enforced.** Your colors, fonts, and logo applied as constraints, not suggestions. Consistent across every ad unit.




[Generate Editable Ads](https://instant.sivi.ai/#/generate-designs?source=sivi-generate-ads)

The fix we kept hearing customers ask for: editable text, swappable images, and adjustable hierarchy without re-prompting. Flat outputs don't survive a brand or compliance review. The [IAB research from early 2026](https://www.iab.com/insights/the-ai-gap-widens/) says AI ad generators have rapidly shifted from experimental to essential tools for marketing teams, with 83% of ad executives reporting that their company has deployed AI in the creative process in 2026, up from 60% in 2024.

## Your questions about the AI ad generator, answered

### **What is an AI ad generator?**

An AI ad generator turns your campaign idea, product details, or offers into unique ads for your brand. Sivi's AI ad generator uses a Large Design Model (LDM) that composes each ad as a layered design file, every element (headline, price, CTA, product image, background) sits on its own editable layer with real text, not pixels.. You can verify the copy, adjust the offer, swap the image, and export to JPG, PNG, PDF, or HTML. More about [what an AI ad generator is, its types, and how it works](./what-is-ai-ad-generator).

### **How does an AI ad creator work?**

The AI ad generator understands your content, target audience, design style, and brand guidelines, then generates template-free ad creatives. It analyses each element and composes them into a cohesive ad layout. Once the composition is complete, it adds colors to it. Finally, it exports the ad in your desired format - JPG, PNG, HTML, PDF.

### **What types of AI ads can I generate with Sivi?**

From display ads to social media ads, you can generate banner ads for numerous platforms and ad sizes, including custom dimensions. Note: Sivi does not support video ads at the moment.

### **How to create ads with AI?**

Type a prompt describing your product and offer, or paste your ad content. Sivi's LDM composes the ad with appropriate layout, text placement, and visual hierarchy. Edit any element, then export.

### **Can I create ads in my language?**

Yes, you can create ads with Sivi in 72+ global languages. You can generate or type your ad copy in your preferred language.

### **Can I create ad copies with Sivi for my brand?**

Yes, Sivi's agent helps you write ad copies for your prompt aligned with your brand's tone and identity. You can also edit the generated ad copies before generating the ad creatives.

### **Can I edit the generated ads?**

Yes. Sivi's AI ad creator outputs layered designs, so every element is editable. Add your text, brand assets, and other preferences to get ad designs specific to your requirements. From fonts to colors, every ad can be further customized within the design studio.

### **What is the best AI ad generator in 2026?**

There are design models, many template tools, and [**AI wrappers**](./blog/most-ai-design-tools-are-ai-wrappers) in the market that generate ads. The [**best AI ad generator**](./blog/best-ai-ad-generators-2026) depends on your output need. 

  * Editable, brand-consistent ad designs at scale: Sivi (design-based, Large Design Model).

  * Artistic / illustrative ad imagery: Midjourney, Nano Banana (image-based).

  * Template-driven social posts: Canva, Adobe Express (template-based).

  * Multi-image-model wrapper: AdCreative AI




### **How much does it cost to create an AI ad with Sivi?**

For small and medium ad sizes, it costs one credit per ad. Larger sizes cost 1.5 credits. You get 12 AI credits every month with the Free plan. The paid plan with more credits starts at $16/month. Check out [**Sivi pricing**](./pricing) for more details.

### **Is the AI ad generator free?**

Yes. You get 12 free credits on signup, enough for 12 small or medium ads. No credit card, no watermarks, and commercial use is allowed on the free plan. Upgrade only if you need more credits.

### **Do I need a credit card to sign up?**

No. Free plan activates immediately with no payment details. Add a card only when you decide to upgrade.

### **Are free AI ad makers effective?**

For testing creative directions, small campaigns, and validating a concept, yes. Sivi's free tier gives full feature access rather than a stripped-down preview, so what you generate for free is production-ready.

### **Can AI-generated ads be used commercially?**

Yes, Sivi-generated ads can be used in paid advertising on platforms such as Meta, Google, LinkedIn, and TikTok. This applies to the free plan too.

### **Can I generate ads in platform-specific sizes?**

Yes. Sivi supports all [**IAB standard ad unit portfolio display sizes**](https://iabtechlab.com/standards/iab-new-ad-portfolio-guidelines/) including 300×250, 728×90, 160×600, and 300×600, Facebook (1200×628), Instagram (1080×1080, 1080×1920), LinkedIn (1200×627), and any custom dimension.

### [Design AI](./design-ai)

#### AI designs for every format.

Ad teams rarely stop at ads. The same brand kit usually has to create a website banner the same week, a Reels cover the day after, and a podcast cover the week after that. Cross-format velocity is what makes a unified design engine pay for itself.

## Built by a team that ships ads

Sivi is the Large Design Model (LDM) for brands. We've helped 176,000+ brands generate ad creatives across 72+ languages. When we describe how ad generators work and where they break, it comes from building one.

Sivi's design engine doesn't predict pixels like an image generator. It composes ad layouts with real text, real brand constraints, and real layer control. That's why Sivi ads can ship as-is to Meta Ads Manager, Google Ads, or LinkedIn Campaign Manager without the usual AI-output cleanup.

Sivi AI ad creator uses the Large Design Model (LDM) for on-brand ads. Built by a team of designers and engineers who ship ads.

## What is an AI banner generator?

An AI banner generator is a tool that creates banner designs from text input: a product launch, a sale, an event, a brand message and produces a visual banner ready for websites, social media, email, or ad placements. But not all AI banner generators work the same way.

  


Template-based banner makers such as Canva fill pre-made layouts. Image generators like Nano Banana 2, GPT Image 2, Seedream 4.0 produce flat pictures with baked-in text. A design-based AI banner creator like Sivi generates layered, editable banner designs from scratch using a Large Design Model, where every element exists on its own layer and can be changed after generation.

  


The difference matters when you need AI generated banners you can actually edit, resize, and brand-match for production use.

[Generate AI Banners](https://instant.sivi.ai/#/generate-designs?source=sivi-generate-banner)

The common mix-up: people expect a banner generator to work like Midjourney. It doesn't. A banner needs accurate text, layout hierarchy, and a precise aspect ratio, none of which image models reliably deliver.

The common mix-up: people expect a banner generator to work like Midjourney. It doesn't. A banner needs accurate text, layout hierarchy, and a precise aspect ratio, none of which image models reliably deliver.

## How to generate banners with the free AI banner maker?

Here’s how you can generate AI banners with the banner generator.

#### 1

### Enter your banner brief

Type a prompt with your message, offer, and audience. Or paste structured content - headline, body, CTA, product URL. Sivi extracts what it needs.

  


#### 2

### The LDM composes the banner

The Large Design Model selects a layout, places your text as editable elements, positions images, and applies your brand kit. Every element is composed individually, not rendered as a pixel blob.

  


#### 3

### Edit and export

Click any element to edit. Change the headline, swap the product image, adjust the CTA. Export as JPG, PNG, PDF, or HTML. Download individual banners or bulk export the full set.

## Common questions about Sivi's AI banner generator

### **Can I customize the AI banners after generating them?**

Yes. You can edit the text, add or remove layers, change the gradient, and do all the actions you can with any other design tool. Every AI-generated banner is fully editable.

### **What is the best AI banner generator in 2026?**

For high volume such as 5 to 50 banners across multiple sizes and campaigns, Sivi is the best free AI banner generator because it composes editable, on-brand banner sets from one brief. For under 5 banners a month, a template tool like Canva is enough. For rule-based automation, Bannerbear's API is purpose-built.

### **How many AI banners can I generate for free?**

With the free plan, you can generate up to 12 AI banners per month. For more information, you can refer to our [pricing](./pricing) page.

### **What are the standard banner sizes?**

The standard IAB display banner sizes are: Leaderboard (728 x 90), Medium Rectangle (300 x 250), Wide Skyscraper (160 x 600), Half Page (300 x 600), Large Mobile Banner (320 x 100), Billboard (970 x 250), and Mobile Leaderboard (320 x 50). For social, common sizes include Facebook cover (820 x 312), LinkedIn banner (1584 x 396), and Twitter header (1500 x 500). Sivi generates banners at all standard sizes and any custom dimension.

### **How many banner variations does Sivi generate per prompt?**

Sivi generates 2 to 4 design variations from a single prompt. Each variation has a different layout and composition, so you can A/B test which performs best. You can also use the enhancer in the design editor to create more style variations for each banner.

### **Can I upload my own images and logos to the AI banner generator?**

Yes. Upload product photos, logos, icons, and illustrations. Sivi removes backgrounds from product images automatically and composes them into the banner layout. You can also choose from the built-in stock library.

### **How accurate is the text in AI-generated banners?**

Pixel-perfect. Sivi renders banner text as real, editable text layers using real fonts, not as part of a generated image. You can upload your fonts as well. There are no misspellings, no garbled letters, and no truncation when headlines run long. You can edit any word after generation without re-prompting, which is the core reason banner production teams use AI banner generators over [AI image generators](./tour/ai-image-generator).

### **Are AI generated banners copyright free?**

Yes. The AI-generated banners created with Sivi are copyright-free. You can use them for both personal and commercial projects. Just ensure any external content you upload (images, logos, fonts) is properly licensed for your intended use.

### **Can I use the AI banner generator for client work?**

Yes. Banners generated with Sivi are commercially usable on both the free and paid plans. Agencies and freelancers use Sivi to deliver banner sets across multiple clients with separate brand kits per account. Sivi also supports brand kit isolation so one client's logo and fonts never bleed into another client's banners.

### **What export formats does the AI banner generator support?**

Export as JPG, PNG, PDF, or HTML. JPG and PNG for direct use. PDF for print-ready output. HTML for email banners and web placements.

### **How is Sivi different from the other template banner makers?**

Most template tools use AI to swap text and images inside pre-made templates. Sivi's AI banner generator creates each design from scratch based on your content, so every banner is unique to your brand.

## Frequently asked questions

#### **How can I generate branded social media banners?**

You can add your brand colors, fonts, logos, and button styles to the Brand Kit. Sivi will use your brand elements to ensure a consistent look across all social media posts.

#### **Can I edit the AI social media designs?**

Yes. Unlike AI tools that generate uneditable images, Sivi generates layered, editable designs that can be customized with the built-in design editor.

#### **Can I generate posts in different languages?**

Yes! Sivi AI supports over [72+ languages](https://support.sivi.ai/generate-your-first-design/languages), helping you reach a global audience effortlessly.

#### **Do the social media posts generated in the free plan include watermarks?**

No. All of your AI social media posts generated with Sivi will be free from watermarks, regardless of your pricing plan. Paid plans offer additional benefits like more credits, dimensions, and storage.

#### **How quickly can I create social media posts?**

You can create social media posts in seconds. Enter your prompt, and Sivi will instantly generate copy, images, and designs.

## What is a WhatsApp status?

A WhatsApp status is a temporary post on WhatsApp that disappears after 24 hours. It allows users to share updates, promotions, or moments with their audience.

  


For businesses, WhatsApp status is a powerful tool to promote products, highlight offers, and engage customers. However, designing a unique status from scratch or WhatsApp status templates demands time and design expertise.

## How to post images on WhatsApp status

## How to post images on WhatsApp status

  1. Open WhatsApp and head to the Status tab.

  


  2. Tap the camera to take a new photo, or select Sivi-generated images from your gallery using the photo icon.

  


  3. Add text, stickers, drawings, or a caption to personalize your image.

  


  4. Choose who can view your status, then click send to post your image on WhatsApp.

## Frequently asked questions

#### **How to create image WhatsApp statuses quickly for daily promotions?**

Sivi AI generates ready-to-post WhatsApp statuses in seconds. Just type a short prompt, choose a dimension, and Sivi instantly designs multiple options, saving hours of manual work.

#### **How to use WhatsApp status maker without AI design skills?**

Sivi’s AI understands layout, typography, and colour balance. You only describe your idea, and Sivi turns it into a visually professional WhatsApp status that looks designer-made.

#### **How to make WhatsApp statuses fit perfectly without cropping or quality loss?**

Sivi automatically designs in the ideal 1080×1920 pixel (9:16) ratio used by WhatsApp. Every output is optimised for clarity and fit, so no part of your message is cropped.

#### **Will the designs generated by WhatsApp status maker match my brand colours and logo?**

Sivi’s brand kit set-up lets you upload your logo, fonts, and colours once. Every design you generate automatically uses your brand elements, keeping all your statuses consistent.

#### **How to make WhatsApp statuses in regional or multiple languages?**

Sivi supports 72+ languages, allowing you to create WhatsApp statuses for any audience instantly without switching tools. Perfect for multilingual marketing campaigns.

#### **How to improve engagement with AI-designed WhatsApp statuses?**

Sivi’s design intelligence focuses on visual balance, contrast, and readability, helping you create scroll-stopping WhatsApp statuses that capture attention instantly.

## What is a WhatsApp business banner?

WhatsApp business banners are business cover photos and marketing designs displayed to WhatsApp users.

  


WhatsApp banner designs are integrated into business messages to promote brands, products, or services on the platform.

  


Designing custom WhatsApp posters can enhance ROI for WhatsApp businesses, but consistently creating unique designs can demand a lot of time and expertise.

## How to do WhatsApp business marketing with Images

In 3 ways: WhatsApp Catalog, WhatsApp Ads, and WhatsApp Broadcast.

  


  1. To broadcast, open your WhatsApp Business app and tap the three-dot icon to choose "New Broadcast."

  


  2. Select the contacts you want to include in your broadcast list.

  


  3. Tap the ‘+’ icon to attach a Sivi-generated image related to your product or service.

  


  4. Add a short, engaging message and hit send to deliver your image-based WhatsApp business promotion to to all selected contacts.

## Frequently asked questions

#### **What’s the best size for a WhatsApp banner?**

The best WhatsApp banner size depends on where you use it: 1080×1920 px for status, 1211×681 px for business cover photos, and around 800×800 px for messages to avoid cropping. Sivi automatically generates banners in these proportions, so no manual resizing is needed.

#### **Can I include my brand logo and colours in a WhatsApp banner?**

Yes. One-time setup of brand kit in Sivi allows you to use your logo, colours, and fonts for every banner automatically.

#### **Do Sivi-generated WhatsApp banners support custom messages or seasonal offers?**

Yes. The WhatsApp banner generator Sivi AI lets you type in any message or offer and instantly generates banners suited to your theme, festival, sale, or announcement.

#### **Can I download WhatsApp banners in multiple formats?**

Yes, Sivi supports JPG, PNG, PDF and HTML exports so your banners are ready for any platform.

#### **I need AI that designs WhatsApp banners in different languages.**

With Sivi AI, you can generate stunning WhatsApp banners in 72+ different languages. Both the text prompt and designs incorporate your preferred language.

#### **Do I need to pay or sign up with a card to try it?**

No card required, you can start designing with Sivi AI’s free plan and download your WhatsApp banners without any watermark.

## Frequently asked questions

#### **What’s the best tool to generate Instagram posts in seconds?**

Sivi AI instantly creates beautiful Instagram posts in the right sizes for feeds, reels, stories, and statuses, all from a short text prompt. Just pick a preset size, add your details, and get 4 ready-to-use posts in seconds.

#### **Can I customise/edit AI-generated Instagram posts with my brand details?**

Yes. With Sivi AI’s Instagram post generator, you can upload your logo, brand colours, and fonts to keep every post on-brand. You can also fully edit text, layout, and image style before exporting your final designs.

#### **Does Sivi AI generate captions along with images?**

Yes. You can add your idea as a simple text prompt, and Sivi suggests matching images and captions to make your Instagram posts more engaging. Choose one and start generating designs.

#### **Is there a free version of Sivi AI to make Instagram posts?**

Yes, with Sivi, you can start for free, generate posts, and download them without any watermark. No card details required. Upgrade your plans for more design generation and designing features.

#### **Does Sivi AI support different post styles (minimal, modern, bold)?**

Yes. You can choose from various visual styles in Preference settings. Sivi adapts the design to match its generations.

## What is a Pinterest pin?

Pinterest pin is a visual content such as image or video shared on Pinterest. It is a visual bookmark that acts as a source of inspiration and discovery.

  


Your pins are generally collected on Pinterest boards based on multiple factors including theme, ideas, and types. With millions of high purchase intent users, it is an impactful platform to increase brand awareness, drive traffic, and convert more leads for your business.

  


However, consistently creating compelling visual content for Pinterest can demand a lot of time and expertise.

## How to post Pinterest image pins

  1. Log in to your Pinterest account and click the plus ‘+’ icon at the bottom or top of the page.

  


  2. Choose ‘Create Pin’ from the menu to begin adding a new image.

  


  3. Upload the Sivi-generated image, then enter a title, description, and a destination link for the pin.

  


  4. Pick the board where you want to save the pin, and optionally schedule it for future posting.

## Frequently asked questions

#### **How to use the Pinterest pin generator without AI design skills?**

Sivi lets you simply type your idea and instantly generates multiple Pinterest-ready pins with balanced layouts, images and clean text placement, helping you create professional pins in seconds.

#### **Will my Pinterest pins use the correct size and format?**

Sivi automatically designs pins in the Pinterest-recommended size 1000 × 1500 px (2:3 ratio), ensuring your visuals display perfectly without cropping or pixelation.

#### **I want all my Pinterest pins to be consistent with my brand colours and fonts.**

With Sivi’s brand setup, you can upload your logo, fonts, and colour palette once. Every new pin you generate stays aligned with your brand identity automatically.

#### **Will Sivi’s pin generator create one or multiple Pinterest pins from one idea?**

Sivi generates multiple design variations, 2 to 4 designs from a single idea. You can review, edit, and download the version that fits your campaign best. Perfect for A/B testing and quick posting.

#### **Do AI-generated Pinterest pins improve engagement and visibility?**

Sivi’s design intelligence prioritises clarity, visual hierarchy, and contrast to make your pins stand out on Pinterest feeds and attract higher organic engagement.

#### **How to export and use my Pinterest pins for free?**

Sivi offers a free plan that lets you design and download pins in PNG, PDF, JPG and HTML formats, ready to upload directly to Pinterest. You can upgrade anytime to access more designs and advanced features.

## What is a LinkedIn post?

A LinkedIn post is content shared on the LinkedIn platform to engage the professional network.

  


From establishing thought leadership to promoting your brand visibility, LinkedIn posting offers a lot of key advantages for professionals and businesses.

  


However, it can be challenging and time-consuming to consistently design unique LinkedIn post creatives, just like your ideas.

## How to create a LinkedIn post?

Create LinkedIn posts in minutes, with AI.

  1. Enter your design prompt into the LinkedIn post generator.  
  


  2. Add your brand assets like logos, images, colours, etc.  
  


  3. Press enter to generate LinkedIn post content.  
  


  4. Review content and let Sivi generate LinkedIn post designs in just two minutes.  
  


  5. Pick, edit and publish the best post.

## How to post on LinkedIn with images

  1. Go to your LinkedIn homepage and click ‘Start Post.’   
  


  2. Click the media icon to open your file browser.  
  


  3. Select the Sivi-generated images to upload from your device.  
  


  4. Add text and hashtags, then click “Post” to share the image on your feed.

## Frequently asked questions

#### **How to improve engagement for LinkedIn posts?**

LinkedIn’s algorithm favours visually engaging posts that capture attention and encourage interactions. Sivi’s free LinkedIn post maker generates copy and visuals, combining them into designs quickly that perform better in the LinkedIn feed.

#### **Can LinkedIn post maker design corporate posts that match brand colours and fonts?**

Yes. With Sivi’s LinkedIn post maker, you can upload your logo, fonts, and colour palette once in the brand setup to consistently generate posts that align with your brand identity.

#### **Can Sivi provide LinkedIn post design ideas when I am out of inspiration?**

Yes, Sivi AI helps you ideate by generating multiple copy content, images and design variations from a single prompt, letting you pick the one that fits your tone or campaign best.

#### **Will Sivi-generated LinkedIn post designs fit perfectly without cropping or resizing?**

Yes. Sivi already has LinkedIn’s recommended post sizes set up. You simply choose the format, and your design is automatically created to fit perfectly without any manual resizing.

#### **How to create LinkedIn posts for multiple languages for free?**

Sivi supports over 72+ languages, enabling you to create LinkedIn posts for different languages from a simple text prompt. Start for free and upgrade later for more features. Ideal for local and global marketing campaigns.

#### **What makes Sivi designs different from Canva-designed LinkedIn posts?**

Unique and quick**.** Sivi creates every design from scratch based on your prompt, brand details, and preferences, ensuring each post is unique, fresh, and ready in seconds. Unlike Canva’s template-based, drag-and-drop approach that requires time and effort, Sivi’s AI handles the design work for you.

## Frequently asked questions

#### **How to get fresh ideas for Twitter post visuals and content?**

Sivi’s AI not only designs but also generates creative content ideas and variations, helping you keep your Twitter feed fresh and active with minimal effort.

#### **How to increase engagement on Twitter posts?**

Twitter algorithm favors tweets with clear visuals. Sivi creates matching copy, assets, and designs for your tweet idea in seconds, helping you increase engagement and get more likes, clicks, and retweets.

#### **How many different languages does Sivi’s Twitter post maker support?**

Sivi supports over 72+ languages, allowing you to create global Twitter visuals and captions for different regions easily.

#### **Can I generate free Twitter posts for daily content or promotions?**

Yes, start for free with Sivi’s Twitter post generator and upgrade later for more features. Just describe your idea, and Sivi designs multiple post options in seconds for your daily promotions.

#### **Will Sivi AI maintain a consistent brand look across all Twitter posts?**

Yes**,** With Sivi’s brand kit, you can upload your logo, colors, and fonts once. Every new Twitter post generated automatically follows your brand identity and visual style.

#### **How to design, export, and share Twitter posts instantly from one platform?**

Sivi lets you design and download your Twitter posts in PNG, PDF, JPG and HTML formats, ready to share directly with no platform switching.

## What is a Facebook post?

Facebook post refers to content including text, links, photos, banner designs, and more, posted on a user’s Facebook profile.

  


In a platform boasting over 3 billion monthly active users, your Facebook posts can extend your reach to a diverse audience by appearing on others' news feeds.

  


However, standing out on the news feed and consistently making such branded Facebook posts demands considerable time and effort.

## Frequently asked questions

#### **How to design using the Facebook post generator without any design skills?**

In 3 simple steps. Input idea, add images and generate posts. Sivi’s AI understands layout, colour balance, typography and more and converts it into a professional, scroll-stopping Facebook post that looks designer-made.

#### **I want brand-aligned Facebook posts fast. Can Sivi.ai do?**

Yes, Sivi’s brand kit lets you upload your logo, fonts, and brand colours once. Every design automatically applies your brand elements, ensuring consistent and quick Facebook post designs at scale.

#### **How to create Facebook posts that get better engagement?**

Facebook’s algorithm favors posts with strong, engaging visuals. Sivi’s Facebook post generator designs posts with the right visual contrast, hierarchy, and text placement, helping your message stand out and drive better engagement.

#### **Do Sivi’s Facebook post designs fit perfectly without cropping or blurring?**

Yes, Sivi designs in Facebook’s recommended sizes, ensuring every post looks sharp and perfectly fits without cropping or quality loss.

#### **Should I switch tools to design Facebook posts in different languages?**

No, Sivi supports 72+ languages, allowing you to instantly generate post designs for multiple languages within Sivi.

#### **Do you charge for each download or each design?**

Sivi’s pricing is based on design generation credits, not downloads. You can freely edit and download your designs as many times as you like using the built-in editor. Start designing for free, and upgrade later for more credits and advanced features.

## Frequently asked questions

#### **What social media platforms does Sivi support?**

Sivi generates social media banner ads for platforms like Facebook, Instagram, LinkedIn, Pinterest, WhatsApp, Reddit, and Twitter, with optimized sizes for each.

#### **How does Sivi generate social media ads?**

Sivi uses Large Design Model (LDM) to analyse the content input and generate template-free social media ads. Choose your ad dimensions, enter your prompt, and get multiple creative options instantly.

#### **Can I create ads for different languages?**

Sivi supports ad creation in over [90 languages](https://support.sivi.ai/generate-your-first-design/languages/), helping you effortlessly connect with audiences worldwide.

#### **How does Sivi help with A/B testing?**

Sivi generates up to 4 unique ad variations in one go, giving you ready-made options for A/B testing and optimizing your social ad campaign performance.

#### **Will the generated ads have a watermark?**

No. Regardless of your pricing plan, Sivi generates social media display ads without watermark, ensuring your creatives look clean, professional, and ready to publish.

With Twitter advertising, businesses can reach new users and target specific audiences to promote their products or services effectively.

## How to post X/Twitter ads with images

  1. Open your Twitter Ads Manager from your business account.

## Twitter ad maker FAQs

#### **How can I create Twitter ad visuals for free?**

With Sivi.ai, you can start generating Twitter ads for free and upgrade later for more designs and features. Sivi uses AI to generate branded, professional-looking designs that you can use for Twitter ads without needing design skills.

#### **Which is better - Twitter ad templates or Twitter ad generator?**

If you want simplicity and manual work, Twitter ad template works. If you want unique visuals, many sizes, multi-language support and brand consistency at scale in seconds, a generator is a smarter choice, and a tool like Sivi.ai offers exactly that.

#### **Will my brand look consistent across all Twitter ad visuals?**

Yes. With Sivi’s brand setup feature, you upload your brand colours, fonts and logo once, and the AI generates visuals aligned with your brand identity always.

#### **How do I quickly test multiple versions of a Twitter ad to see what works?**

Sivi generates 2 to 4 ad variations per output in seconds, so you can A/B test visuals and messaging for your Twitter ads efficiently.

#### **My audience includes non-English speakers. Can I create Twitter ads in their language?**

Yes. Sivi AI designer supports more than 72+ languages, so you can generate Twitter ad visuals customised for different language audiences.

#### **Can I edit AI-generated Twitter ads before publishing?**

Yes. Sivi.ai generates editable designs so you can adjust layout, fonts, colours or images to fine-tune your Twitter ad creatives.

## How to post Facebook image ad

  1. Open Facebook Ads Manager and start by creating a new ad campaign.

  


  2. Pick your campaign objective, like brand awareness, website traffic, or conversions.

  


  3. Choose ‘Create ad’ or ‘Use existing post,’ then select the ‘Single image’ ad format.

  


  4. Upload the Sivi-generated image, customize it, write your ad copy with a CTA, set your audience, budget, and placements, and then publish the ad.

## Facebook ad maker FAQs

#### **Why aren’t my Facebook ads getting clicks?**

Often, the visuals or message don’t stand out; with Sivi’s Facebook ad maker, you can quickly generate on-brand, high-impact Facebook creatives.

#### **I don’t have AI or design skills. How can I make good ads with Sivi AI?**

Sivi lets non-designers produce polished ad visuals in seconds, no specialist AI skills needed.

#### **Will the Facebook ad maker work on a limited budget?**

Yes, better creatives mean better engagement. Sivi helps you create free Facebook ads that convert. Upgrade anytime to a budget-friendly plan for more designs and features.

#### **My brand style looks inconsistent across Facebook ads, Will Sivi help?**

Upload your brand assets into Sivi and get creatives that adhere to your colours, fonts and tone.

#### **My ads are in multiple languages. Can Sivi do that?**

Yes, Sivi supports 72+ multilingual output so you can craft visuals and copy for different audiences.

#### **I need fresh Facebook ads every day. How do I design them fast?**

With Sivi, you can quickly generate 2 to 4 versions of ads for A/B testing, keeping your campaigns fresh every day.

## What is a LinkedIn ad generator?

A LinkedIn ad is an advertisement design displayed on the LinkedIn platform. It allows businesses to target specific professional audiences, and is considered a powerful tool for B2B marketing and lead generation.

  


By leveraging LinkedIn ads, businesses can effectively connect with their ideal audience and drive meaningful results.

## LinkedIn ad generator FAQs

#### **Is it free to start making LinkedIn ads with Sivi?**

Yes, you can start generating LinkedIn ads for free with Sivi and upgrade when you need more design credits and features.

#### **Can I make different LinkedIn ad sizes easily?**

Yes, Sivi’s LinkedIn ad generator supports all LinkedIn ad formats like single image, carousel, ads or banner with instant customization.

#### **I want my ads to match my brand style. Is that possible with Sivi?**

Yes, Sivi, with its brand kit feature, adapts to your brand colours, fonts, and tone so every ad looks on-brand.

#### **How do I write effective LinkedIn ad copy without spending hours?**

Sivi’s LinkedIn ad generator suggests ready-to-use LinkedIn ad copy as well as ad assets that fit your product and audience.

#### **Can I edit and customise Sivi-generated ads after generation?**

Yes. Sivi includes a built-in editor so you can edit every element of your ads and text before downloading.

#### **What if I want multiple ad variations for A/B testing?**

Sivi generates at least 2 to 4 variations of LinkedIn ads per output in seconds, perfect for testing performance.

## What is an Instagram ad?

An Instagram ad is a paid promotional media that appears in users' feeds, Stories, and Explore pages. With over 200 million accounts visiting business profiles daily, Instagram ads can be crucial for your business growth.

  


Captivating Instagram ads increase click-through rates and engagement. However, designing high-performing Instagram ads requires time and design expertise.

## How to create Instagram ads

Creating Instagram ads with AI is simple and efficient.

  1. Enter your ad dimensions and details, including text, product images, and call-to-action.  
  


  2. Add your brand guidelines, such as colors, fonts, and button styles.  
  


  3. Review and confirm the AI-generated ad copy and images.  
  


  4. Let Sivi generate unique, template-free Instagram ads.




Make final edits if needed, then download and use your ad instantly for your Instagram campaign.

## How to post image on Instagram ad

## How to post image on Instagram ad

  1. Go to Facebook Business Suite and access Ads Manager to set up your Instagram ad account.

  


  2. Pick an ad objective that supports Instagram, like reach, traffic, or engagement.

  


  3. Choose Instagram as the placement in feed, stories, or reels. 

  


  4. Upload your Sivi-generated Instagram ad image or select ‘Use existing post,’ then set your budget, schedule the ad, and publish it after preview.

## Instagram ad maker FAQs

#### **Can I create professional-looking Instagram ads for my business without any AI design skills?**

Yes, with Sivi AI, you simply type your idea and upload brand assets, and it generates high-quality visuals in seconds, so you don’t need specialist AI design skills.

#### **How quickly can I get an ad ready for use on Instagram?**

Very quickly. Sivi’s Instagram ad maker lets you choose format, upload your assets, texts and output a ready-to-use ad in seconds.

#### **Can Sivi AI tailor ads for different languages or formats?**

Yes, you can create ads in 72+ languages and different ad formats (feed, story, banner) using Sivi AI easily.

#### **Does Sivi ensure all the Instagram ads match my brand’s colours, fonts, and logo?**

Yes, with Sivi AI you set your brand kit (colours, logo, fonts) once and each output aligns with your brand identity, giving consistency across all creatives.

#### **Can I edit text, layout, or replace an image in a Sivi-generated Instagram ad?**

Yes, after generation, you retain full editing control in Sivi AI to adjust text, swap images or tweak layout so the output fits exactly your need.

#### **Why should I choose Sivi AI when there are other Instagram ad makers?**

While most of the Instagram ad makers use AI to replace the text and image in the pre-made templates, with heavy restrictions, Sivi’s Instagram ad generator creates designs from scratch for the given content in seconds.

## What is a Reddit ad?

A Reddit ad is a promotional content format displayed on the Reddit platform to reach its user community, Redditors. With over 97 million daily active users and 100,000+ subreddits, Reddit offers advertisers access to highly engaged audiences across diverse interest groups.

  


The platform's unique structure allows for targeted advertising based on specific user interests, through subreddits. Creating Reddit ads that capture attention and connects with user can be challenging, especially when trying to maintain brand consistency across multiple ad variations.

## Frequently asked questions

#### **Why does making Reddit ads take so long?**

Because you are still using Reddit ad templates that need time and effort. As you need different visuals and copy for each subreddit and ad format you should use Sivi, that generates on-brand Reddit-ready creatives in seconds.

#### **My Reddit ads are boring. How can Sivi make them stand out?**

Use Sivi, a template-free Reddit ads generator that emphasises unique layouts and Reddit-specific design dimensions so your ad doesn’t blend into the crowd.

#### **Can I tailor Reddit ads for multiple niches without using Reddit ad templates?**

Yes, Sivi lets you prompt for niche-specific copy and visuals, maintaining your brand while speaking to each audience.

#### **We have a tight budget and want to test many Reddit ad variants. How?**

With Sivi, you can quickly generate multiple design variations and run tests without high cost. Start free, upgrade later.

#### **Will AI-generated Reddit ads perform on Reddit?**

Yes, Sivi generates copy tailored to Reddit’s tone (conversational, community-friendly), and you can edit, add and test variants to see what performs.

#### **Can I edit AI-generated Reddit ads before publishing?**

Yes. Sivi.ai generates editable designs so you can adjust layout, fonts, colours or images to fine-tune your Reddit ad creatives.

## Sizes supported by the AI thumbnail maker

One size doesn’t fit all. With Sivi’s AI thumbnail maker, you can generate thumbnails in the ideal size for your content and platform in just a few clicks.

#### Horizontal Thumbnails (16:9)

Make your videos stand out and boost YouTube views with captivating horizontal thumbnails. With the recommended size of 1920x1080 px and an aspect ratio of 16:9, ensure your thumbnail is sharp and optimized for widescreen displays.

#### Vertical Thumbnails (9:16)

Maximize engagement on mobile platforms with stunning vertical thumbnails. By using the recommended size of 1080x1920 px and an aspect ratio of 9:16, vertical thumbnails for short-form content like Instagram Reels and YouTube Shorts, fill the screen and instantly grab attention.

#### Square Thumbnails (1:1)

Impress your audience and capture attention with square thumbnails in a 1:1 aspect ratio, with a recommended size of 1080x1080 px. Perfect for podcast covers and posts, this balanced format keeps your visuals sharp and engaging across screens.

#### Custom Thumbnails

Unique content needs unique thumbnails. From event announcements to product showcases, ensure your content gets the visibility it deserves with stunning thumbnails tailored for every need and platform without having to crop your existing designs.

## Frequently asked questions

#### **What is an AI Thumbnail Maker?**

An AI thumbnail maker is a tool that uses artificial intelligence to instantly generate custom video thumbnails from text prompts. Unlike traditional design editors that rely on pre-made templates, Sivi analyzes your content's context to create unique layouts, typography, and imagery specific to your brand and platform.

#### **Do I need design experience to make AI thumbnails with Sivi?**

Not at all. Sivi’s AI thumbnail maker is designed for ease of use. Just add your prompt and assets, and get unique thumbnails instantly.

#### **Can I generate thumbnails in different sizes?**

As Sivi is based on template-free design generation, you can generate thumbnail designs in various custom sizes, including vertical and horizontal thumbnails, as per your needs.

#### **Can I download thumbnails without watermarks?**

Yes. You can generate AI thumbnails and download them without watermarks, even on the free plan.

#### **What kinds of thumbnails can I make and for which platforms?**

You can use Sivi AI to create thumbnails for YouTube, Reels, Shorts, Instagram posts, vlogs, and more. Pick the size, enter your prompt and watch your thumbnail come alive in seconds.

#### **Can I use different languages for the thumbnail?**

Yes. Sivi supports over 72 languages, so you can use Spanish, French, German, Arabic, Portuguese or many others and get thumbnail designs that reflect your message and audience.

#### **Can I edit the AI thumbnails?**

Yes, you can edit the thumbnails right away within Sivi’s design editor. Edit captions, change images, adjust colours, and fine-tune layouts. You get full control to make designs match your expectations.

## What is a YouTube thumbnail?

A YouTube thumbnail is a small preview image representing a video's content on YouTube. It shows up next to your video title in search, on the homepage, and in suggested videos. It is the single biggest reason a viewer clicks or scrolls past your video.

  


YouTube's own creator data ranks thumbnail click-through rate among the top signals for browse traffic, ahead of the title in most niches.

  


A good YouTube thumbnail does three things at once:

  * Communicates the topic in under a second

  * Creates an emotional pull (curiosity, surprise, or a clear payoff)

  * Stays readable at the small sizes YouTube actually displays it on mobile feeds




[Generate YouTube Thumbnails](https://instant.sivi.ai/#/generate-designs?medium=youtube&mediumType=youtube-thumbnail-small&objective=promote-product&source=sivi-usecases-youtube-thumbnail-generator)

The mistake we see most often is creators designing thumbnails at full size on a laptop, then wondering why they fail on mobile. Always preview your thumbnail at the size it will actually be seen.

## YouTube thumbnail size and specs

The standard YouTube thumbnail size is 1280 x 720 pixels at a 16:9 aspect ratio. YouTube allows files up to 2 MB in JPG, PNG, GIF, or BMP. The minimum supported width is 640 pixels, but anything below 1280 looks soft on modern displays.

## What do YouTubers actually use to make thumbnails?

Most YouTubers in 2026 use a mix of three tools. AI YouTube thumbnail makers like Sivi for fast drafts and variants. Photoshop or Canva for manual polish on flagship uploads. Stock photo libraries or AI image generators for backgrounds and props.
