## How to change a thumbnail on YouTube

You can change a YouTube thumbnail any time after upload, even on videos that have been live for years.

  1. Open YouTube Studio and sign in using your account.

  


  2. Click on ‘Content’ in the left sidebar to view your uploaded videos and choose the one you want to edit.

  


  3. Hover over the video you want to edit and click the pencil icon.

  


  4. Under Thumbnail, click Upload file and select your new thumbnail design (1280 x 720 recommended) made with the free YouTube thumbnail creator.

  


  5. Click ‘Save’ in the top-right corner to apply your updated YouTube thumbnail.




  


For verified accounts, you can also run YouTube's built-in thumbnail A/B test with up to three thumbnails per video.

## Frequently asked questions

### **What size should a YouTube thumbnail be?**

1280 x 720 pixels at 16:9. Files up to 2 MB, in JPG, PNG, GIF, or BMP.

### **Is Sivi's YouTube thumbnail maker free?**

Yes. The free plan generates thumbnails with no watermark and 12 monthly credits. Commercial use is allowed.

### **Can I edit the AI-generated thumbnail?**

Yes. Every thumbnail is a layered design. Swap images, edit text, change colors, and adjust layout without re-generating.

### **What is a good YouTube thumbnail?**

High contrast, large readable text, a clear emotional face or focal point, and a single dominant idea. Avoid cluttered layouts and small fonts.

### **Why are my YouTube thumbnails not getting clicks?**

Common causes: low contrast at small sizes, too much text, no clear focal point, or the thumbnail not matching the video's actual payoff. Test variants instead of guessing.

### **Can I use AI-generated thumbnails commercially on YouTube?**

Yes. Sivi thumbnails are commercially usable on the free and paid plans.

### **How do I A/B test YouTube thumbnails?**

Use YouTube Studio's built-in Thumbnail Test for verified accounts. Upload up to three variants and let YouTube pick the winner by CTR. Sivi generates multiple design variations from a single prompt, making it easy to A/B test different thumbnails.

### **What is the best YouTube thumbnail maker in 2026?**

For weekly creators who want fast, editable, on-brand thumbnails from a prompt, Sivi is the best option. For manual template editing, Canva and Adobe Express work well. For full creative control on flagship videos, Photoshop is still the standard. Most active creators use a mix of AI for drafts and a manual editor for milestone uploads.

## What is an Instagram reel cover?

An Instagram reel cover is the thumbnail image that represents your reel or short form video on your Instagram profile grid or in the Reels tab. A well-designed Instagram reel thumbnail grabs attention, highlights the reel’s content, and encourages people to engage.

  


Creating on-brand, captivating reel covers requires design skills and time. As a result, many brands use default video frames, which often fail to maximize their content's potential, resulting in lower engagement and reach.

## How to add Instagram Reel cover

  1. After recording or uploading your Reel on Instagram, tap ‘Next’ to move forward.

  


  2. Tap the ‘Cover’ option located above the description section.

  


  3. Choose ‘Add from camera roll’ to upload a Sivi-generated Instagram reel cover image or pick a frame from the Reel itself.

  


  4. Adjust the selected image or frame to fit, tap ‘Profile Grid’ to preview its layout, then tap ‘Done’ and ‘Share’ to publish.

## What is podcast cover art?

Podcast cover art is the visual identity of your podcast that appears on platforms like Spotify and Apple Podcasts. It’s the first thing potential listeners see, making it crucial for attracting attention and conveying your podcast’s theme. Creating eye-catching, branded podcast cover designs can be time-consuming and challenging without design expertise.

## How to upload Podcast cover art in general

## Frequently asked questions

#### **Which is the best podcast cover art generator?**

An AI generator that is easy to use, supports standard podcast dimensions, allows branding, editing, and downloading for free without watermarks. Try Sivi with all the mentioned features to instantly generate professional podcast cover designs in seconds.

#### **Can I make custom-sized podcast covers?**

Yes. Sivi lets you set custom dimensions or choose the recommended format preset in Sivi automatically.

#### **Do I need design experience to use Sivi?**

No. Sivi’s AI handles layout, style, colors, text, images and more such design elements while you just input your idea and brand assets.

#### **Can I download my podcast art in high quality?**

Yes, Sivi lets you design and download your podcast art in PNG, PDF, JPG and HTML formats, ready to share directly with no platform switching.

#### **Is it possible to edit the design generated by the podcast cover art generator?**

Yes. With Sivi’s built-in editor, you can update your design anytime without starting over.

#### **Does Sivi charge per design or per download?**

Sivi works on a credit-based model. You pay for design generation, not for downloads.

## What is a LinkedIn banner?

The LinkedIn banner is the visual content at the top of the LinkedIn profile, that lets people know about you. Placed on a prime space of your profile, the banner makes an impact on visitors and communicate your story, expertise, and business through an eye-catching manner.

  


A well-designed LinkedIn background image can reinforce your branding and enhance your professional image. However, creating a unique LinkedIn cover that reflects your identity and trends requires time and design expertise.

## How to change LinkedIn banner

  1. Click on the ‘Me’ icon at the top of your LinkedIn homepage and select ‘View Profile.’  
  


  2. Move the mouse over the banner area in the introduction section and click the ‘Edit’ icon.  
  


  3. Choose ‘Change’ to update with a newly designed banner by Sivi for your LinkedIn profile.

  


  4. You can also crop, filter, reposition, rotate, change, or delete the image. Click ‘Apply,’ to save changes.

## Frequently asked questions

#### **Can I create LinkedIn banners with Sivi AI for desktop and mobile?**

Yes! You can easily create LinkedIn banners in the right size by selecting preset sizes or by entering custom dimensions. Sivi’s LinkedIn banner maker automatically adapts your layout to fit perfectly across desktop and mobile.

#### **Is Sivi AI using templates for professional banners?**

No. Sivi AI offers template-free designs tailored for business, personal branding, and marketing use. You can generate fresh designs from your own prompt to match your tone, niche, or profession.

#### **How customizable are the LinkedIn banner designs?**

Every banner Sivi generates is multi-layered, so you can edit text, images, and design elements individually without affecting the rest of the layout. You stay in full creative control.

#### **Can I add my brand logo, colours, and fonts?**

Yes. You can upload your brand kit in Sivi’s LinkedIn banner maker, like logo, font styles, and colour palette, so every banner stays aligned with your brand identity.

#### **Is there a free plan for creating LinkedIn banners?**

Yes, you can start for free, no credit card required. Generate banners, preview designs, and download your favourites without watermarks.

#### **What file formats and quality can I download?**

You can download your LinkedIn banner in high-resolution PNG, PDF, HTML or JPG, ready to upload directly to your profile. Use Sivi’s mock-up feature to preview your designs as banners before finalising.

## What is a Facebook cover?

A Facebook cover is the large banner at the top of a Facebook profile, located above the profile picture. 

  


Facebook banners serves as a visual centerpiece to showcase personality, branding, or storytelling. It is often the first visual impression visitors have of a FB profile.

  


While iterating Facebook cover images based on trends, seasonal offers, and product launches can increase the audience engagement, it requires a lot of time and expertise to design.

## How to change Facebook cover photo

  1. Go to your Facebook profile where your current cover photo is displayed.

  


  2. Hover over the cover photo and click the camera icon that appears.

  


  3. Choose a Sivi-generated new photo or select one from your existing Facebook albums.

  


  4. Adjust the image position if needed, click ‘Save changes,’ and your updated cover photo will be visible instantly.

## What is a LinkedIn cover image?

The LinkedIn cover image serves as the focal point of your LinkedIn page, personal or business, providing a key opportunity to highlight your brand's narrative. Strategically placed, it acts as a potent tool to boost your exposure, foster connections, and gain insights into your customer base.

  


LinkedIn cover image should be 1128 x 191 px with a 129:8 aspect ratio, and its file size should not exceed 8 MB.

## How to change LinkedIn cover image

  1. Click the ‘Me’ icon at the top of your LinkedIn homepage and select ‘View Profile.’

  


  2. Hover over the cover area in the introduction section and click the ‘Edit’ icon.

  


  3. Choose ‘Change’ to update with a new Sivi-generated cover image for your LinkedIn profile.

  


  4. You can also crop, filter, reposition, rotate, change, or delete the image. Click ‘Apply’ to save changes.

## Frequently asked questions

#### **How does Sivi compare to other LinkedIn cover photo makers?**

While most tools rely on pre-set templates, Sivi creates unique designs from text prompts and lets you fully customise every element. It’s ideal for professionals who want original, on-brand banners without manual design work.

#### **What size does Sivi AI support for LinkedIn cover photos?**

Sivi AI automatically supports LinkedIn’s recommended banner size 1584×396 pixels. You can also enter custom dimensions if you want to reuse the same design prompt for other social platforms or websites.

#### **Is there a free plan for creating LinkedIn banners with Sivi?**

Yes. You can start with Sivi’s free plan, generate and download LinkedIn banners without a watermark, and upgrade later if you need more credits or advanced brand features.

#### **Can I use my company brand colours, logo, or fonts in Sivi AI?**

Yes. Sivi supports full brand customisation, allowing you to upload logos, set brand colours, and choose your preferred font, keeping your LinkedIn banner visually consistent with your brand identity.

#### **Can I edit the AI-generated banners in Sivi’s LinkedIn cover photo maker?**

Yes. Unlike most AI generators, Sivi uses a layered design editor, so you can tweak text, images, or layout elements individually without regenerating the whole design.

#### **Are AI-generated LinkedIn cover photos accepted by LinkedIn’s algorithm?**

Yes. LinkedIn accepts AI-generated cover photos as long as they meet the platform’s image size and quality requirements. Sivi ensures your designs are optimised for LinkedIn’s recommended sizes, quality and uniqueness so they upload smoothly without any issues.

## What is an X/Twitter header?

X/Twitter header is the wide cover image displayed at the top of the X (formerly Twitter) profile page. The Twitter header image size is 1500x500 px and serves as a visual introduction to your Twitter profile visitors.

  


The Twitter header, also called a Twitter profile banner, cover image and background, plays a crucial role in conveying a user’s identity or business to make a memorable first impression.

  


Regularly updating the Twitter header can engage visitors and enhance your profile. However, designing the Twitter banner requires time and skill. While there are numerous Twitter header design templates, they don’t let your profile stand out.

## How to change Twitter header

  1. Open your Twitter profile and click the "Edit Profile" button.

  


  2. Hover over the header area and click the camera icon that appears.

  


  3. Upload your new Sivi-generated Twitter header image in 1500x500 px.

  


  4. Adjust the image if needed and click "Save" to update your Twitter header.

## Frequently asked questions

#### **Which is the best Twitter banner maker?**

The best Twitter banner maker should create banners that fit perfectly on both desktop and mobile, reflect your brand, be easy to use, support multiple languages, export formats, and allow quick edits. Sivi AI’s Twitter banner maker does all this for free.

#### **What makes Sivi AI better than traditional Twitter banner templates?**

Templates limit creativity. Sivi AI, on the other hand, creates unique, brand-fit designs from your prompt, style, and brand kit, giving you personalised banners that stand out every time.

#### **Do I need design skills to use a Twitter banner maker like Sivi?**

Not at all. With Sivi AI, you just type your simple prompt, and it instantly generates creative banner options. With pre-set dimensions, style preferences, colours palettes, and fonts, your designs get generated with no manual design work.

#### **Can I create a Twitter banner with my brand colours, logo, and fonts?**

Yes. Sivi lets you upload your brand asset, your logo, fonts, and colour palette so your Twitter banner stays on-brand every time you generate designs.

#### **Can I edit my AI-generated Twitter banner after creation?**

Yes. Unlike most AI design tools that regenerate everything when edited, Sivi allows layer-based editing, meaning you can tweak text, images, or background individually without disturbing the layout.

#### **Is it free to make and download a Twitter banner with Sivi AI?**

Yes. You can start with the free plan, create your Twitter banner, and download it without any watermarks. Upgrade your plan anytime for more designs and features.

## What is a header?

A header is a graphic element at the top of your social media profiles, websites, or emails. Headers influence the first impression of visitors and help establish your brand identity across different platforms.

  


However, creating unique headers across platforms with custom copy and brand assets requires design expertise and time.

## Frequently asked questions

#### **What is the best AI header generator for websites and social media?**

The best AI header generator should support all header sizes, offer editable designs, maintain brand consistency, and deliver quick results. Sivi AI’s header generator automatically designs headers for websites, blogs, Facebook, LinkedIn, and more, perfectly sized and ready to use.

#### **Can I upload my brand assets?**

Yes. You can upload logos, brand colors, fonts, icons, and product images to make sure your header stays on brand.

#### **Can I edit the design after it's generated?**

Yes. You can adjust copy, images, and colors using the design editor before downloading.

#### **Can Sivi generate headers for blogs and email newsletters, too?**

Yes. Sivi ai supports headers for blogs, websites, e-commerce pages, and even newsletter banners, so you can maintain a unified look across every channel.

#### **Can I do free header designs before buying?**

Yes, Sivi offers a free plan where you can generate and download headers without watermarks and no card details are needed to start.

#### **How does Sivi AI compare to tools like Canva or Adobe Express?**

Unlike static template-based tools, Sivi AI generates unique, multiple header variations instantly from your prompt, helping you design professional-looking headers faster and at scale.

## What is a website hero image?

A website hero image, also known as a hero banner, is the prominent visual element placed at the top of web pages. The hero banner contains text, images, and a call-to-action, to engage visitors and increase conversions.

  


As the first thing visitors see, the website header plays a crucial role, especially for ecommerce businesses. It captures attention instantly, conveys the core message, and creates a lasting first impression.

  


However, designing custom-branded hero banners for every web page demands significant time and design expertise.

## Frequently asked questions

#### **What is the best AI hero image generator for websites and landing pages?**

A good AI hero image generator should match your brand style, colours, and layout. Sivi AI does this automatically, creating hero images sized perfectly for web headers and landing pages.

#### **Which AI hero image generator supports custom dimensions?**

Sivi supports common hero image sizes like 1920×600 px, plus other wide aspect ratios and custom dimensions too, ensuring your banner looks perfect on both desktop and mobile without cropping or stretching.

#### **Can I create brand-consistent website hero images with AI?**

Yes, Sivi AI is built for branded content. You can upload your logo, define brand colours, and select a visual style so every AI-generated hero image stays consistent with your website identity.

#### **What’s the easiest AI website header generator for non-designers?**

With Sivi, anyone can design a professional hero banner in seconds. Just describe your brand or product, Input website URL, choose your preferred styles, and click generate to download multiple ready-to-use headers instantly. It's easy to use with no skill requirements.

#### **Which free AI hero image generator is best for startups and marketers?**

Sivi AI offers a free plan with no watermark and instant downloads, perfect for startups, marketing teams, and creators who need stunning hero banners without high design costs.

#### **How can I edit or customise AI-generated hero banners?**

Sivi lets you easily edit generated hero images in its editor. You can tweak colours, composition, headline space, or regenerate alternate layouts to perfectly match your site structure.

## What is a blog banner?

A blog banner is the creative in a blog post that sets the visual tone for the content. A well-designed blog header banner at the top of the blog enhances engagement, improves brand recognition, and elevates your blog’s overall appeal.

  


Creating custom headers from generic blog banner templates while ensuring the right dimensions and brand consistency requires a lot of time and graphic design expertise.

## Frequently asked questions

#### **Why choose AI-generated blog headers instead of a blog header template?**

For uniqueness and speed. Template tools rely on pre-set designs with restrictions on content hierarchy, whereas Sivi creates unique headers from text prompts and lets you fully customise every element. It’s ideal for professionals who want original, on-brand headers in seconds.

#### **What if my blog layout needs a custom header size?**

Design custom blog headers easily with Sivi. Just enter your preferred dimensions, and Sivi adapts the design automatically.

#### **Are Sivi’s generated designs editable like blog header templates?**

Yes. You can edit the generated design’s text, fonts, colours, images and more inside Sivi’s built-in editor before downloading.

#### **Do I need to pay to test the tool?**

No. Sivi lets you generate and preview blog header designs for free before upgrading to paid plans.

#### **Will AI headers match my blog’s niche or tone?**

Yes. Sivi tailors design, colour, and imagery based on your prompt input, preference settings and brand assets.

#### **Can I use Sivi to design multiple blog posts quickly?**

Yes. You can generate multiple AI header variations for each blog post, keeping your blog visually consistent but never repetitive.

## What is a Twitch banner?

A Twitch banner is a large image displayed at the top of a Twitch profile that sets the tone for a streamer’s brand. With 240 million monthly active users, striking banners can help you stand out from the crowd and establish your brand identity. Creating such Twitch cover art from Twitch banner templates takes a lot of time and expertise for streamers.

## How to add Twitch banner

## How to add Twitch banner

  1. Log in to your Twitch account and click your profile icon at the top right to access the Creator Dashboard.

  


  2. In the Creator Dashboard, go to Settings. Under the Channel section, click on the Brand tab.

  


  3. Find the Profile Banner section, click Update, and upload your Sivi-generated Twitch banner image when the ‘Upload a Photo’ pop-up appears.

  


  4. Click ‘Save’ to apply your new Twitch banner.

## Twitch banner maker FAQs

#### **I need multiple versions of Twitch banners fast. Can Sivi design?**

Yes, Sivi generates multiple design variations from the same prompt in seconds, so you can switch banners easily.

#### **Will Sivi’s Twitch banner maker keep my banners on-brand?**

Yes, use Sivi’s brand setup feature to upload logos, colours and fonts once, after which your generated banners align with your channel identity always.

#### **Will my Twitch banner display correctly on both mobile and desktop?**

Yes, with Sivi’s preset dimensions, you just have to choose the dimensions for the Twitch platform, and Sivi automatically generates designs optimising the key elements for both mobile and desktop.

#### **How much text should I put on my Twitch banner?**

Keep text minimal, just your name or handle and maybe one short tagline. Too much text can clutter the design. Sivi suggests copy and assets for banners, too.

#### **Can I post Sivi-generated Twitch banner designs from my mobile?**

Yes. You can use Sivi’s web app on your mobile to create designs, download them, and post directly to your Twitch platform.

#### **Is the AI twitch banner generator expensive?**

No, you can use Sivi’s AI twitch banner generator for free to test, design, edit and download. Upgrade to budget-friendly paid plans for more designs and features.

## What is an email banner?

An email banner is a visual element placed in multiple locations within your email, including headers, body sections, and footers. Effective email banners help recipients engage with your content and increase click-through rates.

  


Creating email banners that drive engagement across all devices and email clients is challenging. Most solutions demand design skills and time while limiting you to overused templates your email recipients have seen before.

## Frequently asked questions

#### **Which is the best free email header maker for marketing campaigns?**

A good free email header maker should let you design headers quickly, support multiple formats, languages, be on-brand and offer free downloads without watermarks. Sivi AI stands out because it generates multilingual, on-brand email headers from your text prompt in seconds.

#### **What download formats are available?**

You can download your email banner in JPG, PNG, PDF, or HTML formats, based on your needs.

#### **Can I customize the email banner size?**

Yes. You can choose from preset email banner sizes or enter custom dimensions that fit your emails.

#### **Will the banners follow my brand style?**

Yes. Upload your logo, colors, and fonts. Sivi automatically applies them to keep every design on-brand.

#### **How to generate email headers for different industries?**

Sivi offers smart AI-generated layouts for every niche, from fashion and real estate to e-commerce and events, healthcare and more, helping you create industry-specific email headers effortlessly.

#### **How does Sivi AI compare to other free email header makers?**

Unlike basic drag-and-drop tools like Canva or Visme, Sivi AI uses Large Design Model (LDM) to generate professional headers from prompts, ensuring brand consistency, custom sizing, and speed all in one platform.

# What is an email header?

Email header or email banner is the visual introduction placed at the top of the email content. It invites the readers and sets the tone for the email body.

  


A compelling email newsletter banner not only captures attention and boosts reader engagement but also reinforces brand identity.

  


Crafting such striking email hero banners for multiple email types, from welcome emails to promotional emails can take a lot of time and iteration.

## What is a newsletter header?

A newsletter header is the top section of an email that sets the tone and reinforces your brand identity. 

  


A well-designed email newsletter header captures attention and improves reader engagement. However, designing such headers requires time and graphic design expertise.

## How to apply headers for newsletter

  1. In your preferred email marketing document editor platform, go to the "Insert" menu and choose ‘Header’ or ‘Header & Footer’ from the options.

  


  2. Pick a ready-made generic header or upload a Sivi-generated custom header design containing text, images, logos, and other elements.

  


  3. Save your changes, exit the newsletter header editor, and your header will appear across your emails. 

  


  4. When sending an email newsletter, preview your newsletter on different devices to ensure it displays correctly.

## Frequently asked questions

#### **How do I design a newsletter header that reflects my brand instantly?**

Your header should feature your logo, consistent fonts and colours. With Sivi AI, you can set your brand kit once (colours, logo, fonts) and generate header visuals that match your identity without starting from scratch in seconds.

#### **Will AI keep my newsletter header clean and effective?**

Yes, Sivi AI helps by recommending layout templates that prioritise white-space and visual clarity, so your message stands clean and effective.

#### **Sivi-generated newsletter header works on mobiles too?**

Yes. With Sivi AI, you get header designs optimised for both desktop and mobile, so you don’t need separate designs or guess about sizing.

#### **Can I reuse the newsletter header design later?**

Yes. With Sivi.ai, your newsletter header is saved in the “Generated” tab, where you can reuse, edit, or download it anytime.

#### **What elements should I include in a newsletter header to make it purposeful?**

A strong newsletter header includes logo, title or newsletter-name, date/issue number and a short tagline. Sivi AI helps you structure these elements correctly and suggests content and assets to emphasise depending on the prompt of the newsletter.

#### **How can I test and improve my newsletter header over time?**

You can test different header styles (e.g., image-heavy, text-heavy or neutral) using preference settings in Sivi. These generated header variants are stored in the library so you can A/B test layouts quickly and improve header designs over time.

## What is an email signature?

An email signature is a customized block of text, images, and links at the end of an email. It enhances credibility, improves brand recognition, and increases engagement with recipients.

  


However, creating such unique, on-brand email signature banners from generic email signature design templates requires design expertise and time.

## How to add image to email signature

## How to add image to email signature

  1. Upload your Sivi-generated email signature image to Google Drive or a free image hosting website.

  


  2. Copy the shareable URL of the uploaded image.

  


  3. If using Gmail, go to Gmail settings by clicking the gear icon and selecting ‘See all settings.’

  


  4. In the Signature section, click ‘Insert Image,’ paste the image URL, and save the changes.

## Frequently asked questions

#### **How can I create an email signature banner that looks professional without design skills?**

AI tools like Sivi generate polished, on-brand banners automatically from your text prompts, so you don’t need to design from scratch.

#### **Can I customise the banner to match my brand colours and logo?**

Yes, Sivi adapts your brand assets and colours palette to create consistent, professional-looking email signature banners.

#### **Are the email signature banner sizes fixed?**

No, Sivi supports custom dimensions and preset banner sizes too, ensuring a perfect fit for any email platform.

#### **Is there a free option before I commit?**

You can start creating email banners for free with Sivi and upgrade later for advanced features and credits.

#### **How do I download and use the banner in my email signature?**

Sivi lets you export your banners in PNG, PDF, JPG and HTML formats, ready to embed in any email client.

#### **I need quick variations for campaigns or promotions. Can Sivi help?**

Yes, Sivi can instantly generate multiple creative versions for campaigns and promotions just through simple text prompts. You can edit the existing ones or generate new ones, all in seconds.

## What is a website banner?

A website banner is a graphic element displayed on web pages such as blog covers, home pages, etc. From promoting your products and services to showcasing your brand, web banner designs play an important role in conveying the message in a visually compelling way.

  


Well-crafted banners including website headers and blog covers not only contribute to the overall aesthetics of the website but also create a positive user experience and encourage visitors to stay longer on your site.

  


However, designing such website banners based on needs and trends requires a lot of time and design expertise.

## Frequently asked questions

#### **Which is the best website banner maker?**

A good website banner maker should be easy to use, apply brand elements, and allow quick customisation. Sivi AI fits perfectly as it lets anyone generate branded website banners from simple text prompts, even without design skills, in seconds.

#### **Will the banner match my brand look?**

Yes. Add your brand colors, fonts, logos, and brand preferences including button styles and Sivi applies them and generate brand-consistent designs.

#### **Can I generate banners in different languages?**

Yes. Sivi supports over 72+ languages, so you can create website banners that resonate with global audiences.

#### **What formats can I download the banner in?**

You can download banners in JPG, PNG, SVG, or HTML, based on your website design needs.

#### **Which website banner maker offers AI speed with human-like design quality?**

Sivi combines AI automation with human design control using a human-in-the-loop approach, producing professional, ready-to-publish website banners in just seconds.

A display ad is an online advertisement that combines text, images and other elements to promote products or services. 

  


The banner ads help advertisers convey information, create brand awareness, and drive user engagement. With Google’s Display Ad Network reaching 90% of global internet users, compelling ad creatives can get you a lot of reach and engagement.

## How to change images in google display ads

  1. Open your Google Ads account and select the campaign you want to edit.  
  


  2. Click ‘Ads’ in the left menu and find the display ad you want to change.  
  


  3. Click the pencil icon to replace images.  
  


  4. Upload the Sivi-generated display ads and click ‘Save’ to apply the changes.

## Frequently asked questions

#### **What display ad sizes does Sivi's AI ad generator support?**

Sivi supports all standard display ad sizes, including leaderboard, skyscraper, inline rectangle, and many more. You can also create custom-sized display ads to fit specific placement requirements across different ad networks.

#### **Does Sivi support branded display ad creation?**

Yes. You can upload your complete brand guide, including brand colours, fonts, and logo, into Sivi. The AI ad generator creates on-brand, template-free display ads that maintain your visual identity consistently across all ad variations.

#### **Can I create display ads in different languages?**

Yes, Sivi's multilingual capabilities support 72+ languages, enabling you to create localised display ad campaigns for global audiences. Both ad copy generation and design layouts adapt to different languages seamlessly.

#### **Can I edit the AI-generated display ads after generation?**

Yes. Once Sivi generates your display ads, you can review, edit, and customise them before downloading. Unlike other AI design generators, where every edit changes the entire layout, Sivi uses a layered design process, allowing you to edit each element individually without affecting the rest of the design.

#### **Can I create multiple ad variations without design skills?**

Yes. Sivi’s AI ad generator automatically creates 2 to 4 unique, professional display ad designs for each prompt, no design experience needed. Just provide your ad copy and brand assets, and the AI handles everything from layout to colour and typography.

#### **Can I use this AI ad generator tool for free before purchasing?**

Yes, Sivi has a free plan. No card details required. You can try generating ads in various sizes, languages, and formats before purchasing any higher plans.

## What is Amazon A+ content?

Amazon A+ content, previously Enhanced Brand Content (EBC) is a feature that allows sellers to enhance their product listings with rich multimedia content. 

  


Beyond the standard product details, sellers can showcase their ecommerce brand story, highlight key product features, and provide a more immersive shopping experience. 

  


It helps customers better understand your products, builds trust, and increases conversion. However, crafting such banners for your ecommerce products with your brand guidelines, product images, and features requires a lot of time and design expertise.

## How to change Amazon A+ content images

  1. Log in to Amazon Seller Central and go to Advertising and then to A+ content manager.

  


  2. Search for the ASIN or product name and select the A+ content you want to update.

  


  3. Click "Edit," locate the image module, remove the current image, and upload your new Sivi-generated image with alt-text.

  


  4. Review the changes, click ‘Next,’ and submit the content for approval.

## Frequently asked questions

#### **Why choose AI-generated Amazon A+ designs over Amazon A+ content templates?**

Designing and aligning visuals, text, and layouts in templates manually takes effort. Sivi AI speeds this up by generating complete on-brand a+ designs in seconds.

#### **How do I ensure my A+ content matches Amazon’s format?**

Sivi automatically adapts your visuals to Amazon’s layout and image specifications with its preset dimensions, removing guesswork.

#### **I need multiple variations for different products in different dimensions. Can Sivi design?**

Sivi lets you generate and edit multiple creative versions of products in multiple dimensions fast, keeping all your product listings consistent. Save your product photos, brand assets, design preferences and languages to generate consistent designs.

#### **How do I maintain brand consistency across products?**

Sivi keeps your fonts, colours, and brand style consistent across all A+ designs automatically using its brand kit feature.

#### Ia**m short on time and budget for designers. What can help?**

Sivi saves both time and cost by offering ready-to-use AI-generated A+ designs in seconds.

#### **How do I download and use the Amazon A+ content?**

Sivi lets you export your a+ content in PNG, PDF, JPG and HTML formats, ready to upload and share.

## What is a product banner?

A product banner is a visual promotion graphic to highlight a specific product in an e-commerce online store. It is typically designed to capture the audience's attention, showcase product features, and drive purchases. 

  


For an online store with multiple products, it can take a lot of time and effort to create e commerce banner as you scale.

## Frequently asked questions

#### **I have product photos only and no design skills. Can I still produce good-looking product banners for websites?**

Yes. You can upload your product photos, brand colours/logo, and Sivi will generate professional copy, product assets, and layout suggestions to choose from. Select your preferred ones and start generating banner designs instantly without any design skills.

#### **My business uses local languages and market-specific visuals. Can Sivi handle that?**

Yes. Sivi supports 72+ multiple languages, and you can customise the text and visuals to match your local audience while keeping your brand identity.

#### **What is unique about Sivi’s AI-generated product banners than product banner templates?**

Sivi’s AI generates rich variations and applies your brand assets (logo, colours, fonts) so your banners reflect your unique brand style rather than just a stock layout.

#### **My budget for design tools is limited. Is Sivi cost-effective for a small business?**

Yes. Sivi.ai offers a free plan to start, and provides paid plan upgrades when you want access to more designs and features, making it a cost-effective solution for small businesses to get high-quality visuals.

#### **I want to A/B test different banner visuals to improve performance. Can I easily generate variants?**

Yes, with Sivi, you can generate 2 to 4 design variations quickly, test which works with your audience, and optimise your product banners based on real feedback.

## What is a category banner?

A category banner is a visual element that represents a collection of products on the ecommerce website. 

  


Category banners are designed to enhance the shopping experience by visually representing the product categories in ecommerce stores such as Etsy, Shopify, Amazon, etc. They take users to designated category pages, making it easier to browse the required range of products and shop for them. 

  


However, designing product category banners for online stores with different collections of products can demand a lot of time and iteration.

## Frequently asked questions

#### **Can non-designers use Sivi?**

Yes. With Sivi.ai, you simply add your idea, brand assets, choose a size, and the AI generates visuals with minimal clicks. No design expertise needed.

#### **Can my designers use the banner-generator tool easily within our existing workflow?**

Yes, often designers run out of inspiration or hit a road-block with ideas and copy. With Sivi, you or your designers can upload product images and brand assets, then it suggests multiple variations of copy, layouts and visuals to choose from. Sivi adapts to your existing workflow, boosting productivity.

#### **Should I resize the e-commerce banners manually for different formats?**

No, Sivi supports custom sizes and preset sizes for all popular e-commerce platforms. Just choose a size to automatically generate banners in multiple formats, saving you time and keeping your brand consistent.

#### **Will Sivi keep my brand's look consistent across banners?**

Yes, Sivi lets you upload your brand kit once (logo, colours, font preferences) and then every banner follows your brand guidelines, keeping your banners consistent.

#### **Will the AI banners load fast and look good on desktop and mobile?**

Yes, Sivi generates high-quality banner files optimised for web/mobile use, so they look sharp and perform well.

#### **How much will this cost and is it worth it for a small business?**

Yes, Sivi AI is a cost-effective tool that provides banner generation across sizes, formats, languages and variations under one roof. Start for free and upgrade to feature-rich plans as you grow.

## What is a hello bar?

A hello bar is a banner at the top of a webpage to capture visitor attention, convey important information and drive specific action.

  


From offering ecommerce holiday promotions to making product announcements to guiding users to take a specific action, the website hello bar is used for multiple use cases.

  


However, designing announcement bars that enhance visitor engagement and overall website visuals requires iteration and time.

## Frequently asked questions

#### **How do I ensure the Hello Bar matches my brand’s look and feel?**

Sivi lets you add your logo, brand colours and fonts so the generated hello bar blends seamlessly with your website and strengthen your identity.

#### **Can I use Sivi’s hello bar examples to design one for my own use?**

Yes. You can use Sivi-generated designs for your own use just by duplicating the design idea and uploading your own assets to start generating for free. Get a ready-to-use hello bar in seconds.

#### **My website serves many types of users. Will one tool work for all?**

Yes. Sivi allows you to customise design size, message and language so you can create hello bars tailored for different niches, users, and purposes while maintaining brand consistency.

#### **Our website visitors speak different languages will the tool handle this?**

Yes. Sivi supports 72+ language generation so you can create hello bars in the visitors’ language, making the message more relevant.

#### **We need to update offers quickly (discounts, events). How fast can we roll out a new bar?**

Very fast. Sivi’s generator lets you enter new copy and assets, and then generate the updated hello bar to deploy it in seconds.

#### **Will the Hello Bar distract or annoy our visitors instead of helping them?**

No. Hello Bars are designed to catch attention without being disruptive. You can use Sivi to create bars that are clear, align with your brand, and deliver information in a friendly way rather than interrupting the user’s experience.

## How to create a real estate banner with AI

Create eye-catching real estate banners with Sivi AI Designer in 2 ways: Prompt to design or Content to design

#### Generate real estate banners with a prompt

  1. Add your design dimension and prompt with property and real estate details.  
  


  2. Add brand assets, and generate tailored ad copy.

  


  3. Finalise ad copy, and let Sivi generate stunning property banners within minutes.  
  


  4. Click on any real estate banner to edit and download.




#### Generate real estate banners for your content

  1. Open Sivi, select ‘Content to Designs,’ pick your dimensions, and proceed.  
  


  2. Add the real estate property details including property images.

  


  3. Hit 'Generate' and get template-free real estate banners within minutes.  
  


  4. Download preferred banner, edit if required and share them with your network to boost property inquiry.

## Common questions about real estate banner designs

#### **Why choose AI for real estate banner designs over template tools?**

Sivi’s real estate banner generator designs banners in seconds with no manual work. It generates unique banners from scratch based on your prompt and assets, helping your listings look fresh and stand out.

#### **Can I generate real estate banners in multiple sizes, like social posts, websites, and listing ads, without starting over?**

Yes. With Sivi, you can reuse the same design idea and instantly generate real estate banners for any platform size or custom dimension. Sivi supports all popular social media and digital platforms.

#### **How do I include my real estate agency’s branding in the banner?**

Easily. Do a one-time brand kit set up with branding assets like logo, font and colours. Sivi incorporates them into every design variation so your banners are ready to go.

#### **How to add contact details and CTA to the real estate banner?**

You can add contact details by simply typing them in the prompt box in Sivi. Just include your mobile number, website, address in the prompt, and Sivi will place them in the banner with the right icons.

#### **How to design a real estate banner with multiple images?**

In Sivi, you can design a real estate banner with multiple images by simply uploading all the images directly in the prompt box. Sivi will use them to create a collage during design generation.

#### **Can I test different real estate banners to see which listing drives more leads?**

Yes. Sivi creates multiple variations from one prompt, so you can A/B test different designs and identify what works best for your audience.

#### **What if I need banners in a local language and for a local audience?**

Sivi supports 72+ multiple languages and custom fonts, so you can input content in the preferred language and upload language-specific assets so the banner speaks directly to your regional audience.

## How to create a travel banner with AI

You can now create custom travel promotion ads tailored to your needs effortlessly with Sivi. Just feed a prompt or use the content you already have.

#### Create travel banners with a prompt

  1. Add your prompt with details about the travel package, including the locations, cost, images, and contact info.  
  


  2. Check and choose a generated ad copy.  
  


  3. Watch Sivi instantly generate multiple tour package banner designs.  
  


  4. Click on any design to edit or download it.




#### Create travel banners using your content

  1. To start with ‘Content to Design’, select the size of the design, and proceed.  
  


  2. Type in details of your travel package including the places covered, duration, cost, facilities, etc. Add images and an appropriate CTA.  
  


  3. Click ‘Generate" and watch captivating tour banners take shape in minutes.  
  


  4. Download, share, and watch your tours fill up. Boost bookings with these stunning travel poster designs!

## Frequently asked questions

#### **How to add images of multiple destinations to travel banners?**

In Sivi, you can add multiple images directly in the prompt box. Just upload all the images you want, and Sivi will use them to create a collage in your travel banner designs.

#### **How to specify travel banner colours?**

Just type your preferred colours in the prompt box, and Sivi will generate the banner using those colours. You can also use hex codes for specific shades.

#### **Can Sivi give unique travel designs every time?**

Yes. Unlike static templates, Sivi generates every banner from scratch using AI based on your prompt, style, and brand details. No repeated layouts, no manual efforts.

#### **Can Sivi generate travel banners that match my travel agency brand?**

Yes. Upload your travel agency’s logo, fonts, and colours once in Sivi’s Brand Kit, and every travel banner design auto-aligns with your brand instantly.

#### **Will Sivi write banner copy for me, or do I need to think of it myself?**

Sivi generates engaging banner headlines, subtext, and CTA’s tailored for travel audiences, so you don’t start from blank or rely on prewritten template text.

#### **Do I need design skills to make professional travel banners?**

No. You just describe your campaign idea, and Sivi creates multiple high-quality travel banner options in seconds. No resizing, no switching tools, no design experience needed.

#### **Can Sivi create banners optimised for different platforms (Instagram, Facebook, Google Ads)?**

Yes. Sivi auto-generates travel banners in platform-ready sizes and ratios, so nothing looks cropped, stretched, or blurry.

#### 8\. **Can I start for free before committing to a subscription?**

Yes. Sivi has a free plan to generate and test travel banners. You can upgrade anytime for more designs and advanced features.

## How to generate an event banner with AI

Want to create stunning event banners in a few minutes? Sivi is here to help you. Simply add your event information, as a prompt or as content, and get unique designs ready to be posted.

#### Create event banners with a prompt

  1. Give your prompt with details about the event name, date, time, images and CTA.

  


  2. Review the ad copy generated. Choose one and click ‘Generate’.

  


  3. Check how Sivi generates stunning event banners within a few minutes.

  


  4. Click on the designs to edit or download them.




#### Create event banner with your content

  1. To start with, choose the size of the event poster design and move to ‘Content to designs’.

  


  2. Type in your content including the event name, date, time, and CTA. Add the required assets.  
  


  3. Click 'Generate' and watch your custom event banners come to life in minutes!  
  


  4. Download and share these creative event banners, and watch registrations skyrocket.

## Frequently asked questions

#### **How to add a date and time to the event poster design?**

Just type the date and time you want directly into the prompt box, and Sivi will include it in your design.

#### **How to choose fonts for the event poster design?**

Select the font style in the preference settings, and Sivi will generate the poster using that font.

#### **Can I design event banners without any design experience?**

Yes. With Sivi AI, you can create professional designs by describing your event and customising the generated results in seconds. Whether it’s a concert, webinar, conference, or festival, you can generate event banners that fit the event’s tone.

#### **How quickly can I get multiple banner designs for one event?**

You can generate 2 to 4 variations almost instantly, helping you move quickly from event planning to event promotion.

#### **Can the event banners match my brand’s colours and typography?**

Yes. Just upload your brand kit in Sivi to keep all banners consistent and on-brand.

#### **Will I get event-ready headlines, visuals and CTA suggestions too?**

Yes. Sivi suggests 4 engaging titles, subtext, CTA’s and visuals per output that fit your event’s purpose and audience, and you can replace them anytime with your own assets.

#### **Can Sivi create event banners in Spanish, French and Arabic?**

Yes. Sivi supports 72+ languages, including Spanish, French and Arabic. Select the preferred language, input your prompt, and get banners in seconds.

#### **How do I avoid event banners that look generic or overused?**

By creating multiple unique, editable design variations with Sivi instead of relying on standard template tools.

## How to create a hospital banner with AI?

Whether you have a vague design idea or specific banner content, Sivi AI has got your covered. You can easily create stunning hospital banners in 2 simple ways.

#### Generate hospital banners with a prompt

  1. Enter the prompt with healthcare banner details such as dimensions, contact info and brand assets to proceed.

  


  2. Review and choose your preferred ad copy from the generated ones.

  


  3. Click ‘Generate’ to see how Sivi generates eye-catching banners instantly.  
  


  4. Click on a design to edit and download.




#### Generate hospital banners for your content

  1. Choose ‘Content to Designs’, pick your dimensions, and click proceed.  
  


  2. Add the content including hospital service details, contact info, brand assets, and hospital images.  
  


  3. Tap 'Generate' and get template-free healthcare poster designs within a minute.  
  


  4. Select your designs, edit if needed, and download them. Share the medical banners and grow.

## Frequently asked questions

#### **How to add a hospital logo to design content?**

You can upload and attach your hospital logo in the prompt box, and Sivi will include it in your design.

#### **How to add colours to customise the hospital banner designs?**

Simply enter your hospital’s brand colours as hex codes in the prompt box, and Sivi will apply them consistently across your banner designs.

#### **How to create a healthcare LinkedIn banner?**

Choose the LinkedIn banner as dimensions in Sivi. Add content along with your hospital brand assets including logo, images, and colors. etc. Hit generate and get your healthcare LinkedIn banner ready in seconds.

#### **Can I try hospital banner generation for free before scaling?**

Yes. Sivi offers a free plan to create and download banners; upgrade when you need more generation credits and advanced features.

#### **Will the hospital banner design follow my brand and compliance rules?**

Yes, upload logo, fonts, colours, and compliance notes once in Sivi’s Brand Kit; every generated banner automatically applies those rules.

#### **Can Sivi create clinical yet patient-friendly banner copy for different departments?**

Yes. Sivi generates clear, easy-to-understand headlines and CTAs for healthcare audiences, and from one prompt, it creates multiple editable variants for departments like ER, OPD, cardiology, paediatrics and more.

#### **Are the banner images and exports good enough for publishing?**

Yes. Sivi uses high-resolution assets and provides exports in PNG, JPG, PDF, and HTML to avoid blur or pixelation.

#### **Can I localise hospital banners for different languages?**

Yes. Sivi supports 72+ languages to help you generate localised banners for diverse patient populations.

## How to make free summer banners with AI?

Whether you have full content or just a concept, Sivi AI makes designing your summer sale banner a breeze.

#### Generate summer banners with a prompt

  1. Start with a prompt, including details like banner dimensions, sale offers, brand, and colors.  
  


  2. Review and choose a generated ad content and visuals.

  


  3. A click on ‘Generate’ button will start generating summer banners instantly.

  


  4. Customize if desired, then download and share your summer sale banner!




#### Design summer sale banners for your content

  1. Go to ‘Content to Designs’. Set your preferred banner size.

  


  2. Enter your summer sale details, discounts, brand elements, and vibrant summer visuals.  
  


  3. Tap 'Generate' to get custom, eye-catching summer sale banners in just a few minutes.  
  


  4. Choose your favourite designs, make any final edits, and download. Share your banners to captivate and attract customers!

## Frequently asked questions

#### **What is a summer sale banner?**

A summer sale banner is displayed on websites and social media platforms, with striking summer-themed visuals, bold text, sale details, and coupon codes, along with a clear call to action to boost engagement and sales.

#### **Which tool helps businesses create summer banners without design stress?**

Look for AI tools that combine quick generation + branding + easy edits + free downloads. Sivi fits well here with fast outputs, seasonal styling, brand alignment and free downloads built in.

#### **How to add colours to summer banners?**

You can preset Sivi designs to your brand colours, or open Content editor → Colours & Fonts → Custom pick a palette, and click ‘Replace’ to apply it to all your summer banner generations.

#### **How to add sale and coupon codes to summer sale banner designs?**

You can add sale details or coupon codes by typing them directly into the prompt box in Sivi. Just mention your offer (like “50% off”) or your coupon code (like “SUMMER24”), and Sivi will include them in your summer sale banner designs.

#### **Can Sivi AI create summer banners in different sizes for social, website, and ads?**

Yes. Sivi supports all popular social media platform posts, ads and website dimensions to avoid manual resizing. You can also generate designs for custom sizes.

#### **Why do Sivi-generated summer banners look unique, not templated?**

Sivi uses a prompt-based AI generator that creates fresh compositions with summer palettes, typography, and layouts tailored to your brand, unlike editing preset templates.

#### **Can I generate multiple summer banner variations quickly?**

Yes. With the Sivi AI design tool, one prompt can produce multiple summer banner options that you can refine or export for campaigns.

#### **How fast can I launch a full summer campaign with multiple banners?**

With Sivi’s instant generation and quick edits, you can build a batch of ready banners in minutes instead of days.

## How to generate a car wash banner with AI

Create captivating car wash banners with AI in minutes. Simply add details about your car wash business and let Sivi generate eye-catching designs to promote your business.

#### Create car wash banners with a prompt

  1. Add a prompt with details of your business/service including the types of washes, other services, your USP, banner size etc.  
  


  2. Add brand assets, images and click ‘Generate’ to get the banner content suggestions.

  


  3. Select one and proceed with the designs. Sivi instantly generates multiple design options.

  


  4. Click on the designs to edit or download them for posting on social media.




#### Create a car wash banner with your content

  1. To start with, choose the size of the design and head to “Content to Design”.  
  


  2. Type in details of your business/service including the types of washes, other services, pricing, your USP, etc. Add images and an appropriate CTA.  
  


  3. Click ‘Generate" and watch unique car wash banners show up in minutes.  
  


  4. Download your stunning car wash banner designs and share them everywhere! Drive in more customers and watch your business shine!

## Frequently asked questions

#### **How to add a list of services under a package in the car wash banner design?**

Just type the list of services directly in the prompt box. Sivi will include them in your banner.

#### **How to add an offer and a coupon in the car wash banner designs?**

Type your offer and coupon code in the prompt box, and Sivi will place them in the design.

#### **How do I attract more customers with my car wash banners?**

Use bold visuals and clear offers in your audience’s language. Sivi lets you create on-brand, scroll-stopping, multi-language banners fast with no design skills needed.

#### **Which tool helps car wash owners design without stress or extra cost?**

Prompt-based AI design tools like Sivi are built for fast, affordable banner creation without complexity. Start for free and upgrade as you grow.

#### **I need to promote weekend offers quickly. How do I make banners fast?**

Skip slow design processes with template tools and heavy, complex software. With Sivi, you can create and download banners in seconds.

#### **Can I add my logo, colours, and pricing without complicated editing?**

Yes, Sivi lets you apply brand elements like logo and colours easily using its brand kit feature. You can edit your pricing details within Sivi’s in-built design editor.

#### **I want the same design for the shop banner + social media. Is that possible?**

Yes, Sivi supports all social media and custom sizes. You can reuse the same prompt to generate multiple sizes and keep your campaign consistent.

## How to generate conference banner with AI

Whether you're organizing a tech summit, business conference, or industry event, Sivi AI simplifies your promotional design process. You can effortlessly create impactful conference banners in 2 simple ways.

#### **Generate conference banners with a prompt**

  1. Enter the prompt with conference banner details, dimensions, images, contact info and brand assets to generate copy.  
  


  2. Select your preferred ad copy and visuals if required from the generated ones.  
  


  3. Click ‘Generate’ to see how Sivi generates eye-catching conference banners instantly.  
  


  4. Select a design to edit, download and share quickly.




#### Generate conference banners for your content

  1. Login to Sivi and go to content editor. Select the required conference banner design size.  
  


  2. Add your conference banner content including the event name, date, assets, venue, and CTA.  
  


  3. Hit 'Generate' and get your conference poster ready in minutes.  
  


  4. Download and share the template-free conference banner creatives to amplify registrations.

## Frequently asked questions

#### **How to add multiple conference speakers to the banner?**

Add conference speakers’ details including their images, names, and designations to Sivi’s content editor. Sivi will automatically try to group and place them consistently in designs. You can also select Groups in the top right of the content page to group the content blocks.

#### **How to add date, time, and venue details in Sivi-generated conference banners?**

You can simply type your prompt when starting generation, or open Sivi’s content editor, type ‘/’, and choose the ‘Date/Time’ block to add date and time details. To include venue information, select the ‘Contact’ content block.

#### **Should I pay to test Sivi’s conference banner designs?**

No. You can start for free. Generate, edit, download, and explore free conference banners on Sivi.ai before paying for plans. Upgrade to budget-friendly plans for more designs and features.

#### **How much time does Sivi take from the prompt to download?**

Very little. Once you enter your prompt, select assets and sizing, Sivi generates conference banners in seconds. Then you can review, edit, and download immediately.

#### **Can I generate banners in multiple sizes and apply my brand style?**

Yes. Sivi lets you create banners in various custom sizes and personalise them with your brand colours, fonts, and visuals using brand kit set-up features.

#### **Can I edit or refine a generated design?**

Yes. After generation, you can use Sivi’s built-in editor to update text, swap images, adjust colours or layout, giving you full control over the final banner while still saving time.

#### **Are Sivi-generated conference banners safe for commercial use?**

Yes. You can safely use the banners for conferences, events, promotions, and marketing material.

## How to make sale banner for free using AI?

No matter if you have a complete idea or just a spark of inspiration, Sivi AI makes designing your sale banners effortless.

#### Generate sale banners with a prompt.

  1. Enter your sale banner prompt, discounts, coupon codes, brand assets and CTA into the prompt field to get ad copy.  
  


  2. Once the ad copy is ready, choose one and proceed to generate designs.

  


  3. Sivi generates multiple design variations, customised just for your ad copy and brand assets.  
  


  4. Download and share template-free sale banner across platforms to boost your sales.




#### Generate sale banners with a content.

  1. Go to ‘Content to Designs’. Set your preferred banner dimension.  
  


  2. Add your sale details including the images, discounts, coupon codes, and CTA.  
  


  3. Click generate and get multiple design variations for your sale banners instantly.  
  


  4. Download and share stunning sale ads & banners to drive sales.

## Frequently asked questions

#### **How to add Sale/Offer to sale banner designs?**

To add a sale or offer, just type the offer details directly in Sivi’s prompt box, like “50% off,” and Sivi will include it in your sale banner design.

#### **How to add contact details and social media links to the sale banner?**

Just type your contact details and social media links directly into the prompt box in Sivi. Add your website, phone number, email, and any social platforms you want included, and Sivi will place them in the banner.

#### **Why are Sivi’s sale banners unique from templates?**

Sivi generates fresh sale banner designs from your prompt and brand details, so each banner is unique, not a repetitive template.

#### **Will the sale banners match my brand automatically?**

Yes, upload your logo, fonts, and colours once into Sivi’s Brand Kit; every generated sale banner will use those elements for consistent branding.

#### **Can Sivi create sale banners in the exact sizes I need for ads and socials?**

Yes. Sivi produces platform-ready sizes for most of the popular platforms like Facebook, Instagram, Google Ads, web and more automatically, eliminating manual resizing or cropping. Also supports custom dimensions.

#### **How to create multiple sale banner variants with different copy and CTAs quickly for A/B testing?**

From a single prompt, Sivi creates 2 to 4 layout and copy variations tailored to your campaign, so you can test and also help save you time and improve conversion focus.

#### **Can I start for free and scale later if I need more banners?**

Yes. Sivi offers a free plan to create and test sale banners, with upgrade options for additional credits and advanced features.

#### **Do I pay for every banner download?**

No. Sivi uses design credits to generate banners, not download limits. You can edit and download generated banners multiple times at no extra cost.

## How to generate furniture store ads with AI

Want to showcase your furniture in style? Sivi makes it pretty easy. Just enter a prompt or type in your content and get stunning designs ready to share.

#### Create furniture banners with a prompt

  1. Type in a prompt input mentioning the product range, contact info, and an appropriate CTA.  
  


  2. Add an image that showcases your product and proceed to generate ad copies.

  


  3. Choose your ad copy and click ‘Generate Designs’ to get the furniture banners in just a few minutes.

  


  4. Want to edit or download the designs? Click on them and customise as you wish.




#### Create furniture banners using your content

  1. Choose the design size and proceed to “Content to Designs”.

  


  2. Furnish details such as product range, contact info, etc. Add images and an appropriate CTA.  
  


  3. Click ‘Generate’ and get your furniture banners in just a few minutes!  
  


  4. Download your fresh furniture banners and watch your sales grow!

## Frequently asked questions

#### **How to add a website to the furniture banner design?**

You can add your website by entering the details directly in the prompt box in Sivi.

#### **How to remove the background of a furniture image?**

You can do it inside Sivi, no extra tools needed. Just upload your furniture image and click ‘Remove BG’ in the content editor.

#### **Which tool is best for furniture store owners to create stress-free banners?**

A prompt-based AI design tool like Sivi makes creating furniture banners simple, fast, and free.

#### **How do I stand out from my competitors?**

Choose an AI that creates unique, fresh furniture banners instead of repeating templates. Sivi does this in seconds.

#### **How do I add my showroom name, logo, and pricing easily?**

Sivi’s Brand Kit lets you auto-apply your name, logo, and pricing to every design. You can also update prices or offers instantly without complexity.

#### **Can I create the same design for Instagram and WhatsApp?**

Yes, Sivi has preset dimensions and supports all popular social media platforms to generate quick designs without manual resizing or starting from scratch.

#### **I don’t know AI design tools. Can I still make professional banners?**

Yes, Sivi is a simple text-prompt-based design tool that uses generative AI to design banners automatically. No AI design skills needed.

#### **How quickly can I launch an offer banner for a festive or seasonal sale?**

With Sivi, you go from idea to banner in seconds. Type your prompt, pick assets, and Sivi creates 2 to 4 ready designs. Edit, A/B test, download, and launch your campaign fast.

## How to make a sports banner with AI

Create banners for sports team announcements, player recognition, fundraising events, and season celebrations that are unforgettable in just a few steps.

#### Generate sports banners with a prompt

  1. Add your sports banner size and event details as a prompt in Sivi AI.

  


  2. Provide your sports event assets, such as images, logos, colours, etc., and get a design copy.

  


  3. Click ‘Generate’ for multiple personalized sports banner designs.

  


  4. Choose your favourite banner and make any final adjustments, download it, and get ready for digital use.

## Frequently asked questions

#### **Can I create a custom sports banner for any sport?**

Yes, Sivi AI can generate a custom sports banner for any sport. Football, cricket, basketball, marathon, school sports day, gym tournaments, basically any sport can be turned into campaign visuals in seconds. Customise dimensions, font styles, images, colours, button styles, background, themes, languages and more.

#### **Do I need AI prompting and content writing experience to make a sports banner?**

No, Sivi is designed for everyone. You don't need any prior AI prompt or content writing experience to create a professional sports banner. Copy suggestions, images and sporting CTAs are auto-generated to match the event tone like motivational, competitive, or hype-driven.

#### **Why AI-generated sports banner over template tools?**

Sivi AI generates sports banner designs almost instantly, allowing you to get your visuals ready in seconds. Instead of fixed templates, banners are created based on your input, making them feel unique, contextual, and audience-ready.

#### **How do I design high-impact sports banners without design skills?**

You just describe your idea like sport type, team colours, event vibe, and Sivi AI handles layouts, typography, and visuals, making banner creation quick, even for non-designers.

#### **Can I export Sivi designs for free?**

Yes. Sivi designs can be exported in high-quality PNG, PDF, JPG and HTML formats, suitable for event banners, posters, social ads, and web promotions without losing clarity for free. Upgrade for more designs and advanced features to pocket-friendly plans anytime.

#### **How do I maintain my team or sports event branding consistently?**

Brand colours, logos, fonts, and style can be applied across every banner automatically using Sivi’s brand kit feature, keeping uniformity without manual editing.

#### **Can Sivi create action-focused, energetic sports visuals?**

Yes. Sivi-generated designs follow your design preferences set in settings. The design engine prioritises sports-driven layouts, bold typography, stadium aesthetics, and modern graphics, perfect for sports promotions.

#### **Is Sivi suitable for teams, coaches, event organisers, and sports marketers?**

Yes. Designed for anyone promoting sports like teams, academies, leagues, gyms, colleges, tournaments, and community events without extra effort.

## How to make a football banner with AI

Whether you need football banner ideas for your team, school, or business, our AI football banner generator makes it easy to generate multiple, eye-catching visuals in minutes.

#### Generate football banners with a prompt

  1. Add your football banner details, like team names and game dates, as a prompt in Sivi AI.

  


  2. Provide your event assets, such as images, logos, colours, etc., and get a design copy.

  


  3. Pick one from the generated football poster ideas that match your team's colours and energy level.

  


  4. Our football artificial intelligence tool generates multiple ready-to-use banner options in seconds.

## Frequently asked questions

#### **What makes a good football poster design?**

Clear messaging, bold visuals, and strong team colours that stand out even in fast scrolls make a great football poster design. Sivi with its brand kit feature helps you bring all of this together in seconds.

#### **Can I create football banners in different languages?**

Yes, Sivi AI works with over 72+ languages to create football banners for international teams and diverse communities, while maintaining professional typography and layout.

#### **What sizes can I create for my football banner?**

With Sivi, generate custom banners for any purpose - from small social posts to large football advertisement posters. Banners are created in formats that work perfectly for Facebook, Instagram, Twitter, and other platforms.

#### **Do the Sivi-generated football banners follow sports design aesthetics?**

Yes. Sivi-generated designs follow your design preferences set in settings. Designs can be personalised by including stadium themes, sports elements, bold typography, club colours, and high-energy layouts suited for football audiences.

#### **Can I create multiple design options quickly?**

Yes. Input one prompt in Sivi, and get multiple football banner options generated in seconds, so you can choose, edit, or A/B test them quickly.

#### **Are the banners customisable by team colour and identity?**

Yes. Sivi’s brand kit feature allows you to generate designs for particular team’s colours, logos, slogans, and player images to match team identity or club branding.

#### **How long does it take to create a football banner?**

Usually seconds with Sivi. You go from idea to finished banner in 3 simple steps. Type prompt, choose assets, generate banners.

## How to make a music cover art with AI

Getting the right music cover picture for your tracks, albums, or playlists is effortless with Sivi AI.

#### Generate music cover art with a prompt

  1. Enter your music details like track name, genre, and preferred dimensions into Sivi AI as a prompt.  
  


  2. Upload your music brand elements, including logos, photos, colour schemes, or any existing music assets.  
  


  3. Sivi generates multiple music cover art options based on your input and music style.  
  


  4. Select your preferred design and make quick adjustments. Download your music cover design ready for streaming platforms.

## Frequently asked questions

#### **What makes a good music cover art?**

A standout music album cover art from Sivi, uses your brand elements like font styles, brand colors, and simple visuals that reflect your music and stay sharp as a thumbnail in busy feeds.

#### **What size should my music cover art be?**

Most streaming platforms require square covers at 1400 x 1400 pixels minimum and PNG or JPEG is the preferred file format. Sivi’s preset dimensions automatically generates your music cover art**** for all major platforms.

#### **Can I create music banners in different languages for free?**

Yes, Sivi AI works with over 72+ languages to create music banners for global audience completely free. Just type in your preferred language in the prompt and get ready-to-use multilingual music banners.

#### **Does Sivi generate text and title typography along with artwork?**

Yes. Sivi generates artwork along with smart typography, title placement, and layout, so your cover looks complete, not unfinished.

#### **Is Sivi fast enough for frequent music releases?**

Yes. Sivi generates cover art in seconds, making it ideal for artists who release singles, remixes, or albums regularly.

#### **Can I customise the designs after generation?**

Yes. Every output can be edited, refined, and personalised to match your brand, artist image, or release concept.

## How to make an album cover with AI

Whether you're an independent artist, podcaster or part of a music band, getting the right cover art for album has never been easier.

#### Generate album cover with a prompt

  1. Start with album details, like name, genre, and size, as a prompt in Sivi AI.  
  


  2. Input your brand assets, such as images, logos, colors, and illustrations.  
  


  3. Sivi AI will instantly generate multiple cover options for your album cover based on your input.  
  


  4. Choose your favourite design and make any final adjustments. Download your custom album cover ready for release.

## Frequently asked questions

#### **What makes a good album cover?**

A good album cover blends visual impact with a clear reflection of your audio and genre. With Sivi, you can create album covers that stand out even in small, crowded feeds.

#### **Which tool is best for independent artists who release frequently?**

Sivi helps musicians quickly produce designs themselves that are consistent, on-brand visuals for singles, EPs, and full albums anytime, anywhere.

#### **Can I use the album cover for commercial purposes?**

Yes, all album cover photos created with our AI generator come with free commercial usage rights. Use your designs on streaming platforms, online releases, social media posters, and promotional materials.

#### **Do I need design skills to use the album cover maker?**

No, Sivi is designed for everyone. You don't need any prior design experience to use the album cover maker. Sivi AI understands music aesthetics and generates appropriate visuals that match your style and preferences.

#### **Can I use my artist name, logo, and title easily on the cover?**

Yes, Sivi lets you add your artist name, adjust logo placement, and choose title fonts that match your album’s style.

#### **I don’t have a design budget. Can I still get high-quality covers?**

Yes, Sivi makes professional album covers affordable. You get high-quality visuals without spending. Start for free and upgrade as you grow.

## How to make a plumbing banner with AI

Crafting a clear and appealing banner that highlights your plumbing services is as simple as fixing a leaky pipe with Sivi. Our AI understands your business needs, helping you produce designs that are both professional and inviting.

#### Generate plumbing banner with a prompt

  1. Enter your details like plumbing company name, services offered, and contact information as a prompt in Sivi AI.  
  


  2. Upload your business logo, brand colors, and any images you want to include.  
  


  3. Sivi AI instantly generates multiple plumbing shop banner designs based on your input.  
  


  4. Pick your favourite design and make any final tweaks. Download your ready-to-use AI plumbing banner for your website, shop, or marketing campaigns.

## Frequently asked questions

#### **What makes a good plumbing banner?**

A good plumbing banner clearly shows your services, contact information, and builds trust with a professional design. Sivi generates template-free banners that look polished, even if you have no design experience.

#### **Is Sivi affordable for small plumbing businesses?**

Yes, Sivi offers professional-looking designs at a fraction of traditional design costs. Start for free and upgrade to more features as you grow.

#### **I want to promote discounts on plumbing services. How do I design banners fast?**

Just type your offer in a prompt, and Sivi instantly generates ready-to-post discount highlight visuals that attract customers.

#### **Can I use the plumbing banner for my business marketing?**

Yes, all plumbing banners created with Sivi come with full commercial usage rights. Use them on your website, social media, and local advertising.

#### **Can I create a plumbing banner for specific services or a specific region?**

Yes, Sivi AI can create a plumbing banner tailored to services like leak repair, drain cleaning, installations, and more, in over 72+ languages. Just enter your prompt, and Sivi does the rest.

#### **How can I keep my banner designs consistent every month?**

With Sivi’s brand kit, you can reuse the same logo, colour, and layout for a consistent brand look for all your plumbing banner needs.

## How to build a construction banner with AI

Whether you run a small contracting business or manage large construction projects, building effective construction company ads is effortless with Sivi AI.

#### Generate construction banner with a prompt

  1. Input your construction banner needs, including project type, services offered, company branding, and preferred dimensions as a prompt in Sivi.  
  


  2. Upload your company logo, project photos, or specific colour schemes you want featured.  
  


  3. Sivi AI instantly generates multiple construction poster designs tailored to your specifications.  
  


  4. Select your preferred design and make any needed adjustments. Download your professional construction marketing material ready for immediate use.
