## Frequently asked questions

#### **What should I include in my construction company banner?**

A construction company banner should feature your company name, key services, contact information, and high-quality project images that demonstrate your work quality. Achieve this in seconds using Sivi AI.

#### **Can I create banners for specific construction services?**

Yes, Sivi generates targeted banners for roofing, electrical, plumbing, general contracting, and other specialised construction services easily.

#### **Do I need design experience to make professional construction banners?**

No design skills required. Sivi provides preset dimensions for common banner sizes, built-in editing tools, and a brand setup feature for your construction business so that every generated design looks professional.

#### **I often change offers and contact details. Do I need to redesign everything?**

No. With Sivi, you can easily update text, pricing, or project info without starting from scratch.

#### **How can I ensure brand consistency across multiple construction projects?**

Sivi’s brand kit feature keeps your logo, colours, and typography consistent in every new design.

#### **Is it possible to design bilingual or regional language banners?**

Yes, Sivi supports 72+ multiple languages, so you can create banners that connect with your local audience.

#### **How can I save time while managing multiple site promotions?**

## How to make a restaurant banner with AI

A restaurant marketing agency or restaurant owner/manager can use Sivi easily to design everything from restaurant opening banner designs to restaurant promotion banners in 72+ languages and multiple sizes without hiring expensive designers.

#### Generate restaurant banner with a prompt

  1. Tell Sivi what type of restaurant banner you need, like daily specials, combos, or promotional offers, as a prompt.  
  


  2. Upload your restaurant logo, menu photos, and brand colours to maintain consistency.  
  


  3. Sivi generates multiple restaurant banner design options instantly based on your requirements.  
  


  4. Pick your favourite design, make quick edits if needed, and download your ready-to-use restaurant banner.

## Frequently asked questions

#### **What makes an effective restaurant banner?**

Sivi generates effective restaurant banners with clear messaging, suitable colours, fonts, food deals, specials, coupon codes, appetising food photos, and consistent branding that matches your restaurant's style and attracts your target customers.

#### **Can I create banners for specific restaurant types?**

Yes, Sivi handles everything from Italian restaurant poster designs in Italian language to cafe poster ideas, vintage restaurant poster layouts, restaurant hiring posters, and restaurant safety poster requirements, all generated in seconds.

#### **How can I design restaurant banners that increase walk-ins and online orders?**

Focus on irresistible food visuals, clear offers, and simple CTA’s. Sivi automatically builds these into your designs to publish online.

#### **I run multiple branches. Can I make banners for each location easily?**

Yes, Sivi lets you duplicate and customise banners per branch by editing names, offers, and contact info quickly.

#### **How do I keep my restaurant branding consistent across all my ads?**

Use Sivi’s brand kit to save your logo, colours, and fonts, ensuring every banner matches your restaurant’s identity.

#### **I don’t have professional food photos. Can Sivi still design good banners?**

Absolutely. Sivi suggests copyright-free AI visuals and layout suggestions to make your banner look delicious and premium, even without photoshoots.

## How to make a food banner with AI

From food businesses and vendors to pantries, trucks, and culinary creators, creating a custom food banner is simple with Sivi AI

#### Generate food banner with a prompt

  1. Describe your desired food banner, including the type of food, occasion, style, and size as a prompt.  
  


  2. Upload any specific images, logos, or brand colours you want to include.  
  


  3. Sivi AI will instantly generate multiple food banner designs based on your input.  
  


  4. Choose your favourite design and make any final adjustments. Download your custom food banner ready for use.

## Frequently asked questions

#### **What makes a good food banner?**

A good food banner features appetising visuals, clear text, and a design that complements the food and brand's style while keeping your brand recognisable.

#### **How quickly can I get an Italian food banner design ready?**

Sivi generates multiple language food banner designs in seconds. With support for 72 + languages, your food banner can reach a diverse audience, diverse food specialities and diverse food recipes with a click.

#### **Do I need design skills to use the food banner maker?**

No, Sivi is user-friendly for everyone. You can create professional food banner designs without any prior design experience with its various helpful features like preset dimensions for all major platforms, in-built design editor, brand kit set up and library of free images.

#### **Is it affordable for small cafes and cloud kitchens?**

Yes. Sivi gives professional-quality food banners in seconds, at a fraction of what designers or agencies charge.

#### **How can I promote food delivery or takeaway offers quickly?**

Just type your offer or delivery message in Sivi’s prompt bar; AI generates banners that highlight your specific services instantly using relevant visuals, buttons and highlight elements.

#### **I want my food banner to match my restaurant’s brand style. Can I do that?**

Yes, upload your logo, fonts, and colours in Sivi’s brand kit and keep every banner generation consistently branded.

#### **I run seasonal food offers. How fast can I update my banners?**

With Sivi, you can instantly change prices, dishes, or discounts using editable text fields; no redesign needed.

#### **How do I make my food banners look more tempting to customers?**

Use vibrant colours, close-up shots, and contrast-driven layouts. Sivi helps you generate mouth-watering designs automatically with AI.

## How to make a holiday banner with AI

Getting the perfect holiday banner design for your seasonal campaigns has never been easier with AI.

#### Generate holiday banner with a prompt

  1. Enter your holiday details, like occasion, message, and banner size, as a prompt in Sivi AI.  
  


  2. Upload your brand assets, including logos, colours, and any specific holiday images you want to include.  
  


  3. Sivi generates multiple holiday banner options instantly based on your requirements.  
  


  4. Select your preferred design and make adjustments if needed. Download your custom holiday banner ready for your campaign.

## Frequently asked questions

#### **What elements make a good holiday banner?**

A good holiday banner combines festive imagery, seasonal fonts, eye-catching colours, and your brand elements to capture the holiday spirit while keeping your brand recognisable.

#### **Do I own the rights to use these holiday banners commercially?**

Yes, all holiday banner images created with Sivi come with commercial usage rights. Use them freely for marketing campaigns, websites, social media, and promotional materials.

#### **What sizes work best for holiday email campaigns?**

For a holiday banner for email, standard sizes like 600 x 450 px or 600 x 250 px work well. Sivi creates banners customised for all major platforms and ensures they display correctly across all devices.

#### **How do I keep my holiday banners on-brand while adding a festive touch?**

Upload your logo and brand colours once in Sivi’s brand kit, and Sivi applies them automatically across all your seasonal holiday designs.

#### **Can I quickly switch from a Christmas to a New Year campaign?**

Yes, with Sivi, you can edit text, visuals, or themes instantly and refresh your banner without starting from scratch.

#### **Can I generate banners for the website, email, and social media together?**

Yes, Sivi supports multiple formats and sizes. You can use the same prompt to generate website banners, email visuals, and social media posts one by one, ensuring your holiday banners look perfect everywhere.

#### **Is it affordable for small businesses running holiday promotions?**

Yes. Sivi provides high-quality holiday banners at a fraction of the usual design cost. Start free, upgrade later.

## How to make a car banner with AI

Auto shops, dealerships, and car enthusiasts spend countless hours perfecting their services, but creating professional banners is just seconds away with Sivi.

#### Generate car banner with a prompt

  1. Start with your banner details, like car business type, car services, and banner size requirements, as a prompt in Sivi AI.  
  


  2. Input your brand assets, such as logos, colors, and any specific car images you want to include.  
  


  3. Sivi will instantly generate multiple car banner options based on your prompt.  
  


  4. Choose your favorite design and make any final adjustments. Download your custom car banner ready for display.

## Frequently asked questions

#### **Can I use the AI car banner for commercial purposes?**

Yes, all car banners created with our AI car banner generator come with free commercial usage rights. Use your designs for car repair banners, dealership display ads, and online promotional materials.

#### **How quickly can I get my custom car banner design ready?**

Sivi generates 2 to 4 car banner design options almost instantly, allowing you to have your designs ready in seconds.

#### **What kind of design customisation can I do for my car banner?**

With Sivi, you can customise various aspects like text, colours, images, sizes, font, language and overall layout to ensure your car banner perfectly matches your car business brand.

#### **Can I design multiple banner options at once?**

Yes, Sivi creates multiple unique layouts from one prompt, helping you choose your favourite design quickly.

#### **What kind of car businesses can use Sivi’s car banner generator?**

Sivi suits all types of businesses like car washes, auto repair shops, detailing centres, tyre dealers, and car showrooms. Sivi helps car-related businesses design professional banners affordably and efficiently.

#### **Can I update my offers or prices easily on banners?**

Yes, you can edit and refresh your offers anytime using Sivi’s in-built design editor and brand kit features.

## Why use an AI design generator for digital marketing?

AI design tool such as Sivi can help marketing teams to streamline design process, spark creativity, iterate faster and optimize the results.

  * **Stand out:** Each template-free custom marketing visuals are generated based on your content and brand guidelines, letting you stand out from your competitors.  
  


  * **No more creative blocks:** Overcome creative roadblocks with a constant stream of fresh design ideas. Sivi turns your idea into multiple visuals and spark new possibilities to help refine your vision.  
  


  * **A/B testing made easier:** Multiple banners are created in each generation, allowing effortless A/B testing and campaign iterations.  
  


  * **Maintain brand consistency:** Ensure your marketing designs adhere to your visual identity by adding brand guidelines such as colors, fonts and even your button style to brand kit.  
  


  * **Faster Designs:** Add your content and brand assets, and generate multiple design variations within a minute.  
  


  * **Easy edits:** Edit the generated designs in just a few clicks and download them in a tap.

## How to generate marketing designs with AI?

Turn your content ideas into captivating marketing designs with the generative AI design tool.

  1. Log in to Sivi and enter your marketing idea as a text prompt.  
  


  2. Select design dimensions, language, and the number of variations, and add your brand assets, such as your logo, images, and colours, to proceed.

  


  3. Choose from Sivi’s suggested copies and assets or add your own content via the Content editor.

  


  4. Click 'Generate' to create designs instantly, edit them if needed within Sivi before downloading and sharing.

## Frequently asked questions

#### **Will my marketing visual get flagged as AI-generated?**

No. Sivi creates original designs based on your brand and content. It learns your style from your likes and dislikes, so the designs feel authentic, not AI-generated.

#### **Do I need to learn complex AI prompting to get good results?**

No. Sivi works with simple text input and your brand assets. Just type what you need, and Sivi handles all the design complexity automatically.

#### **Do I need to switch multiple tools for copy and designs?**

No, Sivi handles everything in one platform. Create copy, generate designs, edit in-app, and export multiple file formats. No switching between tools or paying multiple subscriptions.

## Business visual designs for small business owners

Sivi helps you design engaging ads and visuals that grow your business while keeping costs low and returns high. Here’s how.

  * **Facebook ads:** Small business owners prioritise Facebook ads. Use Sivi to design Facebook ads that grab user attention, highlight promotions, and drive clicks, helping your small business reach thousands of potential customers easily.  
  


  * **Instagram posts:** With a rising customer base on Instagram, create Instagram visuals in seconds with Sivi that not only engage users but also showcase your products effectively to increase sales.

  


  * **Display ads:** With Sivi, make display ads that attract local customers, promote special offers, and increase foot traffic or online orders for your business.  
  


  * **LinkedIn posts:** Design LinkedIn visuals using Sivi to highlight your expertise, share success stories, and connect with the right audience to grow partnerships and leads.




Other than these social media platforms, you can design banners for email marketing, Whatsapp text promotion, branding materials, community marketing and more with few clicks using Sivi.

## Why AI design is a necessity for small business owners?

AI tools make design easier and more cost-effective for small businesses, helping them grow and stay profitable.

  * **Automate design generation:** Sivi uses your design preferences and one-time brand setup to create consistent, on-brand visuals automatically, letting you focus on your business.  
  


  * **Unique designs:** Create and test multiple unique design variations with Sivi for A/B testing and optimisation, making it easy to test and find what works best for your business.  
  


  * **Latest designs:** With Sivi, get design copy, asset suggestions, and GPT-generated content, so you can create visuals seamlessly in one place.  
  


  * **Reduced design costs:** Traditional graphic design can be time-consuming and expensive. Sivi offers scalable, budget-friendly plans, making professional-quality design accessible for small businesses.  
  


  * **Professional-looking designs:** Even with no design skills, Sivi helps you create polished, marketing-ready visuals that stand out. Compete with larger businesses by presenting your brand professionally across all channels.

## How to generate designs for small businesses using AI?

Small businesses are on equal footing with larger brands when it comes to AI-generated designs, thanks to Sivi’s fast, easy-to-use and cost-effective platform.

  1. Log in to Sivi and enter your text prompt with the design dimensions, variations, language, brand images, logo, and colours.

  


  2. Choose from generated content and asset suggestions, or add your own content via Content Editor.

  


  3. Click ‘Generate’ to create designs in seconds.

  


  4. Tap a design to edit, download it, and start promoting your small business.

## Frequently asked questions

#### **Can I afford an AI design tool with a limited marketing budget?**

Yes. Sivi saves you money by replacing costly tools subscriptions, giving you writing, design, and editing all in one affordable platform.

#### **Can Sivi handle last-minute design creation?**

Yes. Sivi creates professional designs in under a minute, ideal for urgent campaigns, flash sales, moment marketing or sudden marketing opportunities.

#### **Will AI designs make my business look unprofessional?**

No. Sivi produces unique, branded, template-free designs that reflect your business authentically and meet professional standards.

## Promote your content with instant visual designs

As a content creator, you will be using some of these visual designs to enhance views for your content.

  * **YouTube Thumbnails:** They're like mini-billboards for your video content, and creating effective thumbnails is an important skill for any YouTuber. A good YouTube thumbnail design entices viewers to click on your video.  
  


  * **Social media posts** : The visual stories you share with your followers in social media should grab attention, spark conversations, and grow your audience. A well-designed Instagram post, Facebook post and LinkedIn post will stop the scroll, spark conversations, and achieve your engagement goals.  
  


  * **Blog covers** : These are the first things readers will see in your blog posts. So, they need an attention-grabbing visual design to create an admirable first impression in the readers.  
  


  * **Email newsletter header** : In today's overflowing inboxes, how do you make your email newsletter stand out? The solution lies in a creatively designed newsletter header.

## How to generate visual designs using AI?

Stop starting from scratch or staring at blank canvases. Just give Sivi your content, and get professional designs instantly.

  1. Log in to Sivi, enter your idea, and choose design dimensions, language, and number of variations.

  


  2. Upload your brand elements like images, logo, and colour to stay on-brand.

  


  3. Proceed with Sivi’s suggested copies and assets, or add yours via the Content editor.

  


  4. Click ‘Generate’ to create visuals, then edit, download, and share them instantly.

## Frequently asked questions

#### **Will I lose creative control over my visual content with AI generation?**

No. You stay in charge with full creative control. Sivi just speeds things up with design variations, in-app editing, and learning your preferences all within seconds.

#### **Will AI affect my authenticity or brand voice?**

No. Your style and voice stay yours. Sivi adapts to your preferences, making design faster without changing your brand.

#### **How does Sivi fit into my current workflow?**

Easily. Sivi fits right into your workflow, avoiding creative blocks, tight deadlines and version issues. Create visuals anytime, edit, download and share them easily with your team.

  1. Start typing your text prompt into Sivi. Specify your design dimensions, variations and language preferences.

## Frequently asked questions

#### **Can I predict and control Sivi AI design generation?**

Use the **Behind The Scenes (BTS)** play button to see how Sivi composes each element, applies brand guidelines, and responds to your content. You will understand how your settings, preferences, and asset inputs in Sivi influence future design generation, making Sivi AI behaviour predictable and easy to control.

#### **Can I edit specific elements in Sivi-generated designs?**

Yes. Sivi creates layered, editable designs, letting you modify specific elements without affecting the overall layout. You can experiment with prompts, adjust settings, and generate 2 to 4 variations per output.

#### **Can I export design or integrate Sivi's designs with other AI workflows?**

Yes, Sivi exports designs in multiple formats like PNG, JPG, PDF and HTML. Layered, editable outputs can be used in other AI workflows or other creative tools. With Sivi’s API and UI SDK, you can generate copy and branded creatives at scale within your application, automating your creative production.

## AI Design features for digital marketing agencies

Sivi helps digital marketing agencies create professional designs faster while managing multiple clients efficiently.

  


  * **Brand setup** : Keep logos, fonts, colours, and brand guidelines neatly organised for each client. Switch between workspaces instantly and maintain brand consistency across campaigns.

  


  * **Bulk generation** : Generate 2 to 4 banner variations per output in seconds. Sivi supports 72+ languages too. Scale seasonal promotions, product launches, and ongoing campaigns in minutes instead of days.

  


  * **Editable designs** : Edit every element of generated designs to incorporate client feedback, and roll back versions easily to refine campaigns without starting from scratch.

  


  * **No watermark** : Deliver designs with your agency branding. Generate ready-to-share previews that streamline client approvals and showcase campaign ideas.

With Sivi, generate template-free unique social media creatives within minutes to help social media marketers quickly respond to the evolving market and engage with audience.

  


  * **Content marketing:** Creating compelling visuals to complement the written piece can be difficult for content marketers because of the lack of design expertise. Leverage Sivi’s easy-to-use AI graphic design tool to turn content into stunning banners for blogs, gated content or any digital marketing channel.

  


  * **Display advertising:** In the search of higher ROI for every dollar, ad specialists constantly carry out A/B tests, iterate and optimize the digital ad creatives. With Sivi, generate multiple unique banner ads to conduct A/B testing and optimize the conversion while also diminishing ad fatigue.

  


  * **Email marketing:** Sharing information through newsletters and promoting offers with email banners that scale and capture attention can be challenging. With Sivi, you can create compelling visuals for everything from general communication to promotional campaigns.




  


  * **Stay unique:** With millions of visuals produced daily, standing out is tough. Sivi creates template-free, unique designs in custom sizes, tailored to your content and brand style.

## How digital marketing agencies can generate designs using AI?

Blank canvas, creative block and tighter deadlines? Sivi is your graphic design assistant for seeking design inspirations, generating compelling copy and quick design iterations.

  1. Log in to Sivi and enter your marketing idea as a text prompt.  
  


  2. Select design dimensions, language, and the number of variations, and add your brand assets, such as your logo, images, and colours, to proceed.

  


  3. Choose from Sivi’s suggested copies and assets or add your own content via the Content editor.

  


  4. Click 'Generate' to create designs instantly, edit them if needed within Sivi before downloading and sharing.

## Frequently asked questions

#### **Will AI replace the agency designer?**

No. Sivi acts as a creative assistant, handling repetitive tasks like design variations, multi-language designs, brand assets application and copy generation, so your team can focus on strategy and creativity.

#### **How do I reduce endless client revisions of brand assets?**

Sivi applies brand guidelines to designs, delivering on-brand drafts from the start, reducing revisions. All design elements are fully editable within Sivi.

#### **How do I justify design costs to clients?**

By showing value in speed and volume. Sivi generates 3+ design options in seconds, proving ROI in the very first meeting.

## AI design features for e-commerce product promotions

Sivi helps ecommerce businesses of any budget to create professional marketing visuals that drive sales and increase conversions. Here's how.

  * **Product background removal:** Clear cluttered backgrounds from product images within Sivi. Create professional product photos that clearly highlight your items, making them perfect for website listings, social media posts, and advertising campaigns.

  


  * **High content banners:** Break free from template limits with full control over content hierarchy. Instantly design promotional banners like sale highlights with prices, deal banners with coupon codes, limited-time offers with terms, or flash sale alerts that drive urgency and boost conversions.  
  


  * **Multiple dimensions:** Instantly generate e-commerce visuals in every dimension you need. From Instagram stories and Facebook ads to website banners and email headers, create brand-consistent designs with preset sizes that save time and keep your look cohesive.

  


  * **Multiple language banners:** Grow your reach and connect with shoppers in their own language. No manual translations needed. With Sivi, e-commerce brands can create banners in 70+ languages. Simply choose your language, and your design copy is generated instantly.




  


Beyond these core features, you can create e-commerce category banners, seasonal themed visuals, inventory clearance designs, and moment marketing materials with just a few clicks using Sivi.

## Why use AI design tool for ecommerce banners?

Globally, there are more than 12 million e-commerce stores, and the number is consistently growing. This means increasing competition for your online business. In addition to this, seeing a customer step into your digital store only to click away due to a lack of compelling and clear visuals can be even more daunting. With Sivi, the generative AI design tool, you can transform your e-commerce store into a visually stunning online destination.

  


  * **New product launch:** Craft striking email banners and social media posts that pique customer interest and drive results for your product launch campaigns.

  


  * **Promotion and sales:** From New Year discounts to end-of-the-season deals, create stunning designs that drive sales during holidays and promotional periods.

  


  * **Category and product management:** Optimise your online store for conversion with category banners and product banners that scale across your marketplace

  


  * **Retargeting:** Win back past customers with compelling retargeting ads and email banners, and reconnect your brand with them.

  


  * **Stand out:** Using generic banner templates risks a lack of originality. With Sivi, you can generate unique, template-free visuals tailored to your content, product photos, and brand guidelines, making you stand out from the competition.

  


  * **On-brand designs:** Save time creating branded visuals. With Sivi, add your prompt and brand guidelines to generate compelling copy, product images and generate custom banners within minutes. Furthermore, Sivi Visualizer makes it even easier to extract content from your e-commerce product pages.

  


  * **Designs to optimise:** Sivi helps you make visuals for all platforms. From Instagram ads to website banners to email headers, Sivi can be your design partner in creating designs of all sizes. With multiple editable designs per generation, conduct A/B testing at scale and optimise your conversion.

## Frequently asked questions

#### **How can I keep designs consistent during high-volume seasonal sales?**

Sivi generates multiple banners in seconds while maintaining brand consistency. Upload your brand guidelines once, and they’re automatically applied across all seasonal sale banners.

#### **Can I keep my designs unique even if competitors use AI tools?**

Yes. Sivi adapts to your brand’s style, product images, and brand messaging, ensuring all your designs stay uniquely yours.

#### **Can Sivi adjust designs, colours, and fonts for seasonal shopping trends?**

Yes. Sivi’s ‘Preference’ settings let you change colours and fonts to create visuals that align perfectly with seasonal shopping moods and behaviours.

## AI design features for SaaS marketing

Sivi helps SaaS companies create professional Saas tool marketing visuals that convert prospects into customers and demonstrate product value effectively. Here's how.

  


  * **Screenshot enhancement:** Turn raw product screenshots into polished marketing visuals with professional mockups for desktop, tablet, and mobile. Showcase your software features in a clear, compelling way that highlights value for customers.

  


  * **Product demo graphics:** Create thumbnails and promotional visuals for demos, tutorials, and onboarding. Design engaging covers that boost clicks and help prospects grasp your software’s value instantly.

  


  * **Banners in seconds:** Quickly design free trial banners, limited-time offers, and sale banners with CTAs that drive action. Use urgency-driven visuals to turn visitors into paying customers.

  


  * **Multiple language support:** Sivi supports 72+ languages, so you can design region-specific messaging for Saas webinar banners, Saas product updates, Saas promotional visuals and more without manual translation. Your brand stays consistent while reaching global audiences effortlessly.

## Why use an AI design tool for your SaaS marketing?

Software as a service (SaaS) marketing strategy is evolving rapidly based on changes in channels, trends, and technology. Setting your brand apart across the platforms can play a pivotal role in scaling your SaaS marketing.

Creating customized visual content for your strategy including content marketing, social media marketing, SEO and email marketing can be a key to standing apart and establishing your brand. Sivi, your AI design partner can enable your marketing team to generate unique SaaS banners customized for your brand preferences, channels, and design size.

  


  * **Content marketing:** Producing high-quality visuals for content marketing that aligns with SEO efforts and scales with your blog post, e-book, white paper, newsletter, and webinar can take a lot of effort and cost. With Sivi, generating copy and visual content just requires a prompt and a few minutes.

  


  * **Email marketing:** With limited budgets and resources, it can be challenging for SaaS startups to do product launches, feature marketing campaigns, etc. Sivi’s email banner generator can help you leverage email marketing and generate the best ROI.

  


  * **Social media marketing:** Enhancing brand presence, thought leadership, and engagement on social media such as LinkedIn requires companies to be agile with their communications. With Sivi, turn your ideas into visual content instantly.

  


  * **Community marketing:** While building a community around a brand, engaging banner designs play a pivotal role in webinars, events, podcasts, member spotlights, and product update announcements. Generating such visual content for community building is easier with just a few clicks in Sivi.

  


  * **Stay unique:** While you are continuously innovating and updating your offering to be competitive, your standardised design templates might look otherwise, uninspired. Sivi generates template-free designs for your content and assets, such as screenshots, placing innovation and uniqueness back into your communications.

  


  * **Multiple designs within a minute:** Be it an online marketing campaign on social media, a display ad network, or a marketing email, an A/B test can help you optimise. With Sivi, you can easily generate multiple design variations for multiple design sizes in minutes.

  


  * **On brand banners:** Designing multiple creatives with consistent brand identity, including fonts, colours, and button style, might be difficult. However, on providing the brand guidelines, Sivi will adhere to them and generate brand-aligned designs.

## Frequently asked questions

#### **Do I need to switch between multiple tools for copywriting and design?**

No. Sivi integrates copy generation and design in one platform. You can create compelling copy and corresponding designs without the need to switch between different tools, streamlining your workflow and saving time.

#### **Is Sivi adaptable to various marketing channels and dimensions?**

Yes, Sivi supports the creation of marketing visuals across multiple channels and dimensions, including Instagram stories, Facebook ads, website banners, and email headers. Download designs in PNG, JPG, HTML and PDF.

#### **Can I edit the designs generated by Sivi?**

Yes. Sivi’s designs are fully editable in-app, allowing you to adjust layouts, text, colours, and other elements to fine-tune your visuals exactly how you want.

While Canva integrates AI for image generation, it falls short on design generation. Canva's Magic Design replaces templates, instead of generating business visuals. Sivi, an AI design generator, generates unique and instant designs for your content.

## Approach

Canva is a design platform that offers a range of design templates and tools for creating a variety of visuals.

  


Sivi, goes beyond templates and uses artificial intelligence (AI) to instantly generate custom designs, such as banner ads and social media posts, based on the user's input and preferences.

  


To know about how Sivi compares with top AI design models, checkout the state-of-the-art of [generative AI for graphic design](../blog/generative-ai-for-graphic-design-sivi-cole-deepfloyd-sdxl-dall-e3) article.

## Benefits

An effective visual plays a great role in your campaigns, from gaining attention to driving clicks and everything in between. Let’s compare how Sivi and Canva can help you with creating such unique designs, and drive eyeballs and revenue for you.

**Stay unique**

Canva primarily relies on pre-designed templates and thus the designs created using it may look similar to your competitor. With Sivi, the designs are generated based on the provided content and brand guidelines, rendering unique compositions for you to stand out.

**Instant design**

With Canva, it’ll take a considerable amount of time for you to select a template, stretch your content to fit the template and customize it to fit your brand guidelines. Using Sivi, you can enter your content and brand preferences to generate striking designs in an instant.

**Multiple variations**

With every generation in Sivi, you get around multiple unique design variations, so that you don’t have to start from scratch for the A/B testing.

It’s time for you to explore and find the design tool that adds magic to your designs and brand.

# Canva API vs. Sivi API: Which Design API Should You Use?

If you’re comparing Sivi API and Canva API, you likely want to automate design or give your users the power to automate designs. Both are powerful design tools, but they solve different problems. Let’s break this down so you can determine which one fits your needs.

## Quick Answer

  * **Sivi API** → Best if you want to embed AI-driven design automation and allow your users to generate on-demand designs, with no templates. Ideal for personalizing and scaling visuals with minimal human effort.  
  


  * **Canva API** → Best if you want to embed Canva’s drag-and-drop editor and let users create or customize designs themselves. Ideal for experiences driven by templates.




## What is Sivi API?

Sivi API is an AI-powered design automation tool. Instead of pulling from templates, it uses Large Design Model to create new layouts instantly.

#### **Use Cases**

  1. Marketing Platforms → Auto-generate ad creatives and campaign visuals directly inside your app.

  2. Email Platforms → Generate email banners dynamically and insert them into email templates.

  3. Ecommerce Stores → Send product details like title, image, and price to Sivi API, and [generate ads](../generate-ads) at scale that are unique and on-brand.

  4. Social Media Tools**→** Auto-generate post visuals for different channels.

  5. LLMs & Agents**→** Let AI agents instantly design visuals as part of broader content workflows.

  6. Website Builders & CMS **→** Offer users automated [hero banners](../usecases/website-hero-banner-generator), landing page creatives, or [blog graphics](../usecases/blog-banner-maker).




#### **Why Sivi API**

  1. 100% AI-generated, not template-based

  2. Scales to thousands of creatives instantly

  3. Optimized for automation, requiring less human input

  4. Excellent for dynamic ads, personalization, and programmatic design




## What is Canva API?

Canva API brings Canva’s famous drag-and-drop editor into your product. It doesn’t generate designs for you. Instead, it provides users with the familiar Canva experience and vast template library.

#### **Use Cases**

Allows users to manually design and edit social posts, presentations, or flyers inside your app.

#### **Why Canva API**

  1. Access to Canva’s massive template library

  2. Easy, familiar interface for end users

  3. Great for collaboration and team workflows

  4. Flexible customization, but requires human input




## Sivi API vs Canva API: Key Differences

### Features

### Sivi API (AI-driven)

### Canva API (Editor-driven)

Design Approach

AI-generated, no templates needed

Template-based, user-driven

Best For

Automation, personalization, scale

User creativity, collaboration

User Involvement

Fully automated

Manual editing required

Customization

Content + brand rules + Advanced editor

Rich editor + templates

Ideal Use Cases

AI designs inside marketing, email, or ecommerce platforms, automated ads, personalized social posts, programmatic design.

DIY design inside apps/marketing platforms

## Which one should you choose?

  * Choose Sivi API if your priority is automation and personalization at scale. You want instant [on-brand visuals](../why/on-brand-visuals) inside your platform.  
  


  * Choose Canva API if your priority is user creativity and collaboration. You want to embed Canva’s editor so users can design themselves.




## Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs)

#### **Is Sivi API better than Canva API?**

They serve different purposes. [Sivi API](../api) excels in automation, while Canva API is better for templates.

#### **Which API is cheaper?**

Pricing depends on usage. Canva follows a SaaS model based on users, while Sivi is more about requests/volume-based. Always compare based on your scale.

## Final Take

  * Sivi API → automation, scale, AI-first design  
  


  * Canva API → collaboration, templates, manual design




  


Both are powerful, but your choice depends on whether you want designs created for users (Sivi) or designs created by users (Canva).

# Adobe Express vs. Sivi: Template Tool vs Generative AI

Design tools are on the rise to integrate AI and make design accessible for everyone. Meet Adobe Express, one such popular template-based design tool and Sivi, an emerging generative AI design tool to democratize design. Let’s explore how Adobe Express and Sivi are different in graphic design approach, capabilities and benefits for businesses.

[Try Sivi For Free](https://instant.sivi.ai/#/generate-designs?source=compare-adobe-express-vs-sivi)

4.8/5

176,000 Brands

72+ Languages

Introducing Sivi Gen-2, an advanced generative AI model for design.

[Know more](../gen2)

Introducing Sivi Gen-2, an advanced generative AI model for design.

[Know more](../gen2)

## Overview

With text to template feature, Adobe Express generates text and images to replace them on design templates. Being an AI design generator, Sivi instantly generates business visuals for the given content and brand guidelines.

## Approach

Adobe Express is a template-based graphic design tool that primarily uses premade layouts and stock images. The text to templates feature allows users to type in a text description of what they want and Adobe Express will generate content and images to replace them in the existing templates.

  


Sivi generates template-free designs based on your content, ideas and brand guidelines, which can be edited and downloaded. The generative AI design tool sparks creativity with relevant and stunning banner designs for given dimensions and brand preferences, in 72+ languages.

### Features

### Adobe Express

### Sivi

Template-free designs

High content volume

Custom dimension

Brand guidelines and styles

Multi-image design generation

Multiple variations

Customization

Collaboration

## Benefits

Sivi and Adobe Express offer different approaches to generating designs. Adobe Express provides templates for customization. Sivi generates designs based on your prompts and brand guidelines. The differing approaches lead to unique benefits for each tool.

**Unique**

In Adobe Express, the content is forced to fit the template instead of brand requirements. As Sivi generates design from scratch, it results in visuals tailored to your brand and lets you stand unique.

**Designs for your brand assets**

As Adobe Express doesn’t have options to update all your brand assets and styles, the generated design lacks visual identity and looks generic and unfinished. With Sivi, you can upload your brand assets and styles including brand colors, typography, and even button styles.

**Faster iteration**

Manually customizing Adobe’s generated templates can take a lot of time. Sivi’s multiple AI banner designs allow quick iteration and A/B testing.

It’s your turn to explore both tools and find the one that expresses your brand better, for real.

# Microsoft Designer vs. Sivi For Graphic Design

Graphic design tools are on the rise to help businesses create professional quality designs, that are impactful and unique while saving time. The two latest emerging design tools are Microsoft Designer, a template-based design tool and Sivi, a generative AI design tool. Let’s compare how these tools help create unique visuals.

Introducing Sivi Gen-2, an advanced generative AI model for design.

[Know more](../gen2)

Introducing Sivi Gen-2, an advanced generative AI model for design.

[Know more](../gen2)

## Overview

Microsoft Designer is a graphic design tool that simplifies generic template sifting, customization and AI image generation.

  


Sivi is an AI design tool, that instantly generates template-free designs customized to your content and brand guidelines.

## Approach

As a template-replacement tool, Microsoft Designer replaces the content in the design templates, making them look generic and unfinished. It relies on pre-made templates and uses AI image creator models to generate and edit images.

  


The AI design generator, Sivi generates completely original and unique banner designs based on the given text, brand assets, and style preferences. With Sivi, you get relevant and stunning visual designs for given dimensions and the brand’s visual identity, in over 72 languages.

### Features

### Microsoft Designer

### Sivi

Unique composition

High content volume

Custom dimension

Adhering to brand guidelines

Direct content input

Template-free designs

Instant designs

Multiple variations

Editable designs

Customization

Image generation

Animation

## Benefits

Let’s compare Sivi and Microsoft Designer in generating visuals for real-time business use cases.

**Stay unique**

Microsoft Designer uses existing templates, replacing images and text based on user-given prompts. Whereas Sivi generates template-free designs that help your business stand out in the sea of generic templates.

**Business visuals for your content**

Microsoft Designer lacks support for high content volume which is often required for real-time business use cases. With content-input engineering, Sivi contextually understands the given content and generates visuals for high content input volume.

**Your brand, your way**

While Microsoft Designer allows brand colors and fonts, brands generally have a lot more preferences in their brand guidelines. Sivi allows you to add all your preferences including button style along with your brand colors and typography.

## Generate visuals that are made for you

As an instant design generator, Sivi is your entire home for designs, not just windows.

## Overview

This document shares ideas to guide the AI Design Generator with effective prompt engineering for generative design. It focuses on detailed and structured prompts to generate high-quality, branded designs for your content across various dimensions and languages. You can explore the example prompts.

This document shares ideas to guide the AI Design Generator with effective prompt engineering for generative design. It focuses on detailed and structured prompts to generate high-quality, branded designs for your content across various dimensions and languages. You can explore the example prompts.

#### Model capability:

  1. Works well for marketing purposes like product promotion, sales announcements, and personal branding. For celebratory content like birthday wishes or party invitations, it's still learning.

  2. Sivi prioritizes giving you control over your designs. That's why it generates designs in layers, allowing for easy customization. This process can take a minute or two.

  3. Sivi is constantly evolving! While some initial designs might not perfectly match your vision, we're always working to improve the model's accuracy.

**Image assets and text** : To generate design using the provided text and image.

## AI Design made easy: A prompt engineering cheat sheet

#### **Assets**

**Supported Asset Types:**

  * **Image** : Use for photos, graphics, or visuals.

  * **Icon** : Use for symbols, UI elements, or small graphical representations.

  * **Logo** : Use for brand identification or business symbols.




  


**Ways to Add Assets:**

  1. **Generate Using Sivi** : Request Sivi to create an asset based on your description.

  2. **Upload** : Use the "upload option" within the chat box and choose the appropriate asset type.

  3. **Provide URL** : Paste the URL of the asset to include it directly.




  


**Image Properties:**

  * **No Crop** : Specify if you don’t want the image cropped.

  * **Remove BG** : Indicate if you want the background removed.

#### **Dimensions**

**Predefined Sizes:**

  * **Ad Sizes** : For various ad formats like half page, skyscraper, rectangle, etc.

  * **Social Media Sizes** : Formats for platforms like Instagram (post), Pinterest (pin), LinkedIn (banner), etc.

  * **Custom Dimensions** : Specify exact sizes for website or specific use cases.

## Tasks performed by the AI design generator for branded designs

This document shares ideas to guide the AI Design Generator with effective prompt engineering for generative design. It focuses on detailed and structured prompts to generate high-quality, branded designs for your content across various dimensions and languages. You can explore the example prompts.

This document shares ideas to guide the AI Design Generator with effective prompt engineering for generative design. It focuses on detailed and structured prompts to generate high-quality, branded designs for your content across various dimensions and languages. You can explore the example prompts.

#### **Prepare design brief**

The first task of the AI Design Generator is to prepare the design brief, a blueprint for your design need. The AI design generator analyses your prompt to create a comprehensive design brief that outlines the following:

The first task of the AI Design Generator is to prepare the design brief, a blueprint for your design need. The AI design generator analyses your prompt to create a comprehensive design brief that outlines the following:

  1. **Identify the purpose:** This task in prompt engineering is to identify the purpose of the design from the initial prompt. This ensures the text generator crafts copy that perfectly aligns with your goals. Currently, Sivi understands various purposes like product promotion, brand awareness, and personal branding. But that's not all – creating birthday wishes, showcasing digital products with device mockups, and designing party invitations are on the way.  
  


  2. **Write content:** Based on the identified purpose, the text generator writes a clear and concise copy using the supported semantic text blocks (title, button, offer, coupon, contact, etc.). Feel free to customize the generated copy or provide your own – Sivi gives you complete control over the final message!  
  


  3. **Choose Dimensions:** Set your size or let the AI Design Generator choose one from popular options such as Instagram post, product banner, YouTube thumbnail, etc. Sivi supports custom dimensions beyond pre-defined aspect ratios such as 1:1, 2:1, etc.  
  


  4. **Add Asset Links:** Upload your brand assets (image, vector, or logo) for a cohesive look in one of the following ways:

     1. Provide Asset URL - You can paste your brand asset URL

     2. Generate Assets - Generate one with the image generator, copy the image address, and provide that in the prompt.

     3. Upload assets - Upload an image and submit. Once submitted, right click on the image, copy the image address and provide that in the prompt.  
  


  5. **Add colors:** Provide brand colors or let the AI design generator choose an appropriate palette for you.  
  


  6. **Set Language:** Choose the language for your design (_Sivi supports 72 global languages!)._




#### **Generate designs**

Once you prompt the AI Design Generator to submit the design brief, it combines all the gathered information into a structured JSON and submits the design brief JSON to the Sivi API to generate customizable designs. The API adds the request to a queue and responds back with the following:

  1. Behind-the-scenes view of generation

  2. A link to view the behind the scenes of the design generation process.

  3. Estimated wait time based on the queue.




Once the generation is complete, you can click on the designs to customize them further in a design editor.

Once you prompt the AI Design Generator to submit the design brief, it combines all the gathered information into a structured JSON and submits the design brief JSON to the Sivi API to generate customizable designs. The API adds the request to a queue and responds back with the following:

  1. Behind-the-scenes view of generation

  2. A link to view the behind the scenes of the design generation process.

  3. Estimated wait time based on the queue.




Once the generation is complete, you can click on the designs to customize them further in a design editor.

Here's a quick walk through of how you can use Sivi AI Designer to generate designs.

## Troubleshooting prompts and responses of Sivi AI Designer

**Request not submitted:** If the AI design generator says the request has been submitted without calling the API, just prompt it to submit the request properly. **Example prompts:** “Can you submit the request properly?”, “Can you generate the designs?” 

  


**Image URL issues:** Ensure the image URL for uploaded/generated images is correct. If it throws as error, right-click on the image and copy the address before adding it to the prompt.

  


**Incorrect design links:** If you receive dummy design links, prompt Sivi to submit the request properly and provide a valid link.

  


**Insufficient credits:** If the API throws an error due to insufficient credits, [buy credits](https://instant.sivi.ai/#/billing/add-payment-info) and resubmit the request.

## Get your questions about the AI design generator answered

#### **I submitted a request, but, I didn’t get the designs.**

It might be because of one of the following reasons:

  1. Generation failed (review the design brief json).

  2. Generation request not submitted properly (resubmit)




#### **I asked for three variations, but, it generated only one.**

You might not receive all requested variations if some designs fail during generation.

#### **Why does the generation fail sometimes or throws error?**

Error might be because of invalid URLs or parameters passed in the design brief JSON. You can [report them](mailto:support@sivi.ai).

#### **How many credits do I get?**

Free users get 10 recurring monthly credits (increasing with paid plans). For influencer or educator programs, contact [Sivi support](mailto:support@sivi.ai).

#### **Why don’t the designs appear instantly?**

Sivi processes the design brief, analyses your content, and then generates the designs from scratch, it takes a minute or two (we are working to reduce the time).

#### **Can it generate carousels and adapt across devices?**

Not at the moment. It’s in our roadmap.

# Content Engineering, Not Prompt Engineering!

## What is Content Engineering?

Content Engineering is where creativity meets simplicity, turning words into captivating visuals effortlessly with Sivi! Here’s a quick look at some of the cool things you can do to add great content.

#### Write your copy

Type your marketing copy in your language to get that turned into multiple visuals.

#### Upload assets

Upload your logos, product images, photos, etc. or choose from the stock images.

#### Group blocks

Choose related blocks such as features, speakers, etc. and group them together.

#### Add hierarchy

Select text to make it bold or change the hierarchy of a text block.

#### Highlight content

Mark primary assets and text to highlight important information.

#### Change semantics

Sivi auto-identifies the semantic of each block. You can change them as you wish.

[Try It Now](https://instant.sivi.ai/#/generate-designs?source=sivi-content-engineering)

Always remember, better the content input, better the generated designs.

# Claude Design vs Sivi AI: Why HTML generation is not free-form design generation (2026 Comparison)

# Claude Design vs Sivi AI: Why HTML generation is not free-form design generation (2026 Comparison)

# Claude Design vs Sivi AI: Why HTML generation is not free-form design generation (2026 Comparison)

Updated On:

Updated On:

Jun 23, 2026

Jun 23, 2026

Sona

Sona

Design, Generative AI, Comparison

Design, Generative AI, Comparison

## TL;DR: Claude Design vs Sivi AI in one minute

Anthropic's Claude Design and Sivi AI look similar, but they generate two different things. Claude Design is a Large Language Model (Claude AI), writing responsive HTML, CSS, and Javascript. Sivi AI is an Large Design Model (LDM) generating free-form, layered, editable graphic designs on a pixel canvas. You can edit text in both, but only Sivi lets you freely move, resize, rotate, crop, and overlap elements as design layers. Claude Design belongs with Framer and Webflow for websites, prototypes, and slide decks. Sivi's Design Studio belongs with the work you'd do for ads, social posts, posters, banners, and thumbnails. The test that separates them is the second click: edit the text, then try to drag it.

—

Last week I pitched Sivi to an investor. I told her [Sivi's LDM](../large-design-model) generates free-form, editable, on-brand designs in 72+ global languages.

She said, "Sona, Claude Design does that now". That's based on her recent experience creating a presentation with Anthropic's Claude Design. She said "I'll show you", and shared her screen to prove it. She clicked the headline in her deck and edited the text in place. "See? Editable. On-brand. Done."

I asked her to do one thing. Move the headline text two pixels up.

She couldn't. Not because she didn't know how, but because Claude Design's output doesn't work that way. That single drag is where the difference between an LLM generating HTML and an LDM generating a free-form design becomes visible.

This post is about that difference, why it matters, and what each tool is actually for, with the facts checked and the easy comparisons resisted, because Claude Design is genuinely good at what it's built for.

  


## What's the Difference Between Claude Design and Sivi AI?

**Short answer:** Claude Design produces a website artefact (code that a browser renders). Sivi AI produces a design file (layers on a canvas with coordinates). One is built on a document tree of <div>s, the other is built on free-form layers of pixels. That foundation decides what you can and can't do after the first generation.

Everything below is downstream of that one fact.

  


  


## Claude Design vs Sivi AI: Quick Comparison Table 

Capability| Claude Design (Anthropic)| Sivi AI  
---|---|---  
**Underlying model**|  LLM (Claude Opus, current generation)| LDM: Large Design Model (Gen-2.7)  
**What it outputs**|  Live HTML / CSS / JavaScript| Layered, vector-based design file  
**Core unit**|  The `<div>` in a document tree| The layer on a canvas (x/y, rotation, z-index)  
**Move any element freely**|  No, adjust via chat, inline markup, or tweak sliders| Yes, drag it where you want  
**Resize/rotate / overlap layers**|  Constrained (these are code properties)| Yes, directly on the canvas  
**Crop/pan an image to a focal point**|  No| Yes  
**Add elements from a toolbar**|  No. Re-prompt to regenerate| Yes  
**Typography**|  Your design-system fonts + web fonts| Upload and use any brand font  
**Image masking**|  Limited to basic shapes| Any shape, including custom paths  
**Re-fit across aspect ratios**|  Responsive reflow (web behavior)| LDM re-lays out layers for the new size  
**Languages**|  Multilingual via Claude| 72+ languages, layout composed per language  
**Best output**|  Websites, landing pages, dashboards, prototypes, slide decks| Ads, social posts, posters, banners, thumbnails, emails  
**Sits alongside**|  Framer, Webflow| Generates natively, and allows to edit as in design tolls like Figma or template tools like Canva  
**Editing model**|  Chat + inline comments + adjustment sliders + Canva handoff (Canva handoff is only to add new elements, not to edit the HTML)| Direct layer manipulation on a canvas  
**Access**|  Included in Claude Pro/Max/Team/Enterprise (research preview)| Web app (free + paid), plus REST API and embeddable UI SDK  
**Export**|  PDF, PPTX, HTML, zip, Claude Code handoff| JPG, PNG, SVG, HTML, PDF  
  
  


  


## What does Claude Design actually generate? (HTML, CSS, and JavaScript)

Claude Design generates responsive HTML files. It is actually Claude AI, a large language model, writing code with divs, sections, flex containers, utility classes, a little inline styling. The browser renders the code into something that looks designed. Anthropic launched it in April 2026 as a research preview, and across reviews the consistent description is that the output is live, runnable HTML rather than static images or layered files.

  


### What Claude Design does well 

To be clear about what's good here: this is a real, valuable category. The interface has a chat panel on the left and a canvas preview on the right. It can read your codebase or design system so output stays on-brand, and it hands off cleanly to Claude Code when you want to ship. For a landing page, a dashboard, an app-flow prototype, or a pitch deck, it's genuinely useful arguably one of the strongest AI tools in that lane right now.

  


### Where the HTML foundation hits a ceiling 

The code-first foundation sets a hard limit on graphic-design work:

  * **You can't freely move elements.** Every element sits inside a parent `<div>` in a document tree. There is no x/y coordinate to drag. Asking Claude Design to shift the headline 40px right means rewriting the HTML structure, not nudging a layer. Claude Design does offer inline comments and adjustment sliders for things like spacing and color, but that's guided tweaking, not free placement.

  * **You can't resize or rotate layers directly.** Resize handles do not exist on a `div` the way they exist on a design layer. Width, height, and rotation are properties of code, not handles on a canvas.

  * **You can't drop in new elements from a toolbar.** To add a shape, icon, or text box, you go back to the prompt and regenerate another agentic pass over the whole document.

  * **You cannot crop or pan images to a focal point.** An image is an `<img>` with a source. There's no crop box or focal-point selector to reframe the photo.  
  


  


  * **Typography is bounded.** Claude Design applies the fonts in your configured design system plus available web fonts. You don't get a free per-element font picker across thousands of foundry weights the way a canvas tool gives you.  
  


  


  * **Object placement can clip**. In practice, when Claude Design fits an object into a container, it tends to crop hard against the edges unless the subject is already centered. A designer would scale, center, and add breathing room. Masking is limited to a small set of basic shapes rather than custom paths.  
  


  





None of this is a knock on the model's intelligence. It's the foundation. HTML is brilliant for responsive web pages and the wrong primitive for a fixed-canvas ad where the offer needs to overlap the product photo at a 12-degree tilt.

  


  


## What does Sivi AI generate

Sivi AI generates a layered canvas using an LDM, a Large Design Model purpose-built for graphic design. Every element, text, shape, image, icon, background, sits on its own layer with x and y coordinates, rotation, opacity, blend mode, and z-index. The output is a design file, not an HTML document.

  


### What is a Large Design Model (LDM)?

Where an LLM predicts the next token in a sequence of text or code, an LDM predicts the next design element: its type, position, size, rotation, color, font, and shadow. It composes a layout following design principles like hierarchy, grouping, and contrast, then renders it as an editable, layered file. Its purpose-built for graphic design, the way an LLM is purpose-built for language.

Sivi runs its LDM (currently Gen-2.7) on Google Cloud, Google Kubernetes Engine, and Vertex AI for training, with Gemini integrated for conversational input and translation. The New York Times has noted Sivi as the only one among roughly 95,000 design apps that produces editable layers, which is a useful shorthand for what an LDM does that an image model or a template tool doesn't.

  


### What you can do on a layered canvas: 

  * Move any element anywhere on the canvas.

  * Resize, rotate, overlap, group, lock, and hide layers.

  * Crop and pan images with a focal point.

  * Upload and use any brand font.

  * Mask with any shape, not just circles and rectangles.

  * Resize a 1080×1080 Instagram post to a 1080×1920 story and have the LDM re-lay the layers to fit the new ratio.

  * Work in 72+ languages, with the layout composed so typography and hierarchy hold up in the target language.




The point isn't the plumbing; it's that the output is a free-form design composition, the same layered thing a designer builds in Figma, generated from a prompt. 

  


  


## Divs vs pixels: Why HTML and canvas design are different categories

**Claude Design** belongs in the same family as Framer and Webflow. It's an interface design tool. The unit is the `<div>`, the layout is a document tree, and the output is a website. That is a legitimate, valuable category.

**Sivi** sits in a different category. The unit is the pixel on a canvas, the layout is free-form layered composition, and the output is a graphic: an ad, a social post, a poster, a banner, a thumbnail.

Different foundations, different ceilings. HTML is brilliant for responsive sites and terrible for a 1080x1080 ad with overlapping, tilted layers. A canvas is brilliant for that ad and pointless for a scrolling marketing site. This is why the honest answer to 'which is better' is 'for what'.

  


  


## The Second-Click Test: How to Tell a Document From a Design

Here's the fastest way to tell a document from a design: edit the text, then grab the element and move it. If the layout reflows around your move, you have a document. If the element lands exactly where you drop it, you have a design.

Almost every tool passes the first click: Notion, Canva, Figma, Webflow, Framer, and Claude Design all let you click and edit text. That's why the investor thought the tools were the same. The second click is where they split. Claude Design fails it because there's no free layer to grab; there's a `<div>` in a tree. Sivi passes it, because every element is a layer with coordinates.

  


  


## Does Claude's Canva Integration Make It a Free-Form Design Tool?

Short answer: **No**. But the reason is more interesting than a flat no. There are two routes, and neither one changes what Claude itself generates.

  


### Route 1: The "Send to Canva" export.

Claude Design has a Share/Export menu with a Send to Canva option. What happens next depends on the file type. For simple slide decks, Canva now converts the HTML presentation into a fully editable Canva presentation, with multiple slides and presenter view. For other HTML, Canva imports it as a "Code design." It parses the layout for simple cases, where Claude has generated the HTML in pre-defined formats Canva knows how to read. When the CSS is complex or the format is unfamiliar, you get a render of the code, not a layered file.

That is a real improvement over how this worked at launch, and it is worth being precise about. The editability comes from Canva parsing the HTML on import, not from Claude generating a layered file. It is a conversion step, and it carries the fidelity loss every conversion carries. The design layer is Canva's, not Claude's.

  


### Route 2: The Canva connector (MCP).

Connect Canva to Claude and you can ask Claude to create designs through Canva from chat. Canva returns a design one of three ways: it swaps your text into an existing template, generates a design and decomposes it, or generates HTML and converts that to a design. None of these is a design model doing the work (Canva AI 2.0 deserves its own article). The pattern holds across all three: Canva is the editing layer, Claude is the conversation around it.

So the second-click test still applies. Take a layer Claude produced and try to nudge it two pixels. You are either editing code, or you have handed the file to Canva to rebuild as Canva layers. Claude did not generate a free-form canvas. It generated code, then routed it somewhere that has one.

  


  


## Claude Design: Pros and Cons

  


### Pros

  * Produces real, deployable HTML/CSS/JS, not a mockup.

  * Reads your codebase/design system, so output stays on-brand.

  * Tightest design-to-code handoff in the AI design space (one instruction to Claude Code).

  * Strong at landing pages, dashboards, interactive prototypes, app flows, and slide decks.

  * Included in Claude Pro/Max/Team/Enterprise at no extra cost.




  


### Cons

  * Output is code, not a layered design file; no free-form drag/move on the canvas. No crop/pan focal point; masking and typography are constrained.

  * No native Figma or PNG export.

  * Iteration is expensive (more on this below).

  * For fixed-canvas graphic design, you have to route through Canva's conversion.

  * Still a research preview, with the limits that implies.




  


  


## Claude Design: Pros and Cons

  


### Pros

  * Native LDM output: layered, editable, vector-based designs you control directly.

  * Full canvas control: move, resize, rotate, overlap, crop, mask, group.

  * Brand-kit compliance (your fonts, colors, logos, components).

  * 72+ languages with layout composed per language.

  * REST API and embeddable UI SDK for product teams.




  


### Cons

  * Not a website builder; it doesn't output responsive HTML sites the way Webflow, Framer, or Claude Design do.

  * Built for fixed-canvas graphic design, so it's the wrong tool for a scrolling marketing site or an app frontend.




  


  


## How Much Does It Cost to Iterate a Design in Claude Design?

**For graphic-design work, the cost difference shows up in iteration.** Every meaningful tweak in Claude Design re-runs the agent over the full document and regenerates code. On a subscription, that means you burn through your usage budget faster; at the API level, it maps to Anthropic's published Opus rate of $5 per million input tokens and $25 per million output tokens, and an agent loop re-reads the whole HTML context on every turn. Dragging a layer on a canvas costs none of that. Across a 10-variation ad campaign, the gap is real not because one model is expensive, but because regenerating code to move a button is a different operation than dragging a layer.

  


  


## Claude Design vs Sivi AI: Pricing Compared

**Direct answer:** Claude Design isn't sold separately; it's bundled into [Claude's subscriptions](https://claude.com/pricing), starting at $20/month for Pro. Sivi AI has a free tier and paid plans starting at $16/month (billed yearly). They're priced on different models, so the right question is "what does each charge _for_?"

  


### What Claude Design costs

Claude Design is included with Claude Pro ($17/mo), Max, Team, and Enterprise. There's no standalone Claude Design price as of mid-2026, while it's in research preview. The catch is the usage model: because it runs on Anthropic's Opus model and every iteration reprocesses the whole document, design work consumes your Claude usage allowance quickly. You're not paying per design; you're spending against a shared budget that the same account uses for everything else Claude does.

  


### What Sivi AI costs

[Sivi charges in **credits**](../pricing): one universal unit for generating designs, copy, and images. A typical prompt-to-4-designs run costs roughly 4–5 credits, and Sivi shows the exact cost before each action.

Plan| Yearly (per mo)| Monthly| Credits/mo| Storage| Notable  
---|---|---|---|---|---  
Free| $0| $0| 12| 100 MB| No card; limited dimensions  
Plus| $16| $20| 100| 4 GB| All dimensions, custom fonts, private generation, reseller rights, API access  
Pro| $48| $60| 350| 16 GB| Everything in Plus, headroom for daily output and multilingual campaigns  
Power| $96| $120| 800| 25 GB| Bulk/at-scale plus API access for in-product generation  
Enterprise| Custom| —| Custom| —| SSO, white-label, custom API rate limits, dedicated support  
  
A few details that matter: the yearly billing saves about 20%, the General SDK is free (with separate API pricing for volume), credits reset each cycle and don't roll over, failed generations are auto-refunded, and you can cancel anytime.

  


### Which gives better value for design work

If you already pay for Claude and your output is mostly web pages and decks, Claude Design adds no extra cost; that's its value. But if you're producing graphic-design assets (ads, social, banners, thumbnails) at any volume, a credit-based design tool is more predictable: you can see the cost per run, you don't burn a general AI budget moving a layer, and a free tier lets you test before paying. For teams running campaigns weekly, predictable per-design pricing usually beats spending an Opus usage allowance on regeneration.

  


  


## Best For: When to Use Claude Design vs Sivi AI

If you need…| Use  
---|---  
A responsive website or landing page| Claude Design  
A working frontend prototype to hand to engineering| Claude Design  
A structured HTML document or dashboard| Claude Design  
A pitch deck you'll refine in Canva| Claude Design (Send to Canva)  
A 1080×1080 ad with overlapping, tilted layers| Sivi AI  
Social posts, posters, banners, thumbnails, email creatives| Sivi AI  
The same campaign in 72+ languages, on-brand| Sivi AI  
Design generation embedded in your own product| Sivi AI (API/SDK)  
  
  


  


## Which Should You Choose: Claude Design or Sivi AI?

**Choose Claude Design when the deliverable is a web artifact:** a site, a landing page, a prototype, a dashboard, or a deck. Inside that lane, it's one of the strongest AI tools available, especially if you're already in the Claude ecosystem.

**Choose Sivi AI when the deliverable lives on a fixed canvas and needs free-form, layered, pixel-level control:** ads, social, posters, banners, thumbnails, emails, or when you want to generate that kind of design _inside your own product_ via an API or SDK.

And plenty of teams use both, because they're not really competing: one makes websites, the other makes graphics. The investor saw a UI that looked like graphic design and assumed the capability underneath was graphic design. It wasn't. The moment you ask either tool to do the other's job, the gap shows up in a single drag.

  


  


## Conclusion: HTML Is Not Free-Form Design

The investor wasn't wrong to be impressed. Claude Design _is_ impressive. It turns a sentence into a working, on-brand web page, and for websites, prototypes, dashboards, and decks, that's exactly what you want. The mistake was assuming that because the output _looked_ like graphic design, the tool could _do_ graphic design. It can't, and no amount of better prompting will change that, because the limit isn't the model's intelligence; it's the foundation. An LLM writes code. Code renders into a document. A document is not a free-form design.

That's the whole story in one drag. Edit the text in either tool, and you'll be impressed by both. Try to move the element two pixels and the categories split: a document reflows, a design stays where you put it. If your deliverable is a web page, you want the document to reach for Claude Design. If your deliverable is an ad, a social post, a poster, a banner, or a thumbnail anything that lives on a fixed canvas and needs layers you can move, resize, crop, and overlap you want the design, and that's what Sivi's LDM was built to generate, in 72+ languages, at any size, on-brand, and even inside your own product.

Use the right tool for the job. For most teams, that means both  Claude Design for the site, Sivi for the campaign that runs on it.

  


  


## Frequently Asked Questions: Claude Design vs Sivi AI

  


### Can I just use Claude Design for everything if it's already in my workflow?

For websites, landing pages, and prototypes, yes. For an ad, thumbnail, or poster that needs a fixed canvas with overlapping layers, no. The moment you try to nudge a layer two pixels or crop an image around a focal point, the HTML foundation stops you.

  


### How much do Claude Design and Sivi AI cost?

Claude Design is bundled into Claude subscriptions starting at $20/month (Pro), with no separate fee while it's in research preview. Sivi AI starts free (12 credits/month) and has paid plans at $16, $48, and $96 per month billed yearly (or $20, $60, $120 monthly), plus a custom Enterprise tier.

  


### Does Claude's Send to Canva button bridge the gap?

Partly, and it's improved. For simple slide decks, Send to Canva now converts the HTML deck into a fully editable Canva presentation. For other HTML, it imports as a "Code design" and parses simple layouts, where Claude has generated the HTML in pre-defined formats Canva knows how to read. When the CSS is complex or the format is unfamiliar, you get a render of the code, not a layered file. The editing happens because Canva re-builds the file as Canva layers.  Claude still generated code, not a layered design.

  


### What about connecting Canva to Claude Code via MCP?

That is a different flow. When you prompt with `Canva:`, Canva swaps text into its existing templates. It is template replacement, not free-form generation. Useful for some workflows, separate from what this article is comparing.

  


### Is this an Anthropic-specific limitation, or do all LLM design tools share it?

It's structural to LLMs. Any LLM generates tokens of code. As long as the foundation is HTML, `<div>`s, and a document tree, the ceiling holds no matter which model is underneath. Free-form design needs a different model class and an LDM trained on layered designs as primitives.

  


### What exactly is an LDM?

A Large Design Model. An LLM predicts the next token in a sequence of code or text. An LDM predicts layered design output with element type, position, size, rotation, color, font, shadow. It's purpose-built for graphic design.

  


### What can I make with Sivi AI?

Display and social ads, social media posts, website and ecommerce banners, posters, email layouts, and YouTube thumbnails generated as editable, on-brand, layered designs across 72+ languages and any size, with a REST API and UI SDK for embedding design generation in your own product.

  


### What is a Sivi credit?

A credit is Sivi's universal unit for everything the AI does: generating designs, writing copy, creating images. A typical prompt-to-4-designs run costs around 4–5 credits, and Sivi shows the exact cost before each action. Credits reset each billing cycle, and failed generations are refunded.

  


### Why does iteration cost matter for design edits?

Every tweak in Claude Design re-runs the agent over the full document and regenerates code, which consumes your usage budget (and, at the API level, maps to Opus token rates). Dragging a layer on a canvas costs nothing. Over a multi-variation campaign, that adds up.

  


### Does Sivi do what Webflow and Framer do?

No, and that's the point. Webflow, Framer, and Claude Design make websites. Sivi makes ads, social posts, posters, banners, and thumbnails. Different output, different category. Many teams use both.

  


### Will Claude Design eventually get free-form editing?

Possibly, but that would mean changing what's underneath, not just improving the prompt. Until an LDM sits behind the product, the HTML-vs-free-form split holds.
