# Sivi at the AI Impact Summit 2026: Winning, connecting, and building for what's next

# Sivi at the AI Impact Summit 2026: Winning, connecting, and building for what's next

# Sivi at the AI Impact Summit 2026: Winning, connecting, and building for what's next

Updated On:

Updated On:

Apr 15, 2026

Apr 15, 2026

|

Sona

Sona

|

Team, Updates

Team, Updates

The India AI Impact Summit 2026 was not just another event on the calendar. Inaugurated by Hon'ble Prime Minister Shri Narendra Modi, it brought together global technology leaders, distinguished delegates, and some of the sharpest minds shaping the future of artificial intelligence. For Sivi, it turned out to be a defining moment.

  


We are proud and humbled to share that Sivi was recognised as one of the winning startups at the AI Impact Summit Challenge 2026. Over 50 jury members, CEOs, CXOs, and industry leaders evaluated the participating startups, including our Large Design Model (LDM). The recognition is not just a milestone; it is validation that the problem we are solving matters.

  


### A Vision Aligned with #MANAV

PM Modi's #MANAV vision places humans at the centre of AI. That resonated deeply with what Sivi is built on. Our Human-in-the-Loop architecture ensures that AI decisions remain accountable, ethical, and people-first. We don't believe in replacing designers or marketers. We believe in giving them superpowers.

At Sivi, our mission is to democratise design using our Large Design Model, making on-brand, editable creatives accessible to over 300 million businesses worldwide. The summit reinforced that this mission is not just relevant, it is urgent.

  


### On the Ground: Conversations That Shaped Us

Our leads, Meenakshi and Vijayapurani, took full ownership of the Sivi exhibit across the summit. They showed up with clarity, confidence, and consistency—turning conversations into meaningful connections.

The people who walked up to our booth made every hour feel earned:

  * **Agencies** looking to cut creative production time without compromising quality.

  * **Founders** who needed on-brand creatives at speed and scale.

  * **Government officials** exploring AI-generated design for public communication.

  * **AI enthusiasts** curious about seeing a Large Design Model work in real time.

  * **Students** figuring out their very first business idea and wondering how design fits in.




Every conversation sharpened our thinking. New use cases, new possibilities, and honest proof that Sivi can touch more lives than we had imagined.

###   


### Among Global Leaders

Being at the summit gave us the rare opportunity to connect with leaders who are defining the trajectory of AI globally; Rajan Anandan, Vinod Khosla, Sam Altman, and Demis Hassabis, among others. These were not just photo-op moments. They were grounding reminders of the scale and seriousness of the journey we are on.

  


### What We Came Back With

We returned with more than a trophy. We came back with qualified leads, active customer conversations, government connects, and most importantly, a fire that is hard to put into words.

The summit made it clear: the world is ready for a design engine that thinks, not just renders. A model that understands brand system, generates layered and editable creatives, and fits into real workflows.

  


### What's Next: Sivi Gen-3

We are launching **Sivi Gen-3 for General Availability** soon; a fully editable, layered design generation model. Gen-3 represents composing intelligent, multi-layered designs that marketers and agencies can actually use.

If the India AI Impact Summit was a signal, this is our answer.

  


### Thank You

A heartfelt thank you to the jury, Anna Mam, and the entire organising team for the platform and the recognition. Thank you to our partners, investors, and mentors; Turbostart, Jeff Damodaran (Dan), NASSCOM, who continue to believe in what we are building.

Encouraged and back to work.

Sona & Ram, Co-Founders, Sivi

  


  


  


——

### Author: Sona J Odayappan

Sona is the Co-Founder and Chief Design Officer of Sivi, a generative AI that instantly turns text into business visuals. With a distinguished academic background, Sona started her career as an engineer before transitioning to a designer. Over the last 14+ years, Sona has worked with multiple startups and MNCs in diverse sectors and designed over 35 products. She has evangelized design thinking and formed successful design teams from scratch. Sona is a gold medalist, TiE Women Bangalore Entrepreneurs finalist, MeitY Women Entrepreneurs Award finalist, and an author of a popular design portal.

# Sivi: The story behind the Large Design Model

# Sivi: The story behind the Large Design Model

# Sivi: The story behind the Large Design Model

Updated On:

Updated On:

Apr 16, 2026

Apr 16, 2026

|

Sona

Sona

|

Design

Design

[Sivi](../) is a [Large Design Model (LDM)](../large-design-model) that generates editable, layered graphic designs from a text prompt or content. The output is a real design file with separate text, shape, and image layers you can edit element by element, not templates or flat images.

  


Every product has a story. Our story reflects two fundamental things about the product - how it works, and why it exists.

Deep down, we believe in building on solid foundations. That philosophy shaped the generative AI technology behind Sivi, and it shaped the name itself. What is the meaning of the name Sivi? Why was a Large Design Model named Sivi? These are questions we've often been asked. The answers lie in the story of its creation.

  


  


## **Atomic design: the foundation of Sivi**

How does atomic design influence an AI design tool? We built Sivi not only with design in mind, but on design. Specifically, on atomic design principles.

Brad Frost introduced Atomic Design methodology for UI design. We applied it to generative graphic design. The methodology breaks complex design problems into smaller, fundamental components: design atoms. Simple shapes, color palettes, typography. These building blocks combine progressively with increasing complexity to create molecules, organisms, and eventually a complete design.

This is how Sivi's LDM works under the hood. It doesn't predict what a design should look like pixel by pixel. It composes designs from structural building blocks: text layers, image containers, shape elements, brand components. Each block sits on its own layer, and the model understands how they relate to each other. We took the same principle Brad Frost described for UI and applied it to generative AI design.

We find a deep connection between this approach and Lord Shiva. It is said that Lord Shiva's cosmic dance reflects the dynamism of subatomic particles, the very essence the universe is made of.

Just as atoms form the building blocks of matter, atomic design principles form the foundation for Sivi's approach to AI design generation.

And thus, the first pillar of Sivi was laid.

  


  


## **The Sivi way: embracing feminine grace**

Structure alone doesn't make good design. While Lord Shiva represents the power and structure of the atomic world, we also wanted a name that reflected the elegance and creativity inherent in design. That's where the feminine touch comes in.

The name Sivi holds personal significance too. It's the name of a beloved family member, adding a layer of grace on the foundation.

This balance of structure and creativity is central to Sivi's identity. The LDM enforces structure through layout rules, brand kits, and typographic hierarchy. But within that structure, every generation is unique. No two designs are alike. You describe what you need, whether [ads](../generate-ads), [banners](../generate-banner), social media posts, or email headers, and Sivi composes something original each time.

The structure is what makes Sivi reliable. The creativity is what makes it worth using.

  


  


## **Sivi, your AI design partner**

Why build a generative model instead of a template tool? Sivi is a harmonious blend: the firm structure of atomic design principles balanced with creative generation.

We built Sivi to be a partner in the creative process, not a technical curiosity. From the start, we wanted creators to work with the building blocks themselves, not pick from a library of finished layouts someone else made. That meant building a generative model, not a template engine.

You describe what you need. Sivi composes it. You customize both the building blocks (brand colors, fonts, logos, components) and the final output using a simple chat interface and a design editor. The result is always original, always editable, and always yours.

That philosophy is what separates Sivi from [template tools and image generators](../compare). It's not just an AI design tool. It's an AI design partner, built on the belief that the creative process should start with your idea, not someone else's layout.

  


  


## **Can Sivi replace human designers?**

No, and it doesn't try to.

Sivi enhances creativity. It allows anyone to express themselves visually, even without professional design training. You don't need to know how to design. You just need to know what you want to say.

You tell Sivi what you need. A banner for your website. A social media ad for a product launch. A set of display ads in five sizes. Sivi generates a set of options instantly. If you need to change the headline, swap a color, or move an element, you do it directly in the design editor. The Sivi API and SDK let developers build this into their own products.

Sivi simplifies design for non-designers without devaluing the work of skilled human designers. It handles the production work so designers can focus on creative direction.

  


  


## **A design revolution with Sivi**

How do you make design accessible to non-designers? We started Sivi because we believed it shouldn't require years of training or expensive software. Our mission is to make design accessible to everyone.

A solo entrepreneur's social post should look as intentional as a Fortune 500 ad. Sivi makes that possible, whether you're a [marketer](../persona/marketers), a [business owner](../small-businesses), a [content creator](../persona/content-creators), or a [developer](../developer) building design into your product.

And it all begins with an idea, a name, and the belief that design should be for everyone.

  


  


## **Welcome to Sivi**

The name Sivi carries everything we built into the product: the atomic design foundation, the balance of structure and creativity, the personal meaning from our family.

Sivi isn't just a name. It's why we show up to work every day.

Welcome to Sivi. [Try it free.](https://instant.sivi.ai/) Describe your design in words and get an editable, layered result in seconds.

  


  


## **What people ask about Sivi**

#### What does the name Sivi mean?

The name Sivi combines two ideas: the structural rigor of atomic design, inspired by Lord Shiva's cosmic dance and the building blocks of matter, and the grace and creativity inherent in design. It also carries personal significance from the founding team's family.  
  


#### Why is Sivi built on atomic design principles?

Brad Frost's atomic design methodology breaks complex systems into fundamental building blocks. We applied the same principle to generative graphic design. Sivi's Large Design Model composes designs from independent structural components rather than predicting pixels or filling templates. This is what makes every Sivi output editable and layered.  
  


#### Why wasn't Sivi built as a template tool?

Templates start with someone else's layout. You customize within the constraints they set. We wanted Sivi to start with your idea and compose something original every time. That required building a generative model, not a template library. See how Sivi compares to template tools and image generators on the comparison page.  
  


#### Who founded Sivi?

Sivi was co-founded by [Ram](../author/ram), a deep-tech expert with 18+ years in software and 3 patents in NLP and mobile tech, and [Sona](../author/sona), a designer turned entrepreneur with 15+ years designing for startups and MNCs. The founding team's combined expertise in technology and design shaped Sivi's approach to AI design generation.  
  


#### Is Sivi free to try?

Yes. You can try Sivi at [instant.sivi.ai](https://instant.sivi.ai/), no design skills required.  
  


#### Where can I learn more about how Sivi works?

  * The [Large Design Model](../large-design-model) page explains the technology.

  * The [AI design generator](../design-ai) page shows what you can create.

  * The [developer hub](../developer) covers the [API](../api) and [SDK](../sdk) for integrating Sivi into your own product.

# Why LLMs/LMMs cannot generate designs?

Let's do an experiment by generating designs with Gemini Pro and ChaGPT-4 with vision (Dall-E 3) using the below prompt.

`create a WhatsApp promo for my furniture shop Woodlands Furnitures, for an offer of 20%. Give my contact details +1 888 234 5643. Here is my product image to use`

#####   


##### Outcomes from Gemini Pro

  


##### Outcomes from ChatGPT-4 + Dall-E 3

  


##### Outcomes from Sivi

##### Observation

Even though the images by Gemini or ChatGPT have pleasing objects and colors, the designs are unusable as the users have no control over what these models generate and there's no way to edit the layers.

In contrast, Sivi utilizes user-added assets and copy to generate relevant, editable designs.

  


—————————————————————

#### `TL;DR`

  


  1. `LLMs and LMMs excel in various tasks. Their capabilities are more aligned with processing and generating textual content rather than creating visually appealing designs.`

  


  2. `While LLM/LMM can analyze images to a certain extent and answer questions based on them, they lack the aesthetic training and nuanced understanding of design principles required for graphic design tasks.`

  


  3. `Image generation models have constraints such as distorted text, single-layered images, and no support for vector graphics.`

  


  4. `Graphic design requires specialized models like Sivi, COLE, and CanvasVAE.`

  


  5. `Sivi, in particular, generates multi-layered editable designs in multiple languages and supports user-provided assets.`




—————————————————————

  


## Exploring the Limitations of Large Language Models in Graphic Design

In generative artificial intelligence, the capabilities of large language models (LLMs) and large multimodal models (LMMs) like ChatGPT from OpenAI and Google’s Gemini have sparked immense curiosity and innovation. However, while these models excel in various natural language processing tasks, they have limitations when it comes to generating designs. Let’s see why LLMs and LMMs cannot generate designs and why we need specialized models like Sivi.

  


### 1\. Understanding the Role of LLMs or LMMs

Large language models are primarily designed for processing and generating text-based content. They excel in tasks such as language translation, text summarization, and creative writing. LMMs, on the other hand, expand on this capability by incorporating multimodal inputs, including images and text, to generate more contextually relevant text.

  


### 2\. Limitations of Image Generation Models

While LLMs/LMMs can analyze images to a certain extent, they are not inherently equipped to generate designs. Image generation models like DALL-E are specifically tailored for creating images based on textual prompts. However, these models have their own set of limitations:

  * They generate monolithic images from prompts, limiting the incorporation of user-provided assets or logos.

  * Text inputs are often distorted and unreadable, restricting the use of more than a word or line of text.

  * Generated images typically consist of a single layer, lacking the depth and complexity required for intricate designs.

  * These models lack support for vector graphics and cannot providing editable outcomes, hindering the flexibility required in graphic design workflows.  
  





When asked to generate designs incorporating the provided product, logo, and copy, DALL-E advises engaging a professional designer or utilizing a graphic design tool.

  


It explicitly states its inability to analyze images when prompted to extract the dominant color from a given image.

  


Similarly, Gemini clarifies its capabilities, offering to provide copy, direct users to design resources, or give feedback, but it does not have the capacity to generate designs.

  


### 3\. Incompatibility with Graphic Design Tasks

Graphic design encompasses a wide array of skills, including aesthetic judgment, typography, color theory, and composition. While LLMs/LMMs can perform multiple tasks admirably, the nuanced understanding of design principles and aesthetic sensibilities required in graphic design goes beyond their capabilities.

Here’s an excerpt from Microsoft COLE.

  


### 4\. The Need for Specialized Models

To address the limitations of LLMs/LMMs in graphic design, there is a growing need for specialized tools like Sivi, COLE, and CanvasVAE. These platforms are designed with the explicit purpose of facilitating graphic design tasks by leveraging specialized models and datasets. Key features of these tools include:

  * Specialized datasets and models tailored for graphic design tasks.

  * Enhanced support for user-provided assets and logos.

  * Improved text handling capabilities, including readability and flexibility.

  * Multi-layered image generation to enable more intricate designs.

  * Support for vector graphics and editable outcomes, empowering designers to fine-tune their creations.




Read this article to know more about the [state of the art of generative AI in graphic design](./generative-ai-for-graphic-design-sivi-cole-deepfloyd-sdxl-dall-e3).

  


### 5\. The Role of Sivi in Revolutionizing Graphic Design

Sivi's DGDS 1.6 outperforms models like CanvasVAE or COLE by 8 to 10 times in aesthetic scoring. With its focus on design generation, Sivi offers several advantages:

  * Generating visually appealing and contextually relevant designs in infinite dimensions.

  * Utilization of specialized datasets to train models specifically for design tasks.

  * Introducing [content engineering](../content-engineering) to allow the users to add their own copy and assets.

  * Adhering to brand guidelines and generating designs in 72+ languages.

  * Providing designer-friendly customizations with layered designs.




Get ready for the future of design with Sivi Gen-2, an advanced generative AI model!

  


#####   


## Conclusion

While LLMs and LMMs have revolutionized many aspects of artificial intelligence and natural language processing, their inherent limitations make them unsuitable for graphic design tasks. The complexities of design generation require specialized tools and algorithms, such as those developed by Sivi, to unlock the full potential of AI in the realm of visual communication. As technology continues to evolve, the fusion of AI and graphic design promises to reshape the creative landscape, offering new possibilities for designers and enthusiasts alike.

Share your thoughts on this graphic design revolution.

# Generative AI for Graphic Design - Sivi vs Microsoft COLE vs DeepFloyd vs SDXL vs DALLE3 - SOTA and Future

# Generative AI for Graphic Design - Sivi vs Microsoft COLE vs DeepFloyd vs SDXL vs DALLE3 - SOTA and Future

# Generative AI for Graphic Design - Sivi vs Microsoft COLE vs DeepFloyd vs SDXL vs DALLE3 - SOTA and Future

Updated On:

Updated On:

May 7, 2026

May 7, 2026

Ram

Design, Generative AI, Tech

Design, Generative AI, Tech

## Introduction

Graphic design is all about communicating visually and it plays a crucial role in marketing and advertising. Crafting an advertisement, banner, or post involves composing and arranging visual elements such as colors, shapes, images, and type. This process applies design principles like grouping, hierarchy, etc. to effectively convey a message through visual aesthetics.

##### Traditional design tools:

Graphic design experts have been using traditional design tools like CorelDRAW and Adobe Illustrator to craft these visuals. These tools provided designers with manual control over every aspect of their creations.

##### Template tools:

Subsequently, template-based design tools like Canva, Adobe Express, Microsoft Designer emerged, simplifying the design process for individuals with limited expertise. However, the challenge of finding the right template led 96% of users to opt for designing from scratch.

##### Generative AI design tools:

The latest leap in design technology introduces generative design tools, leveraging the capabilities of generative AI. While significant progress has been made in text and image generation, only a few players like Sivi and Microsoft COLE have ventured into developing [design generation models](https://sivi.ai/blog/text-to-design-models-for-layered-editable-graphic-designs). Sivi's models stand out by offering instantly generated layered editable designs that adhere to brand guidelines, setting them apart in the evolving landscape of graphic design.

  


—————————————————————

You might be curious how a 16 people startup can compete with large businesses in the generative AI for design space.

#### `TL;DR`

  


  1. `Abundant data exists online for text and images and image generators like Midjourney, DALLE, produce monolithic images. The lack of structured data coupled with the multifaceted and multi-layered nature of graphic design, presents challenges in solving graphic design through generative AI.`

  


  2. `Template-based design tools like Canva, Microsoft Designer, focus on template search rather than tackling the broader challenge of design generation for any given content. Template replaced designs are neither cohesive nor relevant.`

  


  3. `At Sivi, we built custom models for layered design generation and prepared unique structured design datasets (beyond image and text datasets) to solve editable design generation.`

  


  4. `Sivi follows atomic design principles, composes designs from scratch across infinite dimensions and spanning over 72 languages, following the creative process of a human designer.`

  


  5. `We started the research in 2019 and we are an excellent mix of designers, data scientists, and engineers driven by a passion for disruption and pushing boundaries.`




—————————————————————

  


  


## Generative AI Tools

While text and image generation tools like ChatGPT, Dall-E, and Midjourney have gained prominence, the field of design generation introduces tools specifically tailored for this intricate process.

##### Text Generation Tools:

Notable tools include ChatGPT, Bard, which focus on generating coherent and contextually relevant text.

[Read why GPT5 or Gemini cannot generate designs](./why-gpt4-or-gemini-pro-cannot-generate-designs).

##### Image Generation Tools:

Dall-E, Midjourney, and Stability AI excel in generating diverse and creative images, expanding the possibilities of visual content.

##### Design Generation Tools:

Some image generators with integrated text capabilities contribute to design generation and **COLE by Microsoft** trains and combines the different AI products to generate designs.

Cascaded diffusion models like **DeepFloyd and Ideogram** are very limited with text support and they are not editable.

[Large Design Model by Sivi](../large-design-model) leads the way in generative AI for graphic design, providing users with the ability to create layered, editable designs on demand.

  


  


## Decoding the challenges of Generative AI in Graphic Design

The world of graphic design is intricate and multifaceted, encompassing typography, text composition, ornamentation, and imagery to convey complex thoughts, emotions, and attitudes. Creating top-tier designs demands a high degree of creativity, innovation, and lateral thinking. Unlike text and image data, graphic design requires layered, structured data, making it a more challenging domain for generative AI.

  * **Multifaceted Nature of Graphic Design:** Graphic design involves various elements, including typography, composition, ornamentation, and imagery. Generating cohesive designs requires understanding and integration of these diverse components.

  * **Multi-layered Design:** Unlike simple text or image generation, graphic design involves multiple layers, such as SVG elements, images, and text elements. One unified layer is insufficient to capture the complexity of graphic design.

  * **Element-specific Handling:** Each design element must be handled differently due to different properties. Generative AI needs to adapt and understand the unique characteristics of each component in a design.

  * **Lack of Structured Data:** Unlike text and image data available abundantly on the internet, graphic design requires layered and structured data, posing challenges in training models effectively.

  * **Brand Identity Integration:** Graphic design often involves incorporating brand details and adhering to brand guidelines across various assets, such as banners, posters, and ads.




  


  


## How Sivi navigates the challenges and generates the designs

Sivi adopts a unique approach based on atomic design principles. Breaking down the design problem into smaller pieces and developing models for each with structured data. You can input text, upload images, and add brand details, and ask Sivi to generate layered, editable designs seamlessly.

  * **User Input:**

    * Type the text or generate it using a prompt

    * Upload assets such as photos, logos, or generate images via a prompt

    * Add brand details (colors, typography)

  * **Sivi's Generation Process:**

    * Identifies tone, emotions, and target audience based on content

    * Forms text styles based on semantics

    * Analyzes images and forms image styles based on the analysis

    * Composes designs

    * Adds colors

  * **Result:**

    * Layered, editable designs that align with user specifications and preferences.




  


  


## SIVI Architecture

##### Focus

While existing models like MidJourney, stable diffusion generate images and cascaded diffusion models such as deep-floyd/IF and Ideogram provide some support for image + text generation, they have limitations, usually accommodating only one line of text with minimal editability.

Sivi specializes in design generation. At present, we focus on design generation and we use open source models for image and text generation.

##### Models

Our approach involves employing custom diffusion models and multimodal architectures. We will share more detailed information soon.

##### Dataset

We are preparing dataset from 2019 for various models. In our experience, models come and go, but dataset remains the same. Our dataset sets us apart, serving as a distinctive value proposition and creating a robust entry barrier despite the availability of open-source models.

  1. Layered composition dataset for each style

  2. Colorization dataset

  3. A large vector dataset

“I recently purchased this pink collection and I love it! The quality is so amazing! I will continue to order more items from this store.”

## Limitations of COLE, Image Generators, and Template Tools

##### Limitations of AI Graphic Design Generators

AI Graphic Design Generators such as COLE understands the user intent. But, they are still in the framework phase and have the following limitations:

  1. The arrangement of typography blocks

  2. Limited number of editable visual elements

  3. The restricted diversity in typography color selection

  4. Only supports square dimensions

  5. No support for free text by the user

  6. Inability to upload user images and brand assets




  


##### Limitations of AI Image Generators

Text to image AI tools like DallE3 by Open AI, Midjourney, SDXL, DeepFloyd, among others, excel in image generation but fall short as Generative AI for graphic design, presenting the following limitations:

  1. Generates a monolithic image rather than a design

  2. Does not provide support for free text 

  3. Supports only a few aspect ratios




  


##### Limitations of Template Tools

  1. Template tools like Canva, Microsoft Designer, etc. begin by picking a template and counting the number of text elements along with the character count.

  2. They then use APIs to generate text that aligns with the specified number of elements and characters in the chosen template. It is a template search rather than design generation.

  3. Finally, they replace the existing content in the template with the generated text.




Templates can be replaced only for a limited number of characters. This restricts the users from adding personalized copy, brand assets, and other elements and the final designs will neither be cohesive nor be relevant.

  


  


## Advantages of Sivi over COLE and other GenAI tools

Sivi is an AI design generator, not a template tool or an image generator. It understands user intent and composes designs from scratch like a human designer.

##### Control

  1. Control before generation - Users can add their content-input or edit the generated ones and choose their preferences

  2. Control after generation - fully editable designs and vector layers for seamless customization




##### Predictability

  1. Component based design following atomic design principles

  2. Allows fine-grained preferences

  3. Style cards




##### Personalization

  1. Support for brand assets such as colors, typography, logo, and elements

  2. Full text support with semantic-specific designs like Headline, Contact, Button, Lists and more




##### Practical AI

Business visuals are mostly used by small businesses and this automation will help them use the various layers. Tailored for small businesses, offering automation for various layers in business visuals.

##### Extendable framework

  1. Generates designs for any dimensions and over 72 languages.

  2. We built our rendering engine and models in a plug-and-play model. We will easily be able to extend to other design areas such as newsletters, UI, and HTML generation in the near future.




Sivi is not just a research or a framework, it is a product available in the market.

  


  


## Conclusion

Generative AI for graphic design is rapidly evolving, overcoming challenges to provide users with dynamic designs. Tools like Sivi and Microsoft COLE showcase the potential of AI in transforming the design process, offering layered, editable designs that cater to the unique requirements of graphic design. As research continues to push the boundaries of what is possible, the future promises a more seamless integration of generative AI into the creative landscape, opening new avenues for designers and enthusiasts alike.

Share your thoughts on this graphic design revolution.

Updates, Launch, Recognitions

Updates, Launch, Recognitions

Launching a new product is always a thrilling experience, filled with excitement and uncertainty. This being our first general access launch, the anticipation was at an all-time high.

On June 6, 2023, we took the leap and launched Sivi AI. Our primary objectives were to raise awareness about our product, gather valuable user feedback, and secure 1000 signups. Little did we know that the response would be overwhelming, surpassing all expectations.

In just 8 weeks, our efforts led to the acquisition of over 8,000 users from an impressive 135+ countries. The most astonishing outcome was the generation of an astounding **100,000+ designs** through our app. We were humbled by the enthusiastic embrace of Sivi by the global community.

Curious about the strategies and tactics that paved the way for this? Let's dive into the key elements that fuelled this.

  


  


  


## **The Pre-launch Preparation**

We started our planning one month before the launch date.

  


###### **Defining the Target Audience**

We targeted AI enthusiasts and freelancers to try Sivi for this launch as they are both interested in AI and design and could benefit from the designs [#generatedBySivi](https://instant.sivi.ai/#/feed).

  


###### **Choosing the Launch Channels**

To get the word out about Sivi, we selected two primary channels that are best suited for Sivi based on our target audience:

  1. **Product Hunt:** a great platform for launching new products, as it provides exposure to a large audience of early adopters of AI and design.

  2. **SEO:** for a startup like us, search engine optimization improves the visibility in search engine results pages (SERPs).




  


###### **Creating the Teaser and Launch Pages**

Before the official launch, we created a coming soon/teaser page on Product Hunt and invited users to sign up for early access. This page gave users a sneak peek of what Sivi was all about. We iterated on the messaging until we got it right. We distributed the teaser page across various channels:

  1. Added a Hello bar on our website that linked to our teaser page.

  2. Shared it with our waitlist users to ensure they get priority access.

  3. Did LinkedIn and Twitter outreach.

  4. Our team announced periodically on social media with a countdown timer to inform users when the product becomes live.




We then worked on the launch page content and the product video. The video got 2348 unique views with 14 hours of time played on the day of the launch.

######   


###### **Engaging with the Community**

Our team actively engaged with potential users and the Product Hunt community through discussions and exploring other products. By building genuine connections, we created interest around Sivi, generating curiosity among potential users.

  


###### **Updating the Website**

A website is a product in itself. We gave a fresh look to [sivi.ai](https://sivi.ai/) and updated our content. We also wanted to make sure that our website was up to date with the [launch details](../product-hunt) so that our audience could stay informed about the launch schedule, teaser page, and other important information. Framer Sites played a major role in ensuring that our website remained up to date. It allowed us to make real-time updates to the website seamlessly and publish the changes right away.

  


###### **Testing the Product**

We also made sure to thoroughly test the product and ensure it scaled with the number of users. This was important because we wanted to make sure that Sivi could handle the traffic that we expected to receive after the launch.

  


###### **Ensuring Responsiveness**

Over 35% of traffic came via mobile. So, we optimized for the mobile experience and ensured users could easily generate visuals from prompts on the mobile web.

  


###### **The Power of Behind-the-Scenes Content**

To make the wait time for users interesting, we offered a glimpse behind the scenes of the design generation instead of a boring loading indicator. This created the aha moment for our users and ensured word-of-mouth for Sivi.

  


  


  


## **Launch Day Strategy**

As soon as the product went live on Product Hunt, our team and friends and family engaged with it. We then reached out to potential target groups and asked them to try it out and share their feedback. Their positive feedback spread the word in the circle of the second connection which in turn distributed Sivi to the third network. Once we got the visibility, the product took over. This organic approach led to twice the number of users as the upvotes received on Product Hunt.

  


###### **Dedicated Support and Immediate Fixes**

On the day of the launch, we maintained round-the-clock availability to respond to every comment and feedback. We also swiftly addressed critical experience blockers and bugs within hours.

  


  


  


## **The Results**

We got an overwhelming response from the community! Sivi emerged as the

  * #1 Product of the Day on Product Hunt

  * #1 Product of the Week on Product Hunt

  * #1 Marketing of the Month on Product Hunt




We also got organic endorsements from AI enthusiasts, avid Canva users, Ben’s Bites, Curiosity AI, and multiple communities.

Our brand search increased by over 300%.

  


  


## **What’s Next**

This launch was all about generating visual designs from simple prompts in less than 2 minutes. We've since improved the user experience and added the ability to switch between light and dark themes.

  


#### Next up is [**Sivi Visualizer**](https://chrome.google.com/webstore/detail/sivi-visualizer/lcgbelglgkockldagdjikpjhahdfjfem)

Sivi Visualizer will turn webpages into visual designs instantly.

Stay tuned for more exciting updates!

Sona is the Co-Founder and Chief Design Officer of Sivi, a generative AI that instantly turns text into business visuals. With a distinguished academic background, Sona started her career as an engineer before transitioning to a designer. Over the last 14+ years, Sona has worked with multiple startups and MNCs in diverse sectors and designed over 35 products. She has evangelized design thinking and formed successful design teams from scratch. Sona is a gold medalist, TiE Women Bangalore Entrepreneurs finalist, MeitY Women Entrepreneurs Award finalist, and an author of a popular design portal.

# Why you should not build custom GPT with actions - ChatGPT plugin

# Why you should not build custom GPT with actions - ChatGPT plugin

# Why you should not build custom GPT with actions - ChatGPT plugin

Updated On:

Updated On:

Apr 16, 2026

Apr 16, 2026

|

Sona

Sona

|

Generative AI, Marketing, Design

Generative AI, Marketing, Design

If you are a SaaS business owner or a developer, you might want to think twice before investing in a ChatGPT plugin or custom GPT with actions. Writing this based on our experience with building [Sivi AI Designer plugin on ChatGPT](../chatgpt-plugin-for-design) — the Multilingual AI Designer for your brand and content.

  


  


## Our Experience building the Sivi AI Designer Plugin on ChatGPT

When we developed Sivi’s design generation API, we decided to test it out by creating the Sivi AI Designer plugin for ChatGPT. While the custom GPT with actions served its purpose, it has its own limitations and challenges. Here’s what we learned about creating a custom GPT with actions, what to do and what not to do when building your own custom GPTs with actions.

  


  


## How the AI Designer plugin on ChatGPT works

The Sivi AI Designer plugin we built for ChatGPT allows users to generate designs via [Sivi API ](../api)for design and displays them directly within the ChatGPT interface. Here's how the AI Designer plugin works:

  1. **User Interaction** : Users can initiate the design request by typing the prompt into the ChatGPT interface.

  2. **Design Generation** : The plugin processes the user prompt and forms the design brief. Once the brief is ready, it calls the Sivi API to generate the designs.

  3. **Generated Designs Listing** : Once the design generation is complete, the designs are shown to the user within ChatGPT. Users can download the designs directly or click on any design to edit it further using the Sivi Design Editor.




  


  


## Limitations of custom GPTs and actions on ChatGPT

While custom GPTs with actions offer possibilities, they come with their own limitations.

### Instructions limitations

  * **Clarity required** : Large Language Models (LLMs) naturally take the least resistant path when processing instructions. So, every step in the instructions needs to be crystal clear to avoid misinterpretation.

  * **Character limit** : Custom GPT instructions have a 8000 characters limit, making it challenging to include detailed instructions. The instructions need to be concise.




  


### Knowledge files limitations

  * **Single file limitation** : Uploading more than one knowledge files leads to error though it doesn’t stop the user from using the GPT.

  * **File formats** : Text files work better compared to JSONs or other formats.

  * **Synchronized update:** While updating instructions, sometimes it is necessary that we update the knowledge file as well to ensure that the details in the knowledge files are used.




  


  


### Capabilities and image handling issues

  * **Image generation and handling** : Unlike template design tools, Sivi can generate designs for user-provided content and images. So, we initially enabled all the custom GPT capabilities including, DALL-E Image Generation. But, passing the generated image via actions is not possible. So, we did a work around. We instructed our users to right-click on the generated image and copy-paste the image URL. However, images from the URL are available for download only for a limited time. So, we downloaded and added a mapping to our URL. Not just the images generated by Dall-E, images uploaded by the users cannot be passed as well. We also created a [prompt engineering guide](../prompt-engineering) to assist users with this process.

  * **GPT updates:** Then came a GPT update where they stopped allowing custom GPTs to download the generated or uploaded images. So, we disabled DALL-E Image Generation capability and asked user to share the image URLs for their products, services, or other design elements.




  


  


### Technical limitations

  * **Unreliable Performance** : ChatGPT often experiences downtime or unresponsiveness, which can disrupt user experience.

  * **Exploration Errors** : The "Explore GPTs" feature frequently throws errors, making it difficult for users to discover new GPTs.




  


  


### Discoverability challenges

  * **Review System Flaws** : ChatGPT Plus users can review custom GPTs with actions without actually using them, leading to potentially skewed ratings.

  * **Lack of Distinction** : There’s no clear differentiation between personal GPTs and GPTs with actions.

  * **Discoverability Challenges** : Custom GPTs with actions are hidden in the ocean of GPTs, making it difficult for users to find them. Users need to search to discover or use direct link.

  * **No Listing Page** : There’s no dedicated listing page for custom GPTs. Only top GPTs are easily discoverable. A limited number of six GPTs get listed on featured GPTs. But, the probability of getting there is quite low.




We either need to attract ChatGPT users or bring our users to ChatGPT. 

  


  


### The Canva GPT case study

Consider Canva GPT as a benchmark. Canva has around 200M users, ChatGPT also has around 200M users, and Sam Altman showcased Canva GPT in the Opening Keynote of OpenAI DevDay. Still Canva GPT has only 3M conversations and a 3 star rating from 50K users. If Canva struggles to make a significant impact, it’s worth thinking through the challenges an upcoming SaaS business might face.

By the way, here’s the [comparison between Canva GPT and Sivi plugin](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=M0xTm2pbiA8). While Canva tries to pick templates based on your prompt, Sivi generates designs from scratch in 72+ languages. 

  


## What could ChatGPT do to help SaaS businesses and developers building custom GPT with actions

To better support developers building custom GPTs with actions, ChatGPT could do the following:

  * **Improve Reliability** : Reduce downtime and errors to ensure a smoother experience.

  * **Enhance Discoverability** : Introduce a listing page for custom GPTs to make them easier to find. And provide a filter for custom GPTs with actions.

  * **Refine the Review System** : Ensure that only users who have actively used the plugin can leave reviews.

  * **Refine the Review System** : For GPTs that enable Dall-E Image Generation, provide a way to use it via API.




  


  


## How we overcame the limitations

We ended up building our own in-app chat to overcome all these limitations. Yes, you heard it right.

This allowed us to provide a seamless design experience directly within Sivi, bypassing the issues we encountered with the ChatGPT plugin. More about it on another blog. Meanwhile, you can [experience the Sivi in-app chat for design generation here](https://instant.sivi.ai/) and share your thoughts.

Here’s how it works:

  


  


## Conclusion

Though building the ChatGPT plugin helped us improve our API and build our in-app chat, we faced multiple hiccups along the way. For SaaS business owners, it might be worth exploring other integration options that offer more control, reliability, and flexibility. By understanding the limitations and potential drawbacks, you can make an informed decision about whether building a custom GPT is the right path for your project.

[Email us](mailto:design@sivi.ai) if you’re interested in integrating the Sivi API for design.

## What is a credit?

A credit is Sivi's universal unit for everything the AI does - generating designs, writing copy, creating or enhancing images, and extracting brand info from a URL.

  


Cost depends on the model and size you choose. Sivi shows the exact credit cost before every action, so there are no surprises.

  


As a rough guide, a typical prompt-to-4-designs run on Sivi costs around 4–5 credits.

## Renewal

  * Credits reset on each billing cycle. Unused credits don't roll over.



  * Failed generations are automatically refunded to your credit balance.

  * Top-up credits are valid until the end of your active subscription.

  * Cancel anytime. Your plan stays active until the end of the paid period.

  * Credits will be automatically reset when the subscription renews.

  * **Generates the full design** : Copy, layout, images, and brand colors using its [**Large Design Model**](./large-design-model), not just an image or a template.

  * **Editable layers** : Every text block, image, and shape is editable. The New York Times noted Sivi as the only one of ~95,000 design apps that produces editable layers.

  * **Brand-aware by default** : Drop in your brand kit and every output stays on-brand.

  * **Built for marketers** : Ad creatives, social posts, banners, thumbnails in the right dimensions, on the first try.

  * **72+ languages:** Generate in your customers' language, not just English.

## Frequently Asked Questions

### **Can I use Sivi for free?**

Yes, Sivi offers a freemium plan with 12 credits per month and 100 MB storage, no credit card required. Upgrading unlocks more credits, larger design dimensions, and extra cloud storage.

### **How much does Sivi AI cost?**

Sivi has four plans.

  * Yearly (save 20%): Plus $16/mo, Pro $48/mo, Power $96/mo.

  * Monthly: Free $0, Plus $20, Pro $60, Power $120.




#### **What is a credit and how many does one design cost?**

### **What is a credit and how many does one design cost?**

A credit is Sivi's universal unit for design, content, image generation, and URL extraction. Cost depends on the model and size. A typical prompt-to-4-designs run lands around 4–5 credits. Sivi shows the exact cost before each action.

#### **Can I switch plans later?**

### **Can I switch plans later?**

Yes. Upgrade or downgrade anytime from your account settings. Upgrades take effect immediately with prorated billing; downgrades apply at the next renewal.

#### **Can I cancel anytime?**

### **Can I cancel anytime?**

Yes. Cancel from your account settings. Your plan stays active until the end of the paid period. No cancellation fees.

### **How many designs can I generate at once?**

Sivi lets you pick how many design variations you want to get for each generation. You can generate up to 4 unique designs in one go!

### **What happens if a generation fails?**

If a generation fails, Sivi automatically refunds your credits.

#### **What happens if I exceed my monthly credits?**

### **What happens if I exceed my monthly credits?**

You can either upgrade your plan or buy top-up credits. Top-ups stay valid through your active subscription period. Sivi never charges overages without your action.

### **What payment methods do you accept?**

Sivi accepts payment methods supported by Stripe including Visa, Mastercard, Amex, and others. Google Pay is available in select regions.

### **What's included in the Enterprise plan?**

Enterprise includes custom credit volumes, team seats, SSO, white-label options, custom API rate limits, a dedicated account manager, and MSA/DPA support. [**Contact sales**](mailto:hello@sivi.ai)

## Frequently Asked Questions

#### **What pricing tiers are available for Sivi API integration?**

Sivi offers multiple integration options with distinct pricing models:

  


Simple Client-Only SDK Integration

  * Integrate via an embedded HTML widget.

  * Redirects end-users to create a Sivi account.

  * **Pricing** : Free to all users




  


Simple Server-Only API Integration

  * Use Core API with your API key.

  * Full backend control over user data.

  * **Pricing** : Starts with the Power plan; an API sandbox is available for testing.




  


Client SDK + User Management APIs

  * Combines the UI SDK with user management capabilities.

  * **Pricing** : Starts with the Superpower plan, plus per-user storage costs.




  


Enterprise Integration

  * For high-volume needs (~1,000+ users/month).

  * Includes white-labeling, custom UI themes, staging environments, priority support, and feature development.

  * **Pricing** : Contact sales for tailored packages.




  


See the [API documentation](https://developer.sivi.ai/) for more details.

#### **Which plan do I need for Core API access?**

To use the Core API endpoints such as generate designs from prompts, check job status, you must be on at least the Power plan. A sandbox environment is available for testing.

#### **Are there any per-user charges?**

  * The Superpower plan includes charges based on per-user storage.



  * For Enterprise, pricing is typically volume-based, reflecting both API usage and custom features.




#### **What happens if I exceed my monthly credits?**

You will be alerted ahead of time if you are going to exceed your credits. Then you can buy additional credits or add money to your wallet.

#### **Can I cancel at any time?**

Yes! When you cancel or downgrade, your plan will run until the end of the current billing period and you won't be charged again.

#### **How is Sivi API different from Canva API?**

Sivi API auto-generates on-demand, template-free designs at scale, while Canva API provides a template-based editor for manual, collaborative design. Check out the difference [here](./compare/canva-api-vs-sivi-api).

Enable your audience to create on-demand, professional designs directly within your platform using Sivi API.

## Our Founders

## Ram

##### CEO & Co-founder

Ram believes in fundamental innovation to help users at scale, and at an affordable price point. He has 16+ years of experience in building software products and 6 years of running a business. He has 3 patents in Natural language processing and mobile tech.

[](https://www.linkedin.com/in/ram-ganesan/)

##### Chief Design Officer & Co-founder

# How It Works

## FAQs

#### **How does Sivi help me?**

Sivi generates unique, template-free, and editable banner designs in an instant. You can use these to kickstart your social media campaigns faster than ever before.

#### **Can I use my own content for the banners?**

Yes, you can. If you already have content, just head to the Content Editor and enter it.

#### **Can I upload my own images?**

If you have images of your business/product, you can upload it in the Assets section of the Content Editor.

For marketers, creating engaging graphics is often a cumbersome process. Now, with the help of AI-based graphic design generator, you can create marketing visuals in seconds.

Claude Design is not a design tool. It's a website builder. An investor told me last week that [Sivi](https://in.linkedin.com/company/sivi-ai?trk=organization_guest_main-feed-card-text) and Claude Design do the same thing. She had built a presentation in Claude Design, edited a headline text, and was sold. So I asked her to move the headline 20 pixels up. She couldn't. Here's why: Claude Design is Claude AI (an LLM) writing HTML. Divs, flex containers, utility classes. You can edit text. You cannot move elements. You cannot add a shape without re-prompting. You cannot crop an image. You cannot upload a brand font. Every tweak burns Opus 4.7 tokens. Sivi is an LDM (Large Design Model). It outputs a layered canvas. Move, resize, rotate, overlap, mask, crop. Same way a designer works in Figma. Zero tokens to drag a layer. Framer and Webflow generate websites with divs. Canva and Figma let you design with pixels. Claude Design is in the first camp. Sivi is in the second. The test that separates them is the second click. \- First click: edit the text. Every tool passes. \- Second click: drag the element. Only canvases pass. Claude Design fails the second one. Sivi passes it. Websites need divs. Designs need pixels. Different models. Different jobs. If you've used Claude Design for graphic work, did you hit the same wall? [#ClaudeDesign](https://www.linkedin.com/signup/cold-join?session_redirect=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.linkedin.com%2Ffeed%2Fhashtag%2Fclaudedesign&trk=organization_guest_main-feed-card-text) [#Anthropic](https://www.linkedin.com/signup/cold-join?session_redirect=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.linkedin.com%2Ffeed%2Fhashtag%2Fanthropic&trk=organization_guest_main-feed-card-text) [#LargeDesignModel](https://www.linkedin.com/signup/cold-join?session_redirect=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.linkedin.com%2Ffeed%2Fhashtag%2Flargedesignmodel&trk=organization_guest_main-feed-card-text) [#AIDesign](https://www.linkedin.com/signup/cold-join?session_redirect=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.linkedin.com%2Ffeed%2Fhashtag%2Faidesign&trk=organization_guest_main-feed-card-text) [#SiviAI](https://www.linkedin.com/signup/cold-join?session_redirect=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.linkedin.com%2Ffeed%2Fhashtag%2Fsiviai&trk=organization_guest_main-feed-card-text)

95,000 image models, and not one of them can actually design. They predict pixels. Design predicts layout, hierarchy, typography, and brand logic. Two different problems. Here's a snapshot from [Ram](https://in.linkedin.com/in/ram-ganesan?trk=organization_guest_main-feed-card-text)'s recent conversation with the Salesforce Startup Program team, where he breaks it down. The design tools landscape: 1\. Adobe: powerful, but hours per creative. 2\. Canva: templates first. Even AI 2.0 starts from an image, code, or a template, not your brand. 3\. Nanobanana Pro, Midjourney, and the other 95,000 image models: flat JPEG and PNG. No layers, no edits, no resizing to a 300×250 without regenerating and praying. 4\. [Sivi](https://in.linkedin.com/company/sivi-ai?trk=organization_guest_main-feed-card-text): a Large Design Model (LDM) that generates editable vector designs from your brand. The difference is architectural, not cosmetic. Sivi's LDM outputs every layer editable in JPG, PNG, HTML, PDF, and SVG. Headlines swap. Logos move. A single prompt produces every IAB size, every channel, every language. With Sivi, the workflow is: 1\. Set your brand once: fonts, colors, logos, styles, components. 2\. Generate on-brand designs from a prompt or your content. 3\. Edit any layer in Sivi Design Studio, or plug it into your product via our API, SDK, and MCP server. For brands in the Salesforce ecosystem, speed is everything. Marketing Cloud helps you orchestrate campaigns, but you still need the creative assets to fuel them. That’s where Sivi comes in - automating the production grunt work so you can launch campaigns faster. Not an add-on. The creative engine. Microsoft built a text-to-design model. So did ByteDance. Neither one shipped it. Their research papers prove the same thing we've been saying since we launched in 2023: flat AI images aren't designs. You can't edit them. You can't resize them. You can't put your brand on them without starting over. Microsoft's COLE? Square outputs only. No brand kit. No API. Paper published, then silence. ByteDance's CreatiPoster? Promised open-source code, model weights, and a 100K-design dataset. The GitHub repo is still empty. The community is asking questions nobody's answering. Both models produce just two layers: \- a background image \- text on top That's it. Icons, shapes, logos? Merged into pixels. Change the headline size? The composition breaks. We took a different approach. [Sivi](https://in.linkedin.com/company/sivi-ai?trk=organization_guest_main-feed-card-text)'s Large Design Model generates true multi-layer designs. Every element is its own layer. Text stays as text. Vectors stay as vectors. You set up a brand kit once, and the model uses it every time. And it's live. REST API. UI SDK. 72+ languages. Any size. Thousands of brands already generating with it. The biggest names in tech validated the category. We built the product. Check out Sivi tech blog for full comparison. [#TextToDesign](https://www.linkedin.com/signup/cold-join?session_redirect=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.linkedin.com%2Ffeed%2Fhashtag%2Ftexttodesign&trk=organization_guest_main-feed-card-text) [#AIDesign](https://www.linkedin.com/signup/cold-join?session_redirect=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.linkedin.com%2Ffeed%2Fhashtag%2Faidesign&trk=organization_guest_main-feed-card-text) [#LargeDesignModel](https://www.linkedin.com/signup/cold-join?session_redirect=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.linkedin.com%2Ffeed%2Fhashtag%2Flargedesignmodel&trk=organization_guest_main-feed-card-text) [#MarTech](https://www.linkedin.com/signup/cold-join?session_redirect=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.linkedin.com%2Ffeed%2Fhashtag%2Fmartech&trk=organization_guest_main-feed-card-text) [#CreativeAutomation](https://www.linkedin.com/signup/cold-join?session_redirect=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.linkedin.com%2Ffeed%2Fhashtag%2Fcreativeautomation&trk=organization_guest_main-feed-card-text)

We’re excited to welcome [Sivi](https://in.linkedin.com/company/sivi-ai?trk=organization_guest_main-feed-card-text) to the Happy Llama India stage, a game-changer in the creative tech space that is moving the industry "beyond templates and flat images." While most AI tools focus on painting pixels, Sivi has pioneered the Large Design Model (LDM). This allows users to generate professional, high-conversion graphic designs like ad creatives, website banners, and social posts that are fully layered and editable, rather than flat files. Key capabilities that set Sivi apart for the 2026 creative workflow: \- True Design Logic: Unlike image generators, Sivi understands design hierarchy, composing elements that respect brand systems and typography. \- Brand DNA Integrity: Upload your brand kit, and Sivi will exclusively use your specific fonts, colors, and components to ensure 100% brand compliance. \- Instant Localization: Generate campaigns across 72+ languages in seconds without breaking the visual composition. \- Size Agnostic: Break free from standard aspect ratios—Sivi’s LDM composes designs to fit any custom dimension perfectly. Catch them live in Bengaluru as they demonstrate how they are helping 116,000+ brands and agencies eliminate design bottlenecks and scale high-volume, hyper-personalized content. # 

Bevor Sie zu YouTube weitergehen

Wir verwenden [Cookies](https://policies.google.com/technologies/cookies?hl=de&utm_source=ucb) und Daten, um

  * Google-Dienste zu erbringen und zu betreiben
  * Ausfälle zu prüfen und Maßnahmen gegen Spam, Betrug und Missbrauch zu ergreifen
  * Zielgruppeninteraktionen zu messen und Websitestatistiken zu erhalten, damit wir verstehen, wie unsere Dienste verwendet werden, und die Qualität dieser Dienste verbessern können



Wenn Sie „Alle akzeptieren“ auswählen, verwenden wir Cookies und Daten auch, um

  * neue Dienste zu entwickeln und zu verbessern
  * Werbung auszuliefern und ihre Effektivität zu messen
  * je nach Ihren Einstellungen personalisierte Inhalte anzuzeigen
  * personalisierte Werbung anzuzeigen, abhängig von Ihren Einstellungen



Wenn Sie „Alle ablehnen“ auswählen, verwenden wir Cookies nicht für diese zusätzlichen Zwecke.

Nicht personalisierte Inhalte und Werbung werden u. a. von Inhalten, die Sie sich gerade ansehen, und Ihrem Standort beeinflusst (welche Werbung Sie sehen, basiert auf Ihrem ungefähren Standort). Personalisierte Inhalte und Werbung können auch Videoempfehlungen, eine individuelle YouTube-Startseite und individuelle Werbung enthalten, die auf früheren Aktivitäten wie auf YouTube angesehenen Videos und Suchanfragen auf YouTube beruhen. Sofern relevant, verwenden wir Cookies und Daten außerdem, um Inhalte und Werbung altersgerecht zu gestalten.

Wählen Sie „Weitere Optionen“ aus, um sich zusätzliche Informationen anzusehen, einschließlich Details zum Verwalten Ihrer Datenschutzeinstellungen. Sie können auch jederzeit g.co/privacytools besuchen.

## What is Sivi AI?

Sivi AI is a generative AI that instantly turns text into visual designs. Using artificial intelligence, prompts, and content engineering, it auto-generates designs for ads, campaigns, website content, banners, WhatsApp promos, Facebook ads, Instagram posts, display ads, etc.

## Sivi AI Description

Here's the comprehensive description of Sivi AI. Gain a brief understanding of its unique features and exceptional benefits.

Sivi AI is the Only Generative AI For Visual Designs dedicated to helping Marketers, Designers, Content creators, and Social Media Managers create stunning visual ads.

  * In your language
  * In any dimension
  * For your assets
  * Following your brand's visual identity
  * With designer-friendly customizations
  * In multiple styles and variations



All within 2 minutes.

ChatGPT is for text, Midjourney is for images, and Sivi AI is for visual designs. Unlike text-to-template tools, Sivi AI does true composition to generate stunning visuals. Sivi now produces up to 16 variations per generation, with over 50% of outcomes looking fantastic. We'd love to hear your thoughts on Sivi!

### **Sivi AI  Features**

  1. Turn your ideas into visuals - Transform your unique ideas into captivating, brand-elevating visuals with Sivi.
  2. Generate designs for any dimensions - Sivi's generative AI adapts to diverse dimensions, from social media to custom sizes.
  3. Add content - Sivi's revolutionary content editor simplifies prompt creation for effortless design generation.
  4. Single-click solution - Streamline content extraction with Sivi's Chrome plugin, in just 1 click.
  5. Text-to-Visual ads - Craft persuasive marketing copy from your brand's story instantly using Sivi's rewrite feature.
  6. Generate within your brand guidelines - Easily enforce brand consistency with Sivi by inputting your brand guidelines.
  7. Get multiple styles and variations - Effortlessly create A/B testing variations with Sivi's multiple style options.
  8. Edit-generated designs - Sivi blends generative AI with a design editor, offering dynamic, designer-friendly visuals.
  9. Ad-free / Watermark-free - Sivi AI doesn't contain any form of external advertising or watermarks.
  10. No Coding Required - Sivi AI can be used without coding or programming skills.
  11. Live Preview - Instantly see what your files and documents look like as you create them and download them.
